programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Swiss league / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. Since 2003, the league has been played according to the system of ten teams, where each team plays four games, two at home and two away. After 36 rounds, the last team leaves the elite rank of Swiss football and is relegated to the second Swiss league. The team with the most titles is Grasshopper Club Zurich with 27, of which 19 are in the professional period. The new millennium was marked by the club from Basel with multiple consecutive championship titles and very good results in the Champions League. / Švajcarska liga je jedna od najdugovječnijih liga u Evropi čija je prva sezona krenula još u 20. veku odnosno od 1897. godine. Liga se od 2003. igra po sistemu deset ekipa gde svaki igra sa svakim četiri utakmice po dve kući i dve u gostima. Poslednja ekipa nakon 36 kola napušta elitni rang švajvarskog fudbala i ispada u drugu švajcarsku ligu. Ekipa sa najviše titula je Grasshopper Club Zurich sa 27, od kojih su 19 u razdoblju profesionalizma. Novi milenijum je obeležio klub iz Bazela sa višestrukim uzastopnim titulama prvaka i jako dobrim rezultatima u Ligi šampiona.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy
programme.desc: The biggest league competition in Italy was founded in 1898. Twenty clubs fight each year for the prestigious title of Serie A champion. / Najveće ligaško takmičenje u Italiji osnovano je 1898 godine. Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Water polo - Champions League / Vaterpolo - Liga Prvaka
programme.desc: The strongest club water polo competition in the world will offer every fan of this sport a series of unforgettable moments in front of the TV screens. Provjerite koja će momčad podići titulu prvaka Europe!

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish league / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: LaLiga Talking Football

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish league / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for European Championship (Women) 2026 / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž) 2026
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two stages. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group advances to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish league / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish league / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for European Championship (Women) 2026 / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž) 2026
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two stages. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group advances to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Handball - Qualification for European Championship (Women) / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž)
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two stages. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group advances to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most media-covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the "Greens" have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

Oni će govoriti o svojim pobjedama i porazima, trnovitom putu do pobjedničkog postolja i manje vidljivoj strani sporta.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Ice Hockey - KHL
programme.desc: The strongest hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called the KHL or Continental Hockey League. The competition itself emerged from the Russian Super League in 2008, and since then the competition has spread to more and more European and Asian countries, thus unofficially becoming the second best hockey league in the world after the American-Canadian NHL. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga svijeta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Sportske igre mladih BiH
programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this area, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za djecu i omladinu na ovim prostorima čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Ice hockey - Champions League / Hokej na ledu - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Ice Hockey Champions League is an international competition for the best European teams that premiered in the 2014/2015 season. The competition was founded by the International Ice Hockey Federation in partnership with the six best European leagues with the aim of continuing the tradition of the "European Trophy" competition and bringing together the best teams in Europe. / Liga šampiona u hokeju na ledu je međunarodno takmičenje za najbolje evropske ekipe koje je svoje premijerno izdanje imalo u sezoni 2014./2015. programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish league / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Ice hockey - Champions League / Hokej na ledu - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Ice Hockey Champions League is an international competition for the best European teams that premiered in the 2014/2015 season. The competition was founded by the International Ice Hockey Federation in partnership with the six best European leagues with the aim of continuing the tradition of the "European Trophy" competition and bringing together the best teams in Europe. / Liga šampiona u hokeju na ledu je međunarodno takmičenje za najbolje evropske ekipe koje je svoje premijerno izdanje imalo u sezoni 2014./2015. Takmičenje je osnovala Međunarodna federacija hokeja na ledu u partnerstvu sa šest najboljih evropskih liga sa ciljem da nastavi tradiciju "European Trophy" takmičenja i objedini najbolje ekipe Evrope.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish league / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Show
programme.desc: The French "League 1" was founded in 1932 and has been attracting the attention of football lovers from all over the world ever since! Meet some of the best football players and remember the moves and reversals that will be talked about. / Francuska "Liga 1" osnovana je 1932. godine i od tada privlači pažnju zaljubljenika u fudbal iz celog sveta! Upoznajte neke od najboljih fudbalera i prisetite se poteza i preokreta o kojima će se pričati.

programme.title: Football - Bundesliga / Fudbal - Bundesliga
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings, until today. Don't miss every possible opportunity to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it. / Uz sve ono što nam je Nemačka podarila kroz istoriju ponosno stoji i Bundesliga. Najviši rang fudbalskog takmičenja osnovanog 1963. godine broji 18 ekipa koje svakog avgusta kreću u trku za popularnim tanjirom. Najviše puta ga je osvajao minhenski Bajern, čak 24 puta. Kultura navijanja, pune tribine i vrhunski fudbal je ono što krasi Bundesligu od njenih početaka, pa sve do danas. Ne propustite svakom mogućom prilikom da uživate u bundesligaškim susretima. Sigurno nećete požaliti.

programme.title: The Big Interview
programme.desc: Listen to interesting interviews with some of the biggest names in the Premier League. Find out all about the thoughts of these famous footballers, their approach to the game, future plans and much more! / Poslušajte zanimljive intervjue sa nekim od najvećih imena Premier lige. Saznajte sve o razmišljanjima ovih poznatih fudbalera, njihovom pristupu igri, budućim planovima i još mnogo toga!

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Swiss league / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. Since 2003, the league has been played according to the system of ten teams, where each team plays four games, two at home and two away. After 36 rounds, the last team leaves the elite rank of Swiss football and is relegated to the second Swiss league. The team with the most titles is Grasshopper Club Zurich with 27, of which 19 are in the professional period. The new millennium was marked by the club from Basel with multiple consecutive championship titles and very good results in the Champions League. / Švajcarska liga je jedna od najdugovječnijih liga u Evropi čija je prva sezona krenula još u 20. veku odnosno od 1897. godine. Liga se od 2003. igra po sistemu deset ekipa gde svaki igra sa svakim četiri utakmice po dve kući i dve u gostima. Poslednja ekipa nakon 36 kola napušta elitni rang švajvarskog fudbala i ispada u drugu švajcarsku ligu. Ekipa sa najviše titula je Grasshopper Club Zurich sa 27, od kojih su 19 u razdoblju profesionalizma. Novi milenijum je obeležio klub iz Bazela sa višestrukim uzastopnim titulama prvaka i jako dobrim rezultatima u Ligi šampiona.

programme.title: Football - France 2nd League / Fudbal - Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 is the second lowest level of French club football competitions. The league was founded in 1933 and in its current format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 rounds in which each team plays at home and away with each of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best-placed teams achieve direct placement in Ligue 1, while three more clubs, through additional play-offs, hunt for another position for placement in the elite class of French football. The last two teams are relegated to the lower ranks of the competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Cycling - Tour of Lombardy (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Lombardije (M)
programme.desc: The race through Lombardy is the last in a series of five monumental classics in the calendar of the World Cycling Union. The "Fallen Leaf Classic", as this race is also called, is considered one of the oldest and most prestigious one-day competitions during the fall. At the 113th edition, cyclists will ride from Bergamo to Como, a route 243 kilometers long. / Trka kroz Lombardiju poslednja je u nizu od pet monumentalnih klasika u kalendaru Svetske biciklističke unije. "Klasik opalog lišća", kako se još naziva ova trka, smatra se jednim od najstarijih i najprestižnijih jednodnevnih takmičenja tokom jeseni. Na 113. izdanju biciklisti će voziti od Bergama do Komoa, rutom dugačkom 243 kilometara.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Rafael declares his love to Isadora and kisses her. This confuses the heart of that girl who is already in love. Rafael discovers that Isadora was investigating the scent on his shirt and accidentally stained it with lipstick. This gives him hope that he will be with his beloved. Olívia notices that the workers did not come to the textile factory because of their children. She got the idea to open a kindergarten for village children. Arminda wants to help Isadora and the textile factory with the kindergarten, so she proposes a charity raffle to raise money. Matias goes crazy, kidnaps and tries to kill Clarinha. He is prevented by Leônidas and Rafael. Violeta decides to place Matias in a sanatorium after he has a nervous breakdown. A gypsy family settles on a plantation. Bene threatens them and chases them away. But Isadora is moved by their situation and prevents him from driving them away. / Rafael izjavi Isadori ljubav i poljubi je. To zbuni srce te već zaljubljene djevojke. Rafael otkrije da je Isadora istraživala miris na njegovoj košulji i slučajno ju je umrljala ružem. To mu daje nadu da će biti sa svojom voljenom. Olívia primijeti da radnice nisu došle u tekstilnu tvornicu zbog zbog svoje djece. Sine joj ideja da otvori vrtić za seosku djecu. Arminda želi pomoći Isadori i tekstilnoj tvornici oko toga vrtića, pa predlaže dobrotvornu tombolu za prikupljanje novca. Matias poludi, otme i pokuša ubiti Clarinhu. Sprečavaju ga Leônidas i Rafael. Violeta odluči smjestiti Matiasa u sanatorij nakon što je doživio živčani slom. Ciganska obitelj nastani se na plantaži. Bene im prijeti i tjera ih. Ali Isadora je ganuta njihovom situacijom i spriječi ga da ih ne otjera.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: The father praises Tiago for standing up to Marco, but admits that he worries that Marco might harm Cacao. Cacau informs Regina and Valdemar of Marco's threat and decides that she will not share custody of her son with him. Salomao encourages Tiago to confess his feelings to Cacao, but he decides to go and reconcile with her. / Otac hvali Tiaga jer se suprotstavio Marcu, ali prizna da se brine da bi Marco mogao nauditi Cacau. Cacau obavijesti Reginu i Valdemara o Marcovoj prijetnji i odluči da neće s njime dijeliti skrbništvo nad sinom. Salomao potiče Tiaga da prizna Cacau što osjeća prema njoj, ali on se odluči otići pomiriti s njom.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: And this Tuesday we have prepared for you a combination of film, music, sport and adventure! He conquered the highest peaks in the world, and he writes about his dramas on Everest in his new book. Our guest is the most successful Croatian alpinist Stipe Božić. After a long break, the Rijeka group En Face returns to the music scene. We talk about the new single "Mary Jane" and other interesting things with frontman Sandro Bastiančić. Are social networks friend or foe of athletes? Ivan Dorian Molnar will discuss this topic with psychologist Dajana Čopec in his column today. Host: Barbara Kolar Producer: Vesna Luković Žarn Editor and screenwriter: Ivan Dorian Molnar / I ovaj utorak pripremili smo za vas spoj filma, glazbe, sporta i avanture! Osvojio je najveće vrhove svijeta, a o svojim dramama na Everestu piše u svojoj novoj knjizi. Naš gost je najuspješniji hrvatski alpinist Stipe Božić. Nakon duge pauze, riječka grupa En Face vraća se na glazbenu scenu. O novom singlu "Mary Jane" i drugim zanimljivostima razgovaramo s frontmenom Sandrom Bastiančićem. Jesu li društvene mreže prijatelj ili neprijatelj sportaša? O toj temi danas će u svojoj rubrici Ivan Dorian Molnar razgovarati sa psihologinjom Dajanom Čopec. Voditeljica: Barbara Kolar Realizatorica: Vesna Luković Žarn Urednik i scenarist: Ivan Dorian Molnar

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore i teme iz povijesti hrvatske fotografije te suvremene autore koji djeluju na hrvatskoj sceni.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Public fountains and fountains have long been the only way to obtain water for drinking, cooking and washing, so they were erected in all available and convenient places. Over time, fountains also become decorations, so they get more and more imaginative shapes. / Javne česme i fontane dugo su bile jedini način dobivanja vode za piće, kuhanje i pranje, pa su se podizale na svim dostupnim i prikladnim mjestima. Fontane s vremenom postaju i ukrasi, pa dobivaju sve maštovitije oblike.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the show Dr. Beck, we will talk about diseases that once ravaged the world and claimed millions of lives, but today are just historical concepts for many. Plague, tuberculosis, polio, syphilis... But have they really disappeared or are they just hiding? / U emisiji Dr. Beck razgovarat ćemo o bolestima koje su nekoć harale svijetom i odnosile milijune života, a danas su za mnoge tek povijesni pojmovi. Kuga, tuberkuloza, polio, sifilis... No, jesu li doista nestale ili se samo skrivaju?

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia will remind us of the importance of gathering around the table. Together with her granddaughter Olivia, she will prepare impressive fried cheese in the form of bowls stuffed with a colorful salad. Then we will see the bucatini pasta with broccoli and walnut pesto. The sumptuous taste of each bite of this dish is like a warm hug. Following are peppers stuffed with turkey, which everyone knows how to prepare. Join Lidia because it's always more fun in company. / Lidia će nas podsjetiti na važnost okupljanja za stolom. S unukom Olivijom pripremit će dojmljivi prženi sir u obliku zdjelica nadjeven šarenom salatom. Potom ćemo vidjeti tjesteninu bucatini s pestom od brokule i oraha. Raskošan okus svakog zalogaja tog jela nalik je na topao zagrljaj. Slijede paprike nadjevene puretinom, koje bi svatko znao pripremiti. Pridružite se Lidiji jer je u društvu uvijek zabavnije.

programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Although our guests are not athletes, they had a huge impact on major sporting events that gave momentum to the life and identity of Split and Zagreb. For one, they said that it is not known whether he is a convinced sportsman who professionally deals with culture or a sworn cultural worker who has a great love for sports, since he was the vice-president of the Executive Committee of the Mediterranean Games and the president of the Executive Committee of the Universiade. The other is the author of the famous Croatian "cubes", but also the creator of the visual identity of the Mediterranean Games and the Universiade. Today's Golden League will host Vladimir Peza and Boris Ljubičić. Host: Božo Sušec Producer: Mladen Šimunov Screenplay: Tanja Šimić and Božo Sušec Editors: Silva Skender and Renata Labaš / Iako naši gosti nisu sportaši, imali su golem utjecaj na velike sportske događaje koji su dali zamah životu i identitetu Splita i Zagreba. Za jednog su rekli da se ne zna je li uvjereni sportaš koji se profesionalno bavi kulturom ili zakleti kulturni radnik kojemu je sport velika ljubav, budući da je bio potpredsjednik Izvršnog komiteta Mediteranskih igara i predsjednik Izvršnog odbora Univerzijade. Drugi je autor poznatih hrvatskih "kockica", ali i tvorac vizualnog identiteta Mediteranskih igara i Univerzijade. Današnja Zlatna liga ugostit će Vladimira Pezu i Borisa Ljubičića. Voditelj: Božo Sušec Realizator: Mladen Šimunov Scenarij: Tanja Šimić i Božo Sušec Urednice: Silva Skender i Renata Labaš

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: When preparing simple dishes, it is crucial to build on the taste, and at the same time it is important to have quality ingredients, which must speak for themselves. Lidia will prepare two dishes in which the main star is winter vegetables: minestrone soup and a salad of roasted pumpkin, carrots, chickpeas and almonds. This dinner is easy to prepare. Discover its great taste by cooking with Lidia. / Kad se pripremaju jednostavna jela, ključno je nadograđivati okus, a pritom je važno imati kvalitetne sastojke, koji moraju govoriti sami za sebe. Lidia će pripremiti dva jela u kojima je glavna zvijezda zimsko povrće: juhu minestrone i salatu od pečene tikve, mrkve, slanutka i badema. Ova se večera jednostavno pripremi. Otkrijte njezin sjajni okus kuhajući s Lidijom.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The first thing that comes to mind when breast health is mentioned is breast cancer as a severe malignant disease that is also a serious public health problem in Croatia due to the large number of patients. However, in this show, in addition to an interventional radiologist, a surgeon and an epidemiologist, we will deal with other diagnoses and conditions of the breast, which are not always malignant, but need to be detected and treated in time. We will also emphasize the importance of preventive examinations, especially important for early detection and more successful treatment of breast diseases. / Prva pomisao pri spomenu zdravlja dojke je rak dojke kao teška maligna bolest koja je i u Hrvatskoj ozbiljan javnozdravstveni problem zbog velikog broja oboljelih. No, u ovoj ćemo se emisiji, uz intervencijskog radiologa, kirurga i epidemiologinju, baviti i drugim dijagnozama i stanjima dojke, koja nisu uvijek maligna, ali ih je potrebno na vrijeme otkriti i liječiti. Također ćemo naglasiti i važnost preventivnih pregleda, posebice važnih radi ranog otkrivanja i uspješnijeg liječenja bolesti dojke.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.
