programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Simone tries to convince Sal that everything that supposedly happened between her and Rui was actually made up by Justin. Majoris wants Rua to help prevent Simone from kicking Susana out of the palace. Simone tells Sal that Regina might be pregnant with Valdemar, not Justin. It shocks her. / Simone pokušava uvjeriti Sal da je sve što se navodno dogodilo između nje i Ruija, zapravo Justinova izmišljotina. Majoris želi da Rui pomogne spriječiti da Simone izbaci Susanu iz palače. Simone kaže Sal da bi Regina mogla biti trudna s Valdemarom, a ne sa Justinom. Nju to šokira.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Alonso makes a drastic decision in agreement with Romulo to avoid firing the entire staff. Ana tries to get closer to Ricardo. Ángela expresses her suspicions to Martina that Cruz and the captain are arranging a marriage for Curro behind his back. / Alonso donese drastičnu odluku u dogovoru s Romulom kako bi izbjegao otpuštanje cijele posluge. Ana se pokušava približiti Ricardu. Ángela iznese Martini svoje sumnje da Cruz i satnik dogovaraju brak za Curra njemu iza leđa.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: The fries were cold, the waiter was hot! A review like this makes the chef angry, but makes the restaurant owner happy. Satisfying hungry tourists is one of the biggest challenges. Gastronomy is the area where reviews are the most peppery, but also the most powerful. In just a few clicks, guests can launch a restaurant to the very top of the rankings, or leave it eerily empty. Is our sea enough for Croatian gastronomy to get five stars? / Pomfrit je bio hladan, konobar je bio vatren! Recenzija poput ove naljuti glavnog kuhara, ali razveseli vlasnika restorana. Zadovoljiti gladne turiste jedan je od najvećih izazova. Gastronomija je područje gdje su recenzije najpaprenije, ali i najmoćnije. U samo nekoliko klikova gosti mogu lansirati restoran na sam vrh ljestvice, ili ga ostaviti sablasno praznim. Je li naše more dovoljno da hrvatska gastroponuda dobije pet zvjezdica?

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: Krunoslav Pokas' participation in "Action Camorra" will bring him face to face with a known dangerous criminal. See what encounters with dangerous criminals look like and what a man feels when he has to reach for the last option _ take out his own gun. / Sudjelovanje u "Akciji Camorra" Krunoslava Pokasa dovest će oči u oči s poznatim opasnim počiniteljem. Pogledajte kako izgledaju susreti s opasnim kriminalcima te što čovjek osjeća kada mora posegnuti za zadnjom opcijom _ izvaditi svoj vlastiti pištolj.

programme.title: Flowers by Saša Šekoranja / Cvijeće Saše Šekoranje
programme.desc: Our famous artist and arranger Saša Šekoranja shows us how we can create our own flower magic at home. / Naš poznati umjetnik i aranžer Saša Šekoranja pokazuje nam kako kod kuće možemo napraviti vlastitu cvjetnu čaroliju.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: This time, Ben Fogle will visit Sandy, who opened an animal sanctuary on the Greek island of Andros. They will spend a week on the mountainside with 25 dogs, 8 donkeys, a horse, a mule and more than 20 cats. Surrounded by beautiful nature, Ben helps feed, brush and walk the many animals that live on the property around the 300-year-old house. She will join Sandy in a surprise rescue operation that will bring the total number of dogs to 32. Sandy never takes a day off, and Ben will discover what made her choose this lifestyle. Surrounded by animals, Sandy doesn't feel the need to socialize with the locals and claims that the animals provide her with everything she needs. But it seems to Ben that she doesn't spend enough time on herself because of this, and wonders how she'll cope when she's older. / Ben Fogle ovaj će put posjetiti Sandy koja je na grčkom otoku Androsu otvorila utočište za životinje. Na obronku planine provest će tjedan s 25 pasa, 8 magaraca, konjem, mulom i više od 20 mačaka. Okružen prelijepom prirodom, Ben pomaže hraniti, četkati i šetati mnoštvo životinja koje žive na posjedu oko kuće stare 300 godina. Pridružit će se Sandy u iznenadnoj akciji spašavanja štenaca nakon koje će ukupan broj pasa narasti na 32. Sandy nikad ne uzima slobodan dan, a Ben će otkriti što ju je navelo da izabere takav način života. Okružena životinjama, Sandy ne osjeća potrebu da se druži s lokalnim stanovništvom i tvrdi da joj životinje pružaju sve što joj je potrebno. Ali Benu se čini da zbog toga ne posvećuje dovoljno vremena sebi i pita se kako će se snalaziti kad bude starija.

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.title: Regionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: Should children issue receipts at school fairs, where they sell their handicrafts? How should parents react to purchases without a receipt? These questions are answered by psychotherapist Tanja Pureta and economist Emil Pavić. Mario Knezović and Saša Lozar will present their latest musical works, "Samo reci no" and "It all starts with us". / Trebaju li djeca na školskim sajmovima, gdje prodaju svoje rukotvorine, izdavati račune? Kako bi roditelji trebali reagirati na kupnju bez računa? Na ta pitanja odgovaraju psihoterapeutkinja Tanja Pureta i ekonomist Emil Pavić. Svoje najnovije glazbene uratke, "Samo reci ne" i "S nam sve počinje", predstavit će Mario Knezović i Saša Lozar.

programme.title: Potjera

In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Kristijan Iličić's journey through Ethiopia begins in Harar, one of the holy cities of Islam. Harar is known for the coexistence of humans and hyenas, so Kristijan meets a pack of wild hyenas that clean the city at night, feeding on garbage. Visiting Gondar, the former seat of Ethiopian rulers, Kristijan finds himself in a conflict zone between the army and the rebels. Despite the danger of war, he climbs Mount Semien to find gelada monkeys, a unique species of primate that lives only in that location. He briefly visits Lalibella, the holy city of Ethiopian Christians, with the so-called eighth wonder of the world _ in the rock carved Church of St. Jurja. Arriving in the modern metropolis of Addis Ababa, Kristijan explores the past and present of the big city _ he hangs out with the rap star Kassmasse, but also visits the castle of Emperor Menelik, where the Seljan brothers stayed 125 years ago. / Putovanje Etiopijom Kristijan Iličić počinje u Hararu, jednom od svetih gradova islama. Harar je poznat po suživotu ljudi i hijena pa tako i Kristijan susreće čopor divljih hijena koje noću čiste grad hraneći se otpacima. Posjećujući Gondar, bivše sjedište etiopskih vladara, Kristijan se nađe u zoni sukoba vojske i pobunjenika. Unatoč ratnoj opasnosti, penje se na planinu Semien kako bi pronašao majmune gelade, jedinstvenu vrstu primata koja živi samo na toj lokaciji. Nakratko posjeti Lalibellu, sveti grad etiopskih kršćana, s tzv. osmim svjetskim čudom _ u stijenu uklesanom Crkvom sv. Jurja. Dolaskom u modernu metropolu Addis Abebu, Kristijan istražuje prošlost i sadašnjost velikog grada _ druži se s rap zvijezdom Kassmasseom, ali i posjećuje dvorac cara Menelika, u kojem su prije 125 godina boravila braća Seljan.

programme.title: Krah
programme.desc: The investigation continues, and shocking truths come to the surface. Two years ago, during Andrew's 50th birthday party, a drunken Jess confessed a dark secret to Liz. In the present, Liz is torn between Jess, Ed and Social Services. Liz and Ed try to reach Jess, but they can't fight her anger and pain. Jess finds it increasingly difficult to deal with a situation she cannot control. The friends slowly realize that Ed has another side. Everyone is surprised by his behavior towards his family and friends at the children's soccer tournament. As the friends begin to get more and more involved in the Carrisford family problems, rumors begin to spread. Mel moves into their home and discovers that everything is not as perfect as it seems. Charlotte takes a drastic step to support Ed, revealing new secrets about what really happened on Friday. Detective Rustin and Lucy Harding put the family under pressure and look for cracks in a marriage that once seemed perfect. The visit under the supervision of the social service turns into chaos, and new facts about the state of health are revealed. / Istraga se nastavlja, a na površinu izlaze šokantne istine. Prije dvije godine, za vrijeme proslave Andrewova 50. rođendana, pijana je Jess Liz priznala mračnu tajnu. U sadašnjosti, Liz je razapeta između Jess, Eda i socijalne službe. Liz i Ed pokušavaju doprijeti do Jess, no ne mogu se boriti protiv njezina bijesa i boli. Jess se sve teže nosi sa situacijom koju ne može kontrolirati. Prijatelji polako shvaćaju da Ed ima i drugu stranu. Svi su iznenađeni njegovim ponašanjem prema obitelji i prijateljima na dječjem nogometom turniru. Nakon što se prijatelji sve dublje počinju uplitati u obiteljske probleme Carrisforda, glasine se počinju širiti. Mel se useli u njihov dom i otkrije da sve nije savršeno kao što se činilo. Charlotte napravi drastičan korak kako bi poduprla Eda, pri čemu se otkriju nove tajne o tome što se zapravo dogodilo u petak. Detektiv Rustin i Lucy Harding stavljaju obitelj pod pritisak i traže pukotine u braku koji se nekoć činio savršenim. Posjet pod nadzorom socijalne službe pretvara se u kaos, a otkrivaju se i nove činjenice oko zdravstvenog stanja.

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: A brisk debate in the Parliament on the Prime Minister's report on the state of the nation. The government says: the country is making economic and social progress, the opposition retorts: it is a fiction that has nothing to do with reality. How is life in Croatia today? Has inflation canceled out GDP growth? How to stop the rise in prices and cost of living? The guests are: Nikola Mažar, HDZ, Dražen Jović, president of the Independent Croatian Trade Unions, Irena Weber, chief director of HUP, Ivana Marković, SDP. / Žustra rasprava u Saboru o premijerovom izvješću o stanju nacije. Vlada poručuje: država gospodarski i socijalno napreduje, oporba uzvraća: to je fikcija koja nema veze sa stvarnošću. Kako se danas živi u Hrvatskoj? Je li inflacija poništila rast BDP-a? Kako zaustaviti rast cijena i troškova života? Gosti su: Nikola Mažar, HDZ, Dražen Jović, predsjednik Nezavisnih hrvatskih sindikata, Irena Weber, glavna direktorica HUP-a, Ivana Marković, SDP.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Remek-djelo ili zlodjelo
programme.desc: In this episode, Fiona Bruce and Philip Mold go to France in search of two greats of Impressionism and Post-Impressionism _ Camille Pissarro and his friend and protégé, Paul Cezanne. Fiona travels through a stunning Provençal landscape exploring a simple watercolor owned by Dominique Rogers. She is the great-niece of Anthony Valabrègue, poet, art critic and close friend of Cezanne, for whom he served as a model several times. Dominique, who is not a particular admirer of Cezanne's painting style, believes that it is a gift from Cezanne himself, which Valabrègue's widow gave to her father in the twenties. Fiona visits Cezanne's studio in Aix-en-Provence, where he lived, tours the nearby quarries, at the foot of Mount Sainte-Victoire, where the rich yellowish rocks and slender trees strongly influenced the artist's work. Is that where Dominique's tree was painted? / U ovoj epizodi Fiona Bruce i Philip Mould odlaze u Francusku u potrazi za dvojicom velikana impresionizma i postimpresionizma _ Camilleom Pissarrom i njegovim prijateljem i štićenikom, Paulom Cezanneom. Fiona putuje kroz zadivljujući provansalski krajolik istražujući jednostavan akvarel u vlasništvu Dominique Rogers. Ona je pranećakinja Anthonyja Valabrèguea, pjesnika, likovnog kritičara i Cezanneova bliskog prijatelja, kojemu je više puta poslužio kao model. Dominique, koja nije osobita poklonica Cezanneova slikarskog stila, vjeruje da je riječ o daru samog Cezannea, koji je Valabrègueova udovica predala njezinu ocu dvadesetih godina. Fiona posjećuje Cezanneov atelje u Aix-en-Provenceu, gdje je živio, obilazi obližnje kamenolome, podno planine Sainte-Victoire, gdje su bogate žućkaste stijene i vitka stabla snažno utjecali na umjetnikov rad. Je li upravo tu naslikano Dominiqueino stablo?

programme.title: Katastrofa podmornice Titan
programme.desc: In June 2023, the OceanGate submarine was on its final mission to descend on the wreck of the Titanic when it imploded at a depth of 3,800 meters. All five passengers died in the accident. With exclusive interviews with members of the US Coast Guard investigative committee and first-ever video footage, we reveal why the tragedy happened and whether it could have been prevented. We will see an analysis of the events leading up to the fateful day _ from the founding of OceanGate under CEO Stockton Rush to the start of construction of the Titan, a unique carbon fiber submarine designed to take tourists on the adventure of a lifetime _ a visit to the wreck of the Titanic. The documentary provides a detailed account of the last mission that ended in a tragic implosion and initiates a discussion about the establishment of necessary safety protocols in similar deep sea exploration missions. World traveler and explorer Josh Gates will show us for the first time his footage of Titan's interior, which he intended to use in the series "Expedition into the Unknown" on the Discovery Channel. They were created in 2021 _ just a few months before the submarine began going on missions to the wreck of the Titanic. A disturbing interview with Rush and a troubled test dive led Gates to cancel the filming of the planned episode. Through interviews with technicians and deep-sea explorers who took part in the submarine's test dive, as well as long-time friends and colleagues of Stockton Rush, we will learn more about the insufficient safety measures and the clear signs that the submarine was not safe _ but those responsible chose to ignore it. / U lipnju 2023. podmornica OceanGate bila je u posljednjoj misiji spuštanja na olupinu Titanica kada je implodirala na dubini od 3800 metara. U nesreći je poginulo svih pet putnika. Uz ekskluzivne razgovore s članovima istraživačkog odbora američke obalne straže i prvi put objavljene video snimke, otkrivamo zašto se tragedija dogodila te je li se mogla spriječiti. Vidjet ćemo analizu događaja koji su doveli do kobnog dana _ od osnivanja tvrtke OceanGate pod vodstvom izvršnog direktora Stocktona Rusha do početka gradnje Titana, jedinstvene podmornice od ugljičnih vlakana, projektirane kako bi vodila turiste u pustolovinu života _ posjet olupini Titanica. Dokumentarac donosi detaljni prikaz posljednje misije koja je završila tragičnom implozijom te pokreće raspravu o uspostavi nužnih sigurnosnih protokola u sličnim misijama istraživanja dubokog mora. Svjetski putnik i istraživač Josh Gates prvi put će nam pokazati svoje snimke unutrašnjosti Titana, koje je namjeravao upotrijebiti u seriji "Ekspedicija u nepoznato" na Discovery Channelu. Nastale su 2021. _ samo nekoliko mjeseci prije nego što je podmornica počela ići u misije na olupinu Titanica. Uznemirujući intervju s Rushom i problematičan testni zaron naveli su Gatesa da otkaže snimanje planirane epizode. Kroz razgovore s tehničarima i istraživačima dubokog mora koji su sudjelovali u testnom zaronu podmornice, kao i s dugogodišnjim prijateljima i kolegama Stocktona Rusha, saznat ćemo više o nedovoljnim mjerama sigurnosti i jasnim znakovima da podmornica nije sigurna _ ali su odgovorni to odlučili ignorirati.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Violeta finds Eugenio smelling her forgotten scarf in the car after a long night spent outdoors. Lira tells Rafael that he is not what he says he is and warns him that he is in trouble. After successfully building the village kindergarten, Joaquim embezzles a food check for the children and accuses Rafael of theft. Send the police after Rafael. Augusta helps Rafael collect the money to prove that he wasn't the one who sold the antique jewelry. Isadora is falling more and more in love with Rafael, but she is still strongly fighting the feeling. Lira invites the residents to her campfire party. Onofre is uncomfortable with Olivia and the priest Tenorio. He says in front of everyone that Olívia is in love. She is looking for a solution not to fall in love with the priest. Kiss Rafael and Isadora sees it. / Violeta zatekne Eugenija kako miriše njezin zaboravljeni šal u autu nakon duge noći koju su proveli na otvorenom. Lira kaže Rafaelu da on nije onakav kakvim se predstavlja i upozori ga da je u nevolji. Nakon uspješne izgradnje seoskog vrtića, Joaquim pronevjeri ček za hranu za djecu i optuži Rafaela za krađu. Pošalje policiju za Rafaelom. Augusta pomaže Rafaelu da prikupi novac da kako bi dokazao da nije on prodao antikni nakit. Isadora se sve više zaljubljuje u Rafaela, ali i dalje se silno bori protiv tog osjećaja. Lira poziva stanovnike na svoju zabavu uz logorsku vatru. Onofreu je neugodno s Olívijom i svećenikom Tenoriom. Pred svima kaže da je Olívia zaljubljena. Ona traži rješenje da se ne zaljubi u svećenika. Poljubi Rafaela i Isadora to vidi.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Simone tries to convince Sal that everything that supposedly happened between her and Rui was actually made up by Justin. Majoris wants Rua to help prevent Simone from kicking Susana out of the palace. Simone tells Sal that Regina might be pregnant with Valdemar, not Justin. It shocks her. / Simone pokušava uvjeriti Sal da je sve što se navodno dogodilo između nje i Ruija, zapravo Justinova izmišljotina. Majoris želi da Rui pomogne spriječiti da Simone izbaci Susanu iz palače. Simone kaže Sal da bi Regina mogla biti trudna s Valdemarom, a ne sa Justinom. Nju to šokira.

programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The first thing that comes to mind when breast health is mentioned is breast cancer as a severe malignant disease that is also a serious public health problem in Croatia due to the large number of patients. However, in this show, in addition to an interventional radiologist, a surgeon and an epidemiologist, we will deal with other diagnoses and conditions of the breast, which are not always malignant, but need to be detected and treated in time. We will also emphasize the importance of preventive examinations, especially important for early detection and more successful treatment of breast diseases. / Prva pomisao pri spomenu zdravlja dojke je rak dojke kao teška maligna bolest koja je i u Hrvatskoj ozbiljan javnozdravstveni problem zbog velikog broja oboljelih. No, u ovoj ćemo se emisiji, uz intervencijskog radiologa, kirurga i epidemiologinju, baviti i drugim dijagnozama i stanjima dojke, koja nisu uvijek maligna, ali ih je potrebno na vrijeme otkriti i liječiti. Također ćemo naglasiti i važnost preventivnih pregleda, posebice važnih radi ranog otkrivanja i uspješnijeg liječenja bolesti dojke.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: When preparing simple dishes, it is crucial to build on the taste, and at the same time it is important to have quality ingredients, which must speak for themselves. Lidia will prepare two dishes in which the main star is winter vegetables: minestrone soup and a salad of roasted pumpkin, carrots, chickpeas and almonds. This dinner is easy to prepare. Discover its great taste by cooking with Lidia. / Kad se pripremaju jednostavna jela, ključno je nadograđivati okus, a pritom je važno imati kvalitetne sastojke, koji moraju govoriti sami za sebe. Lidia će pripremiti dva jela u kojima je glavna zvijezda zimsko povrće: juhu minestrone i salatu od pečene tikve, mrkve, slanutka i badema. Ova se večera jednostavno pripremi. Otkrijte njezin sjajni okus kuhajući s Lidijom.

programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Award-winning translators Mia Pervan and Xenia Detoni will explain whether translation, as Josip Tabak used to say, is pouring someone else's wine into the golden glass of the Croatian language. One translates from English and French, and the other from Hungarian. / Je li prevođenje, kako je Josip Tabak govorio, pretakanje tuđeg vina u zlatnu čašu hrvatskog jezika, objasnit će nam nagrađivane prevoditeljice Mia Pervan i Xenia Detoni. Jedna prevodi s engleskog i francuskog, a druga s mađarskog.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia wants everyone to enjoy cooking. Her Spicy Pork Chops with Broccoli are baked together so dinner is ready in no time. Lidia will teach grandson Miles that he can prepare a simple weekday meal from leftover soup. Dessert will be crescents filled with apricot jam, which are a favorite of the Bastianich household. In this sequel, discover the joy of preparing dinner. / Lidia želi da svi uživaju u kuhanju. Njezini pikantni svinjski kotleti s brokulom zajedno se ispeku pa večera bude začas gotova. Lidia će naučiti unuka Milesa da od ostatka juhe može pripremiti jednostavno jelo na radni dan. Desert će biti polumjeseci nadjeveni pekmezom od marelica, koji su omiljeni u kućanstvu Bastianich. U ovom nastavku otkrijte užitak pripreme večere.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the show Dr. Beck we are talking about alopecia. This is hair loss, i.e. loss of hair from the head, and in more severe cases, loss of all body hair. The causes of alopecia are various, from endocrine disorders to stress and systemic diseases. In the show, we talk about the causes, symptoms and methods of treatment, as well as why hair loss causes serious stress in many people and how to deal with it. Actor Asim Ugljen will share his experience with alopecia. / U emisiji Dr. Beck govorimo o alopeciji. To je opadanje kose odnosno gubitak dlaka s glave a u težim slučajevima i gubitak svih tjelesnih dlaka. Uzroci alopecije su razni, od endokrinih poremećaja do stresa i sistemskih bolesti. U emisiji govorimo o uzrocima, simptomima i načinima liječenja te o tome zašto gubitak kose kod mnogih izaziva ozbiljan stres i kako se nositi s njim. Svoje iskustvo s alopecijom podijelit će glumac Asim Ugljen.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Tiago is sad as Cacau explains to him that Regina wanted to distance him from Marquinho, thinking that Marco was a better man for her. Júlia tells Quim that she won't feel sorry for Regina if she miscarries, given her behavior towards Cacao. Jaime tries to defend Regina, but the others disagree with him. Anita suggests doing a DNA test and everyone agrees. / Tiago je tužan dok mu Cacau objašnjava da ga je Regina htjela udaljiti od Marquinha, misleći da je Marco bolji muškarac za nju. Júlia kaže Quimu da neće žaliti Reginu ako pobaci, s obzirom na njezino ponašanje prema Cacau. Jaime pokuša obraniti Reginu, ali drugi se ne slažu s njim. Anita predloži da napravi DNK test i svi se slože.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana tells Curro that Leocadia knows he is Dolores' son. Catalina is suspicious of Jacob and tells Martina. Romulo informs the servants that there is no more pay for them. Ricardo firmly tells Santos that he will never reconcile with Ana. Manuel announces that he is leaving. / Jana kaže Curru da Leocadia zna da je on Doloresin sin. Catalina je sumnjičava prema Jacobu i kaže to Martini. Romulo obavijesti poslugu da za njih više nema plaće. Ricardo odlučno kaže Santosu da se nikad neće pomiriti s Anom. Manuel najavi da odlazi.

programme.title: Najljepša europska sela
programme.desc: UNESCO heritage, a unique national park, an unreal combination of steep cliffs, natural terraces and colorful houses _ all this describes Cinque Terre, five lovely Italian villages on the Ligurian coast. Together with Lika policeman Tom, we explore the picturesque Manarola and Riomaggiore to find the culprit behind the import of three million tourists and the export of a billion selfies a year. We examine what it's like to cultivate vineyards that defy gravity and why the houses look like the fruit of a child's playful imagination. Watch on color TV, only on HTV. / Unescova baština, jedinstveni nacionalni park, nestvarni spoj strmih litica, prirodnih terasa i šarenih kućica _ sve to opisuje Cinque Terre, pet ljupkih talijanskih sela na ligurskoj obali. S ličkim policajcem Tomom istražujemo živopisnu Manarolu i Riomaggiore kako bismo pronašli krivca za uvoz tri milijuna turista i izvoz milijardu selfija godišnje. Ispitujemo kako je obrađivati vinograde koji prkose gravitaciji i zašto kuće izgledaju kao plod razigrane dječje mašte. Gledati na kolor televizoru, samo na HTV-u.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Kristijan Iličić's journey through Ethiopia begins in Harar, one of the holy cities of Islam. Harar is known for the coexistence of humans and hyenas, so Kristijan meets a pack of wild hyenas that clean the city at night, feeding on garbage. Visiting Gondar, the former seat of Ethiopian rulers, Kristijan finds himself in a conflict zone between the army and the rebels. Despite the danger of war, he climbs Mount Semien to find gelada monkeys, a unique species of primate that lives only in that location. He briefly visits Lalibella, the holy city of Ethiopian Christians, with the so-called eighth wonder of the world _ in the rock carved Church of St. Jurja. Arriving in the modern metropolis of Addis Ababa, Kristijan explores the past and present of the big city _ he hangs out with the rap star Kassmasse, but also visits the castle of Emperor Menelik, where the Seljan brothers stayed 125 years ago. / Putovanje Etiopijom Kristijan Iličić počinje u Hararu, jednom od svetih gradova islama. Harar je poznat po suživotu ljudi i hijena pa tako i Kristijan susreće čopor divljih hijena koje noću čiste grad hraneći se otpacima. Posjećujući Gondar, bivše sjedište etiopskih vladara, Kristijan se nađe u zoni sukoba vojske i pobunjenika. Unatoč ratnoj opasnosti, penje se na planinu Semien kako bi pronašao majmune gelade, jedinstvenu vrstu primata koja živi samo na toj lokaciji. Nakratko posjeti Lalibellu, sveti grad etiopskih kršćana, s tzv. osmim svjetskim čudom _ u stijenu uklesanom Crkvom sv. Jurja. Dolaskom u modernu metropolu Addis Abebu, Kristijan istražuje prošlost i sadašnjost velikog grada _ druži se s rap zvijezdom Kassmasseom, ali i posjećuje dvorac cara Menelika, u kojem su prije 125 godina boravila braća Seljan.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben came to the rocky cliffs of Cornwall, where Todd and Davina live with their children. They left the city for the countryside without any experience _ driven only by a great desire to become farmers. Ben will learn that it took them five years to convert the three-hectare property into a farm. They will join them in taking care of different animals _ pigs, ducks and more than a hundred chickens. They will feel firsthand what their chaotic daily rhythm looks like. You have to find time for the children, take care of the animals, dig the pond, harvest the vegetables... The good life is not always easy, especially if you are at the mercy of stormy weather conditions on the west coast. But Ben will be most impressed by the personal challenges they face _ financially, physically and mentally. / Ben je došao na kamenite litice Cornwalla, gdje Todd i Davina žive s djecom. Otišli su iz grada na selo bez ikakvog iskustva _ vođeni samo velikom željom da postanu farmeri. Ben će saznati da im je trebalo pet godina kako bi posjed površine tri hektara preuredili u farmu. Pridružit će im se u brizi o različitim životinjama _ svinjama, patkama i više od sto kokoši. Iz prve će ruke osjetiti kako izgleda njihov kaotični dnevni ritam. Treba naći vremena za djecu, brinuti se za životinje, iskopati ribnjak, ubrati povrće... Dobar život nije uvijek lak, pogotovo ako ste na milosti burnih vremenskih uvjeta na zapadnoj obali. Ali Bena će se najviše dojmiti osobni izazovi s kojima se suočavaju _ financijski, fizički i psihički.

The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. programme.title: Who wants to be a millionaire? / Tko želi biti milijunaš?
programme.desc: "Who wants to be a millionaire?" offers a unique opportunity to make your dreams come true _ and win a sum of money that can change everything. Can the contestants hold up under the pressure, with a million reasons to give their best on the world's most successful game show? In Millionaire, general knowledge merges with human nature _ concentration, strategy and mental strength of the individual. Each question raises the stakes, and the boundaries shift from answer to answer. Will he be able to get to the very end and readily say, "That's my final answer!"? / "Tko želi biti milijunaš?" pruža jedinstvenu priliku za ostvarenje snova _ i osvajanje novčanog iznosa koji može promijeniti sve. Mogu li natjecatelji izdržati pod pritiskom, s milijun razloga da daju najbolje od sebe u najuspješnijem svjetskom game showu? U Milijunašu opće znanje stapaju se s ljudskom prirodom _ koncentracijom, strategijom i mentalnom snagom pojedinca. Svako pitanje podiže ulog, a granice se pomiču iz odgovora u odgovor. Hoće li uspjeti doći do samog kraja i spremno reći: "To je moj konačni odgovor!"?

programme.title: Jamie Oliver and dyslexia: In the fight for change / Jamie Oliver i disleksija: U borbi za promjene
programme.desc: Taking part in campaigns is nothing new for Jamie Oliver, but this one is more personal than others. As one of the best-known dyslexics in the UK, Oliver deals with the problems that children with dyslexia face all the time. It is believed that 10 to 15% of people are dyslexic and around 25% are neurodiverse, which means that a quarter of every class is struggling with an education system that is not suited to them. Since science allows us to learn more about different ways of learning, Jamie questions why we expect everyone to fit into the same old model of education and assessment that was devised more than 150 years ago. He brings that struggle to the doorstep of the government. At the start of the campaign, Jamie talks to teachers, charities, parents and children, who want and need Government intervention. Out of a hundred children, at least 10 to 15 of them have dyslexia, but only two are diagnosed at school, which means that at least 80% go through their entire education without a diagnosis. A timely diagnosis can be life-changing because without it, they are more likely to have difficulties with confidence, self-esteem and anxiety that can remain with them for life. As a father of five, Jamie knows that teachers do a great job and that it's not their fault, it's the system. Although a quarter of classes in the UK are neurodiverse, a typical three-year program for new teachers only devotes half a day to children with learning differences, and existing teachers have little opportunity for training unless schools fund it themselves. With increasing awareness of special educational needs and with shrinking budgets, our schools need help and teachers need support to deal with all students equally and get a chance to level the playing field. Jamie is asking his social media followers for help to bring the campaign to the Government and is inundated with heart-wrenching stories from across the UK: children, parents, adults, teachers, all feeling let down and desperate to do more. Something has to change, and urgently. Jamie reveals that there are two key solutions supported by teachers that will make a big difference. Bridget Phillipson, Secretary of State for Education in the United Kingdom, makes his two key demands: 1. Spotting the signs in time. Early assessment, within the first two years of school, is crucial. How can we help children if we don't know that they need support? 2. Support for teachers. Teachers are amazing people and of course they want to help every child, so let's enable them to prepare and be supported to do so. / Za Jamieja Olivera sudjelovanje u kampanjama nije ništa novo, ali ova je osobnija nego druge. Kao jedan od najpoznatijih disleksičara u Velikoj Britaniji, Oliver se bavi problemima s kojima se djeca s disleksijom stalno susreću. Vjeruje se da je 10 do 15% ljudi disleksično, a oko 25% je neuroraznoliko, što znači da se četvrtina svakog razreda bori s obrazovnim sustavom koji im nije prilagođen. Budući da nam znanost omogućuje da saznamo više o različitim načinima učenja, Jamie se pita zašto očekivati da se svi uklope u isti starinski model obrazovanja i ocjenjivanja koji je osmišljen prije više od 150 godina. Tu borbu dovodi Vladi na prag. Na početku kampanje Jamie razgovara s nastavnicima, dobrotvornim organizacijama, roditeljima i djecom, koji žele i trebaju Vladinu intervenciju. Od stotinu djece njih barem 10 do 15 ima disleksiju, ali je samo dvoje dijagnosticirano u školi, što znači da barem 80% prođe cijelo školovanje bez dijagnoze. Pravodobna dijagnoza može promijeniti život jer bez nje je veća vjerojatnost da će imati poteškoće sa samopouzdanjem, samopoštovanjem i tjeskobom koja im može ostati doživotno. Kao otac petero djece Jamie zna da nastavnici sjajno rade svoj posao i da krivi nisu oni, nego sustav. Iako je četvrtina razreda u Velikoj Britaniji neuroraznolika, kod tipičnog trogodišnjeg programa za nove učitelje samo se pola dana posvećuje djeci s razlikama u učenju, a učitelji koji su već u nastavi nemaju mnogo mogućnosti za osposobljavanje osim ako to škole ne financiraju same. S porastom svijesti o posebnim obrazovnim potrebama i sa sve manjim proračunima, našim školama potrebna je pomoć, a nastavnicima potpora kako bi se bavili svim učenicima podjednako i dobili priliku za izjednačenje uvjeta. Jamie traži pomoć od svojih pratitelja na društvenim mrežama kako bi kampanju doveo pred Vladu i preplavljen je bolnim pričama iz cijelog Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva: djeca, roditelji, odrasli, nastavnici, svi su iznevjereni i silno žele učiniti više. Nešto se mora promijeniti, i to hitno. Jamie otkriva da postoje dva ključna rješenja koja podržavaju i nastavnici, a koja će donijeti veliku promjenu. Svoja dva ključna zahtjeva upućuje Bridget Phillipson, državnoj tajnici za obrazovanje u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu: 1. Pravodobno primjećivanje znakova. Presudna je rana procjena, unutar prve dvije godine škole. Kako pomoći djeci ako ne znamo da im treba potpora? 2. Potpora nastavnicima. Nastavnici su nevjerojatni ljudi i naravno da žele pomoći svakom djetetu, stoga im omogućimo da se pripreme i dobiju potporu za to.

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: HTV's central political talk show in which the political topic of the day is analyzed every evening from Monday to Thursday with relevant guests from opposing viewpoints. / Središnji politički talk show HTV-a u kojem se svake večeri od ponedjeljka do četvrtka uz relevantne goste suprotstavljenih stajališta analizira politička tema dana.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Životi svetaca s Martinom Scorsesejem
programme.desc: John the Baptist was born as the son of a Levite, a member of the priestly class, but he abandoned his father's tradition and then announced the coming of the Messiah, baptizing his followers. / Ivan Krstitelj rođen je kao sin levita, pripadnika svećeničkog staleža, ali napušta očevu tradiciju, a zatim naviješta dolazak Mesije, krsteći sljedbenike.

programme.title: Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Agatha's tour of the Empire in 1922 takes Sir David Suchet to New Zealand where he will explore woolen mills and gold mines, and the Maori will lead him to geothermal springs. Sir David will find out how the trip made Agatha more independent and why his beloved Poirot hates the sea. / Agathina turneja po Carstvu 1922. godine vodi sir Davida Sucheta na Novi Zeland gdje će istražiti tvornice vune i rudnike zlata, a Maori će ga odvesti do geotermalnih izvora. Sir David će saznati kako je putovanje potaknulo Agathu da postane neovisnija i zašto njegov dragi Poirot mrzi more.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana tells Curro that Leocadia knows he is Dolores' son. Catalina is suspicious of Jacob and tells Martina. Romulo informs the servants that there is no more pay for them. Ricardo firmly tells Santos that he will never reconcile with Ana. Manuel announces that he is leaving. / Jana kaže Curru da Leocadia zna da je on Doloresin sin. Catalina je sumnjičava prema Jacobu i kaže to Martini. Romulo obavijesti poslugu da za njih više nema plaće. Ricardo odlučno kaže Santosu da se nikad neće pomiriti s Anom. Manuel najavi da odlazi.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Onofre tells the village that Olivia likes the priest Tenorio. Isadora sees Olívia kissing Rafael and goes crazy with jealousy. Olívia asks Rafael to pretend to be wooing her to help her get rid of the rumors about Reverend Tenorio. Rafael agrees because he knows it affects Isadora. Leônidas manages to get Matias out of the sanatorium and brings him back to the estate. Violeta is sad about Matias' situation. She is supported by Eugenio who ruins the romantic dinner that Úrsula is preparing for him. Olívia and Onofre have disagreements within the factory. Olívia is changing shifts. Isadora cannot hide Rafael's jealousy. Rafael disguises himself, goes to the club and steals Joaquim's car. Julinha was fired from the LBA. Violeta questions Rafael about their relationship and he confesses to her that he loves Isadora. / Onofre govori po selu da se Oliviji sviđa svećenik Tenorio. Isadora vidi kako Olívia ljubi Rafaela i poludi od ljubomore. Olívia zamoli Rafaela da odglumi da joj se udvara kako bi joj pomogao da se riješi glasina o velečasnom Tenoriju. Rafael pristaje jer zna da to utječe na Isadoru. Leônidas uspije odvesti Matiasa iz sanatorija i vraća ga na imanje. Violeta je tužna zbog Matiasove situacije. Podupire ju Eugenio koji uništi romantičnu večeru koju Úrsula priprema za njega. Olívia i Onofre imaju nesuglasice unutar tvornice. Olívia mijenja smjenu. Isadora ne može sakriti Rafaelovu ljubomoru. Rafael se maskira, ode u klub i ukrade Joaquimov auto. Julinha je otpuštena iz LBA. Violeta ispituje Rafaela o njihovoj vezi i on joj prizna da voli Isadoru.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Tiago is sad as Cacau explains to him that Regina wanted to distance him from Marquinho, thinking that Marco was a better man for her. Júlia tells Quim that she won't feel sorry for Regina if she miscarries, given her behavior towards Cacao. Jaime tries to defend Regina, but the others disagree with him. Anita suggests doing a DNA test and everyone agrees. / Tiago je tužan dok mu Cacau objašnjava da ga je Regina htjela udaljiti od Marquinha, misleći da je Marco bolji muškarac za nju. Júlia kaže Quimu da neće žaliti Reginu ako pobaci, s obzirom na njezino ponašanje prema Cacau. Jaime pokuša obraniti Reginu, ali drugi se ne slažu s njim. Anita predloži da napravi DNK test i svi se slože.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Parkways are made for walks, and walks are made for conversations, closeness, togetherness in discovering blooming magnolias, leaves carried by the wind, changing seasons, nature that seems to want to escape from the cities, and they, on the contrary, try to keep it, place it among the houses, preserve it somewhere in sight. Therefore, gardens are arranged. There are several of them in the center of Zagreb, so in this walk, which is also suitable for those who are not inclined to long walks, we will visit some that are particularly dear to us and some that we wanted to see again after a long time. / Perivoji su stvoreni za šetnje, a šetnje su stvorene za razgovore, bliskost, zajedništvo u otkrivanju procvjetale magnolije, lista nošena vjetrom, mijene godišnjih doba, prirode koja kao da želi pobjeći iz gradova, a oni je, naprotiv, pokušavaju zadržati, smjestiti među kuće, sačuvati negdje u vidokrugu. Stoga, uređuju se perivoji. U užem središtu Zagreba smjestilo ih se nekoliko pa ćemo i mi, u ovoj šetnji prikladnoj i za one nesklone dugom pješačenju, obići neke koji su nam osobito dragi i neke koje smo nakon mnogo vremena poželjeli ponovno vidjeti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the show Dr. Beck we are talking about alopecia. This is hair loss, i.e. loss of hair from the head, and in more severe cases, loss of all body hair. The causes of alopecia are various, from endocrine disorders to stress and systemic diseases. In the show, we talk about the causes, symptoms and methods of treatment, as well as why hair loss causes serious stress in many people and how to deal with it. Actor Asim Ugljen will share his experience with alopecia. / U emisiji Dr. Beck govorimo o alopeciji. To je opadanje kose odnosno gubitak dlaka s glave a u težim slučajevima i gubitak svih tjelesnih dlaka. Uzroci alopecije su razni, od endokrinih poremećaja do stresa i sistemskih bolesti. U emisiji govorimo o uzrocima, simptomima i načinima liječenja te o tome zašto gubitak kose kod mnogih izaziva ozbiljan stres i kako se nositi s njim. Svoje iskustvo s alopecijom podijelit će glumac Asim Ugljen.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia wants everyone to enjoy cooking. Her Spicy Pork Chops with Broccoli are baked together so dinner is ready in no time. Lidia will teach grandson Miles that he can prepare a simple weekday meal from leftover soup. Dessert will be crescents filled with apricot jam, which are a favorite of the Bastianich household. In this sequel, discover the joy of preparing dinner. / Lidia želi da svi uživaju u kuhanju. Njezini pikantni svinjski kotleti s brokulom zajedno se ispeku pa večera bude začas gotova. Lidia će naučiti unuka Milesa da od ostatka juhe može pripremiti jednostavno jelo na radni dan. Desert će biti polumjeseci nadjeveni pekmezom od marelica, koji su omiljeni u kućanstvu Bastianich. U ovom nastavku otkrijte užitak pripreme večere.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: In this sequel, Lidia will prepare food that she likes to share with others. First we will see the pork guazzetto with beans. Rustic ribs stewed with white beans are a complete meal. And if you want a quick and impressive dish for a hungry crowd, Lidia's brudet of mixed fish alla Matalotta is ideal for you. Lidia will prepare enough food for everyone today. / U ovom će nastavku Lidia pripremati hranu koju voli dijeliti s drugima. Najprije ćemo vidjeti guazzetto od svinjetine s grahom. Rustikalna rebarca pirjana s bijelim grahom cjelovit su obrok. A ako želite brzinsko, a dojmljivo jelo za gladnu gomilu, za vas je idealan Lidijin brudet od miješane ribe alla Matalotta. Lidia će danas pripremati dovoljno hrane za sve.

programme.title: Normalan život
programme.desc: After the show dedicated to World Mental Health Day and suicide prevention, especially among adolescents, we continue with the topic "Social work and mental health", which was also the central topic of the 14th conference of social workers, recently held in Vodice. The guests of the show are: Štefica Karačić, B.Sc. soc. worker, president of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and member of the Board of Directors of the Croatian Chamber of Social Workers, Ph.D. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, B.Sc. soc. worker, member of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and the Association's Ethics Committee, advocate and initiator of the Zagreb Strategy for Equalizing Opportunities for People with Disabilities. Guests will speak about prevention and protection of mental health, especially in at-risk and vulnerable groups. As many as 20% of people with disabilities have impaired mental health _ guests will testify about invisible barriers, stigmatization and social exclusion of the poor, elderly and infirm and people with intellectual disabilities. They will especially emphasize the role of social support in improving mental health, especially in the process of mourning, and the importance of interdisciplinary cooperation between institutions. In the context of the digital age, we will also discuss the need to reduce administrative barriers, in order to help people in need in a timely and efficient manner. / Nakon emisije posvećene Svjetskom danu mentalnog zdravlja i prevenciji suicida, osobito među adolescentima, nastavljamo s temom "Socijalni rad i mentalno zdravlje", koja je ujedno bila središnja tema 14. konferencije socijalnih radnika, nedavno održane u Vodicama. Gošće emisije su: Štefica Karačić, dipl. soc. radnica, predsjednica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i članica Upravnog odbora Hrvatske komore socijalnih radnika dr. sc. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, dipl. soc. radnica, članica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i Etičkog povjerenstva Udruge, zagovarateljica i pokretačica Zagrebačke strategije izjednačavanja mogućnosti za osobe s invaliditetom Gošće će govoriti o prevenciji i zaštiti mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u rizičnih i ranjivih skupina. Čak 20 % osoba s invaliditetom ima narušeno mentalno zdravlje _ gošće će svjedočiti o nevidljivim barijerama, stigmatizaciji i socijalnoj isključenosti siromašnih, starijih i nemoćnih osoba te osoba s intelektualnim teškoćama.Posebno će istaknuti ulogu socijalne podrške u poboljšanju mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u procesu žalovanja, te značaj interdisciplinarne suradnje među institucijama. U kontekstu digitalnog doba, razgovarat ćemo i o potrebi smanjenja administrativnih barijera, kako bi se pravovremeno i učinkovito pomoglo osobama u potrebi.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Lalá hides that it bothers her that Simone wants to use Valdemar to protect herself from legal problems. Salomao suggests that they press charges against Marco and Regina for Marquinho's kidnapping, but Cacau does not want to make such a move against his mother. Majoris tells Sal that she never witnessed anything inappropriate between Simone and Rui. / Lalá skriva da joj smeta što Simone želi iskoristiti Valdemara kako bi zaštitila sebe od pravnih problema. Salomao predlaže da podignu tužbu protiv Marca i Regine zbog Marquinhove otmice, ali Cacau ne želi povući takav potez protiv majke. Majoris kaže Sal da nikad nije svjedočila ničem neprimjerenom između Simone i Ruija.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: The announcement of Manuel's and Jana's departure rang out like a bombshell. Marquisa explodes and causes an unprecedented quarrel with Alonso. Martina does not trust Jacob and questions him. Santos types to Romulo that Pía killed Baron De Linaja. Cast: Ana Garces (Jana), Eva Martín (Cruz), Manuel Regueiro (Alonso), Carmen Asecas (Catalina), Arturo Sancho (Manuel) Screenplay: Josep Cister Rubio, Susana Prieto, Carmen Llano, Alberto Grondona, Álvaro Bermúdez de Castro, Juanma Ruiz, Benjamín Zafra, Felix J. Velando, Moises Gomez, Miguel Bueno, Rafael Gallego, Ruth García Director: Miguel Conde, Javier Pulido, Eva Bermúdez, Alberto Pernet Selected by: Martina Rajšek / Najava Manuelova i Janina odlaska odjekne kao bomba. Markiza eksplodira i izazove dosad neviđenu svađu s Alonsom. Martina ne vjeruje Jacobu i ispituje ga. Santos otkuca Romulu da je Pía ubila baruna De Linaju. Velando, Moises Gomez, Miguel Bueno, Rafael Gallego, Ruth García Režija: Miguel Conde, Javier Pulido, Eva Bermúdez, Alberto Pernet Odabrala: Martina Rajšek

programme.title: Put rijeka
programme.desc: The Zrmanja River is one of the most beautiful, but also one of the wildest rivers in Croatia. In places of its course, it is extremely fast and full of smaller and larger waterfalls. The nature and canyons that surround it leave an impression of its magnificent strength. In addition to the usual tourist attractions, rafting has also been designed, an adrenaline adventure that gives the river additional richness. The abundance of flora and fauna and travertine waterfalls have now given man a new, enriched meaning. / Rijeka Zrmanja je jedna od najljepših, ali i jedna od najdivljijih rijeka u Hrvatskoj. Na mjestima njezina toka izrazito je brza i puna manjih i većih slapova. Priroda i kanjoni koji je okružuju ostavljaju dojam njezine veličanstvene snage. Uz uobičajene turističke atrakcije, osmišljen je i rafting, adrenalinska avantura koja rijeci daje dodatno bogatstvo. Obilje flore i faune i sedreni slapovi sada su čovjeku dali novo, obogaćeno značenje.

programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: In the city on four rivers, he found his way of life. Born in Karlovac with Czech roots, Dinko Neskusil observes the world through the lens of a camera. He took his first steps with his father, appearing in Karlovac weeklies, but also on the front line, documenting the devastating attacks on the city. His war photographs make up most of the display of the Museum of the Homeland War in Turnje. "It didn't happen again," says Dinko, who still takes photographs with the same passion today. He knows very well that a picture is worth a thousand words. Sound master: Boris Harmić Lighting master: Darko Višek / U gradu na četiri rijeke pronašao je svoj životni tok. Rođeni Karlovčanin čeških korijena, Dinko Neskusil, svijet promatra kroz objektiv fotoaparata. Prve je korake napravio uz oca, stasao u karlovačkim tjednicima, ali i na prvoj liniji fronte, dokumentirajući razorne napade na grad. Njegove ratne fotografije čine većinu postava Muzeja Domovinskog rata na Turnju. "Ne ponovilo se", kaže Dinko, koji i danas fotografira s jednakom strašću. Dobro zna da slika govori više od tisuću riječi. Ton-majstor: Boris Harmić Majstor rasvjete: Darko Višek

programme.title: turizam.hrt
programme.desc: In the weekly show about tourism, we follow, question and analyze tourist current affairs on the coast, islands and inland. / U tjednoj emisiji o turizmu pratimo, propitkujemo i analiziramo turističke aktualnosti na obali, otocima i u unutrašnjosti.

programme.title: Flowers by Saša Šekoranja / Cvijeće Saše Šekoranje
programme.desc: Our famous artist and arranger Saša Šekoranja shows us how we can create our own flower magic at home. / Naš poznati umjetnik i aranžer Saša Šekoranja pokazuje nam kako kod kuće možemo napraviti vlastitu cvjetnu čaroliju.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben travels to the Shetland Islands, one of the most isolated spots in Britain. He will visit Helen and Jason, a couple who have been living on the island of Yell for several years. They will discover why they gave up life in the city and see what obstacles they face as they realize their dream of living on this beautiful island far from civilization. Ben's hosts devote a lot of time to the physically demanding renovation of the house, and at the same time cultivate 10 hectares of land. They admit that sometimes they have too much work. Ben will shear sheep, lay water pipes, weave woolen rugs and extract peat with them. / Ben putuje na Shetlandsko otočje, jednu od najizoliranijih točaka Britanije. Posjetit će Helen i Jasona, par koji već nekoliko godina živi na otoku Yellu. Otkrit će zašto su odustali od života u gradu i vidjeti s kakvim se preprekama suočavaju dok ostvaruju san o životu na ovom lijepom otoku daleko od civilizacije. Benovi domaćini mnogo vremena posvećuju fizički zahtjevnoj obnovi kuće, a usto obrađuju i 10 hektara zemlje. Priznaju da katkad imaju previše posla. Ben će s njima šišati ovce, polagati vodovodne cijevi, tkati vunene sagove i vaditi treset.

No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend / Geronimo: Američka legenda
programme.desc: A western about the Indian Geronimo who, at the head of his Apache tribe, opposed the American army. At the end of the 19th century, the Apaches are still the only free-roaming Indian tribe, but the US government wants to move them to a reservation. The legendary warrior Geronimo (W. Studi) refused to submit when they tried to arrest him. For the next five years, the US military tried to capture a man who wanted to preserve the freedom of his people at all costs... / Vestern o Indijancu Geronimu koji se na čelu svog apaškog plemena suprotstavio američkoj vojsci. Krajem 19. stoljeća Apaši su još jedino indijansko pleme koje slobodno luta, ali američka vlada ih želi preseliti u rezervat. Legendarni ratnik Geronimo (W. Studi) odbio se pokoriti na što su ga pokušali uhititi. Sljedećih pet godina američka vojska pokušavala je uhvatiti čovjeka koji je po svaku cijenu želio očuvati slobodu svog naroda...

programme.desc: Joaquim claims that Rafael and Olívia's relationship is fake. Bento writes home and tells about himself and Lorenzo's adventures. Lorenzo meets Silvana, who charms him. Fátima wants to help keep the farce of Olivia's relationship going, so she suggests the couple make feijoada for the whole village. Olivia can't stand Isadora grieving over Rafael and tells her the truth about the farce. Eugenio holds an emergency meeting to discuss the loss of an important client. Rafael proposes a competition to save the factory. This infuriates Joaquim. Isadora admits to Violeta that she is afraid of her love for Rafael. Isadora decides to participate in competitions at Rafael's request. Joaquim apologizes to Isadora and offers to present the prize to the winner. / Joaquim tvrdi da je Rafaelova i Olívijna veza lažna. Bento piše kući i pripovijeda o sebi i Lorenzovim pustolovinama. Lorenzo upozna Silvanu koja ga očara. Fátima želi pomoći da se održi farsa o Olivijinoj vezi, pa predlaže paru da naprave feijoadu za cijelo selo. Olivia ne može podnijeti da Isadora tuguje zbog Rafaela i kaže joj istinu o farsi. Eugenio održi hitan sastanak kako bi razgovarali o gubitku važnog klijenta. Rafael predlaže natjecanje kojim bi spasili tvornicu. Joaquima to razbjesni. Isadora priznaje Violeti da se boji svoje ljubavi prema Rafaelu. Isadora odluči sudjelovati u natjecaje na Rafaelov zahtjev. Joaquim se ispriča Isadori i ponudi se da pobjednici uruči nagradu.

programme.title: Normalan život
programme.desc: After the show dedicated to World Mental Health Day and suicide prevention, especially among adolescents, we continue with the topic "Social work and mental health", which was also the central topic of the 14th conference of social workers, recently held in Vodice. The guests of the show are: Štefica Karačić, B.Sc. soc. worker, president of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and member of the Board of Directors of the Croatian Chamber of Social Workers, Ph.D. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, B.Sc. soc. worker, member of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and the Association's Ethics Committee, advocate and initiator of the Zagreb Strategy for Equalizing Opportunities for People with Disabilities. Guests will speak about prevention and protection of mental health, especially in at-risk and vulnerable groups. As many as 20% of people with disabilities have impaired mental health _ guests will testify about invisible barriers, stigmatization and social exclusion of the poor, elderly and infirm and people with intellectual disabilities. They will especially emphasize the role of social support in improving mental health, especially in the process of mourning, and the importance of interdisciplinary cooperation between institutions. In the context of the digital age, we will also discuss the need to reduce administrative barriers, in order to help people in need in a timely and efficient manner. / Nakon emisije posvećene Svjetskom danu mentalnog zdravlja i prevenciji suicida, osobito među adolescentima, nastavljamo s temom "Socijalni rad i mentalno zdravlje", koja je ujedno bila središnja tema 14. konferencije socijalnih radnika, nedavno održane u Vodicama. Gošće emisije su: Štefica Karačić, dipl. soc. radnica, predsjednica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i članica Upravnog odbora Hrvatske komore socijalnih radnika dr. sc. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, dipl. soc. radnica, članica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i Etičkog povjerenstva Udruge, zagovarateljica i pokretačica Zagrebačke strategije izjednačavanja mogućnosti za osobe s invaliditetom Gošće će govoriti o prevenciji i zaštiti mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u rizičnih i ranjivih skupina. Čak 20 % osoba s invaliditetom ima narušeno mentalno zdravlje _ gošće će svjedočiti o nevidljivim barijerama, stigmatizaciji i socijalnoj isključenosti siromašnih, starijih i nemoćnih osoba te osoba s intelektualnim teškoćama.Posebno će istaknuti ulogu socijalne podrške u poboljšanju mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u procesu žalovanja, te značaj interdisciplinarne suradnje među institucijama. U kontekstu digitalnog doba, razgovarat ćemo i o potrebi smanjenja administrativnih barijera, kako bi se pravovremeno i učinkovito pomoglo osobama u potrebi.

Lidia će danas pripremati dovoljno hrane za sve.
