programme.title: The forgotten battle of Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: In the fall of 1991, Croatia was fighting a battle for survival. At the very beginning of November, the Slavonian village of Nuštar found itself in an almost hopeless situation as the only unconquered stronghold between the city on the Danube and the city on Bosut. And while the ring around Vukovar tightens more and more, and the enemy, occupying village after village, is getting closer to Vinkovci and the column of exiles is getting longer, it is uncertain how long the few and poorly armed defenders will be able to resist the aggressor. In those days, Nuštar lived through his most dramatic moments in history, and this is the story of a three-day forgotten battle, of despair and hope, of miraculous heroism and the victory of the heart over the armor. Nuštar had no choice, defeat would have written a different history. Animation: Mato Granić / U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić

programme.title: Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: This documentary series reveals another side of our favorite four-legged friends. Through four exciting episodes, we dive deeper into the world of working dogs, exploring their jobs, but also their leisure time. By following their daily lives, we discover not only how they contribute to our society, but also listen to their thoughts about it through imaginative interpretations. ------ In the first episode, we will dive deeper into the world of Istrian truffles, but literally! Following Bubica, a curly-haired lagotti from Paladin, and her owner Ivana, we will find out the role of sniffing friends in finding this valuable food and what is hidden in the depths of the Istrian forests. Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of gourmet delights and incredible adventures with our four-legged truffle. / Ova dokumentarna serija otkriva nam drugu stranu naših omiljenih četveronožnih prijatelja. Kroz četiri uzbudljive epizode zaranjamo dublje u svijet radnih pasa, istražujući njihove poslove, ali i dokolicu. Prateći njihov svakodnevni život, otkrivamo ne samo kako oni doprinose našem društvu, već i kroz maštovite interpretacije slušamo njihova razmišljanja o tome. ------ U prvoj epizodi zaronit ćemo dublje u svijet istarskih tartufa, ali doslovno! Prateći Bubicu, kovrčavu lagotticu iz Paladina, i njezinu vlasnicu Ivanu, doznat ćemo koja je uloga njuškajućih prijatelja u pronalasku ove vrijedne namirnice i što se to krije u dubinama istarskih šuma. Pripremite se za uzbudljivo putovanje kroz svijet gurmanskih užitaka i nevjerojatnih pustolovina s našom četveronožnom tartufarkom.

programme.title: And she was / I bila je
programme.desc: Byrdie is a prolific screenwriter in her fifties. The problem is that none of the producers want to work with her. Even though she's just completed what is probably the best screenplay of her life, her agent isn't returning her calls, and none of the filmmakers want to read it. So he comes up with a plan to get revenge on them. Looking to revive her career, Byrdie enlists the help of her charming and attractive twentysomething nephew, a former used car salesman, Neil. Just like Cyrano de Bergerac, Byrdie writes screenplays and Neil pitches them to studios as his own. Thanks to Byrdie's giftedness and Neil's youthful charm, the duo achieve great success. Neil soon becomes one of the most sought after Hollywood screenwriters. While visiting the studios, he meets Andrea, the head of acquisitions and the only devotee of Byrdie's work, and falls in love with her. Byrdie and Neil feel guilty about lying to Andrea, but they're in too deep to back out now. Things get even more complicated when Byrdie's family, unaware of their prank, deduces that Byrdie has a drinking problem and organizes an intervention. Despite her fierce opposition, Byrdie is sent to rehab and unable to deliver the script to Neil. Neil tries to write on his own, but soon realizes that writing a screenplay is much more difficult than going to meetings. Does the 50-year-old have a chance to succeed in the ruthless world of Hollywood? And will the truth destroy her nephew's relationship? / Byrdie je plodna scenaristica na pragu pedesete. Problem je što nitko od producenata ne želi raditi s njom. Iako je upravo dovršila vjerojatno najbolji scenarij u svom životu, njezin joj agent ne uzvraća pozive, a nitko ga od filmaša ne želi pročitati. Stoga smisli plan kako da im se osveti. U želji da oživi svoju karijeru, Byrdie potraži pomoć svog šarmantnog i privlačnog dvadeset-i-nešto-godišnjeg nećaka, bivšeg prodavača rabljenih automobila, Neila. Baš poput Cyrana de Bergeraca, Byrdie piše scenarije, a Neil ih studijima nudi kao svoje. Zahvaljujući Byrdienoj darovitosti i Neilovom mladenačkom šarmu, dvojac postiže velik uspjeh. Neil ubrzo postaje jedan od najtraženijih holivudskih scenarista. Obilazeći studije upoznaje Andreu, voditeljicu akvizicija i jedinu poklonicu Byrdienog rada, te se zaljubljuje u nju. Byrdie i Neil imaju grižnju savjesti što lažu Andrei, no preduboko su se uvalili da bi se sad povukli. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad Byrdiena obitelj, koja ne zna za njihovu podvalu, zaključi da Byrdie ima problema s alkoholom i organizira intervenciju. Unatoč njezinu žestokom protivljenju, Byrdie pošalju na odvikavanje pa ne može Neilu dostaviti scenarij. Neil pokuša sam pisati, no ubrzo shvaća da je pisanje scenarija daleko teže od hodanja po sastancima. Ima li 50-godišnjakinja šanse uspjeti u nemilosrdnom svijetu Hollywooda? I hoće li istina uništiti vezu njezina nećaka?

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.title: Regionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: Zovite babicu
programme.desc: This time, Jenny is not facing the beginning, but the end of her life. Frank, the brother of the cleaner Peggy of Nonnatus House, has cancer, and the sisters take care of him. Jenny thus gets to know better their difficult past and the relationship that was shaped by the childhood spent in the poorhouse. At the same time, the other residents of the house help Fred in his (somewhat unusual) business idea _ raising Evie the piglet. But the bacon-earning plan changes when Evie is left unborn. With that, the police find Sister Monica Joan wandering around the docks and bring her back to Nonnatus House. After recovering from pneumonia, she returns to her duties _ until she is accused of stealing... / Jenny se ovoga puta ne susreće s početkom, već s krajem života. Frank, brat čistačice Peggy iz Nonnatus Housea, obolio je od raka, a sestre se brinu o njemu. Jenny tako bolje upoznaje njihovu tešku prošlost i odnos koji je oblikovalo djetinjstvo provedeno u ubožnici. Paralelno, ostale stanovnice kuće pomažu Fredu u njegovoj (pomalo nesvakidašnjoj) poslovnoj ideji _ uzgoju prasice Evie. No plan o zaradi od slanine mijenja se kad Evie ostane skotna. Uz to policija pronalazi sestru Monicu Joan kako luta po dokovima i vraća je u Nonnatus House. Nakon oporavka od upale pluća, vraća se svojim obavezama _ sve dok je ne optuže za krađu...

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: Djevojka iz Jerseyja
programme.desc: Ollie Trinkie (B. Affleck) is a successful music producer who has married the love of his life. However, his wife suddenly dies in childbirth. A terrible tragedy, a terrible shock and the beginning of a completely new lifestyle, with new problems that this New York businessman did not count on. Alone with a newborn baby girl, he decides to return to his native New Jersey, to the house where his father lives. Ollie has resigned himself to the fact that he will never again meet a person with whom he could have a romantic relationship. But that doesn't mean there aren't hot girls in the neighborhood... / Ollie Trinkie (B. Affleck) uspješan je glazbeni producent koji je oženio ljubav svog života. Međutim, supruga mu iznenada umre na porodu. Strašna tragedija, strašan šok i početak potpuno novog stila života, s novim problemima na koje ovaj njujorški biznismen nije računao. Sam s tek rođenom djevojčicom, on odluči vratiti se u rodni New Jersey, u kuću u kojoj živi njegov otac. Ollie se pomirio s činjenicom da nikada više neće upoznati osobu s kojom bi mogao ostvariti ljubavnu vezu. No, to ne znači da u susjedstvu nema zgodnih djevojaka...

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Surovo spasenje
programme.desc: Thriller. After losing his fiancee to a heroin overdose, a rehabilitated addict seeks revenge against the drug cartel while hot on his heels is a sympathetic sheriff... / Triler. Nakon što je izgubio zaručnicu koja se predozirala heroinom, rehabilitirani ovisnik traži osvetu nad kartelom odgovornim za opskrbu drogom dok mu je za petama suosjećajni šerif...

programme.title: Legenda o konkubini
programme.desc: Fantastic. During the Tang Dynasty, a demonic cat appears in the city of Changan, causing confusion and triggering a series of unusual events. The poet Bai Letian and the monk Kûkai team up to investigate the death of Emperor Yang's concubine following the trail left by a cat... The film is based on the novel "Śramaṇa Kūkai" by the Japanese writer Yoneyama Mine, known under the pseudonym Baku Yumemakura. / Fantastika. U doba dinastije Tang u gradu Changanu pojavljuje se demonska mačka koja unosi pomutnju i pokreće niz neobičnih događaja. Pjesnik Bai Letian i redovnik Kûkai udružuju se kako bi istražili smrt careve konkubine Yang prateći trag koji je ostavila mačka... Film je snimljen prema romanu "Śramaṇa Kūkai" japanskog pisca Yoneyame Minea, poznatog pod pseudonimom Baku Yumemakura.

programme.title: And she was / I bila je
programme.desc: Byrdie is a prolific screenwriter in her fifties. The problem is that none of the producers want to work with her. Even though she's just completed what is probably the best screenplay of her life, her agent isn't returning her calls, and none of the filmmakers want to read it. So he comes up with a plan to get revenge on them. Looking to revive her career, Byrdie enlists the help of her charming and attractive twentysomething nephew, a former used car salesman, Neil. Just like Cyrano de Bergerac, Byrdie writes screenplays and Neil pitches them to studios as his own. Thanks to Byrdie's giftedness and Neil's youthful charm, the duo achieve great success. Neil soon becomes one of the most sought after Hollywood screenwriters. While visiting the studios, he meets Andrea, the head of acquisitions and the only devotee of Byrdie's work, and falls in love with her. Byrdie and Neil feel guilty about lying to Andrea, but they're in too deep to back out now. Things get even more complicated when Byrdie's family, unaware of their prank, deduces that Byrdie has a drinking problem and organizes an intervention. Despite her fierce opposition, Byrdie is sent to rehab and unable to deliver the script to Neil. Neil tries to write on his own, but soon realizes that writing a screenplay is much more difficult than going to meetings. Does the 50-year-old have a chance to succeed in the ruthless world of Hollywood? And will the truth destroy her nephew's relationship? / Byrdie je plodna scenaristica na pragu pedesete. Problem je što nitko od producenata ne želi raditi s njom. Iako je upravo dovršila vjerojatno najbolji scenarij u svom životu, njezin joj agent ne uzvraća pozive, a nitko ga od filmaša ne želi pročitati. Stoga smisli plan kako da im se osveti. U želji da oživi svoju karijeru, Byrdie potraži pomoć svog šarmantnog i privlačnog dvadeset-i-nešto-godišnjeg nećaka, bivšeg prodavača rabljenih automobila, Neila. Baš poput Cyrana de Bergeraca, Byrdie piše scenarije, a Neil ih studijima nudi kao svoje. Zahvaljujući Byrdienoj darovitosti i Neilovom mladenačkom šarmu, dvojac postiže velik uspjeh. Neil ubrzo postaje jedan od najtraženijih holivudskih scenarista. Obilazeći studije upoznaje Andreu, voditeljicu akvizicija i jedinu poklonicu Byrdienog rada, te se zaljubljuje u nju. Byrdie i Neil imaju grižnju savjesti što lažu Andrei, no preduboko su se uvalili da bi se sad povukli. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad Byrdiena obitelj, koja ne zna za njihovu podvalu, zaključi da Byrdie ima problema s alkoholom i organizira intervenciju. Unatoč njezinu žestokom protivljenju, Byrdie pošalju na odvikavanje pa ne može Neilu dostaviti scenarij. Neil pokuša sam pisati, no ubrzo shvaća da je pisanje scenarija daleko teže od hodanja po sastancima. Ima li 50-godišnjakinja šanse uspjeti u nemilosrdnom svijetu Hollywooda? I hoće li istina uništiti vezu njezina nećaka?

programme.title: Veterani mira
programme.desc: The weekly show, in studio conversations and reports, illuminates and tries to solve the problems faced by veterans and sensitize the public. / Tjedna emisija, u razgovoru u studiju i reportažama rasvjetljava i nastoji riješiti probleme s kojima se susreću branitelji te senzibilizirati javnost.

programme.title: The forgotten battle of Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: In the fall of 1991, Croatia was fighting a battle for survival. At the very beginning of November, the Slavonian village of Nuštar found itself in an almost hopeless situation as the only unconquered stronghold between the city on the Danube and the city on Bosut. And while the ring around Vukovar tightens more and more, and the enemy, occupying village after village, is getting closer to Vinkovci and the column of exiles is getting longer, it is uncertain how long the few and poorly armed defenders will be able to resist the aggressor. In those days, Nuštar lived through his most dramatic moments in history, and this is the story of a three-day forgotten battle, of despair and hope, of miraculous heroism and the victory of the heart over the armor. Nuštar had no choice, defeat would have written a different history. Animation: Mato Granić / U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

With that, the police find Sister Monica Joan wandering around the docks and bring her back to Nonnatus House. After recovering from pneumonia, she returns to her duties _ until she is accused of stealing... Jenny tako bolje upoznaje njihovu tešku prošlost i odnos koji je oblikovalo djetinjstvo provedeno u ubožnici. Paralelno, ostale stanovnice kuće pomažu Fredu u njegovoj (pomalo nesvakidašnjoj) poslovnoj ideji _ uzgoju prasice Evie. No plan o zaradi od slanine mijenja se kad Evie ostane skotna. Uz to policija pronalazi sestru Monicu Joan kako luta po dokovima i vraća je u Nonnatus House. Nakon oporavka od upale pluća, vraća se svojim obavezama _ sve dok je ne optuže za krađu... Prema memoarima: Jennifer Worth

programme.title: Ljubav poslijepodne
programme.desc: Ariane Chavasse (A. Hepburn) is the daughter of a private investigator working on the case of Mr. X (J. McGiven) whose wife is in a secret love affair with a handsome rich man, American Frank Flannagan (G. Cooper). Ariane eavesdrops on her father's conversation and hears Mr. X threatening to kill Flannagan, so she rushes to the hotel and saves him from the wrath of her jealous husband. After that, she arouses the interest of a charming rich man who tries to win a mysterious girl by all means... / Ariane Chavasse (A. Hepburn) kći je privatnog istražitelja koji radi na slučaju gospodina X-a (J. McGiven) čija je žena u tajnoj ljubavnoj vezi sa zgodnim bogatašem, Amerikancem Frankom Flannaganom (G. Cooper). Ariane prisluškuje očev razgovor i načuje gospodina X-a kako prijeti da će ubiti Flannagana, te hita u hotel i spašava ga od bijesa ljubomornog muža. Nakon toga i sama pobuđuje zanimanje šarmantnog bogataša koji na sve načine nastoji osvojiti tajanstvenu djevojku...

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: A weekly show that highlights positive events and examples in society in reports from the field. / Tjedna emisija koja u reportažama s terena ističe pozitivne događaje i primjere u društvu.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: During October, as part of the 60th Zagreb Salon of Fine Arts, the television airwaves become a place of artistic intervention. Multidisciplinary artist Karlo Štefanek randomly interrupts the program with the performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu, playing with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment. The work is part of his series Self-titled (2022—), in which he explores the instability of identity and questions the concepts of authorship and authenticity, using the body and (self) portrait as a space of discovery and resistance. In today's Art, we talk to Karl Štefanek about this project and his wider artistic practice, and then look back at the history of television performance. / Tijekom listopada, u sklopu 60. zagrebačkog salona likovnih umjetnosti, televizijski eter postaje mjesto umjetničke intervencije.Multidisciplinarni umjetnik Karlo Štefanek nasumično prekida program performansom AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu, poigravajući se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju. Rad je dio njegove serije Self-titled (2022—), u kojoj istražuje nestabilnost identiteta te propituje koncepte autorstva i autentičnosti, koristeći tijelo i (auto)portret kao prostor otkrivanja i otpora.U današnjem Artu razgovaramo s Karlom Štefanekom o ovom projektu i njegovoj široj umjetničkoj praksi, a potom se osvrćemo na povijest televizijskog performansa.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When Murray goes on a trip, Jane Bales tries to take over the furniture store. While Beverly plots revenge, Adam is excited because Dave Kim is also planning to enroll at NYU. / Kada Murray ode na put, Jane Bales pokuša preuzeti salon namještaja. Dok Beverly smišlja osvetu, Adam je uzbuđen jer i Dave Kim planira upisati NYU.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly fills in as a gym teacher at William Penn Academy, and Barry and Geoff compete for an important summer internship. / Beverly privremeno mijenja nastavnika tjelesnoga u akademiji Williama Penna, a Barry i Geoff natječu se za važno ljetno pripravništvo.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Looking to relocate to the dramatic landscape of North Wales, Jules Hudson's buyers are looking for a new home with at least 4,000m2 of land on which to create an oasis for yoga and well-being. Fortunately, Jules is not afraid of heights because he will have to visit the Menai Suspension Bridge, which is being renovated ahead of the bicentenary of its opening. / U želji da se presele u dramatičan krajolik Sjevernog Walesa, kupci Julesa Hudsona traže novi dom s najmanje 4000 m2 zemlje na kojoj bi stvorili oazu za jogu i dobrobit. Srećom, Jules se ne boji visina jer morat će posjetiti viseći most Menai koji obnavljaju uoči dvjestote obljetnice otvorenja.

programme.title: The wonderful world of design: New Streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: The lives of army surgeon Lea and former army officer Craig have been dictated by the military. Now they are determined to create a home just for themselves and have designed an impressive, contemporary, wooden prefab house, a place where they can take a break from military discipline and the impersonal barracks. Jitinder works as a consultant helping businesses run more efficiently and is now applying the same skills to facilitate the process of building his own home. Without any previous experience, he manages the project of building a magnificent single house in the style of the Hollywood Hills. / Živote vojne kirurginje Leae i bivšeg vojnog časnika Craiga diktirala je vojska. Sada su odlučni stvoriti dom samo za sebe te su osmislili dojmljivu, suvremenu, drvenu montažnu kuću, mjesto gdje se mogu odmoriti od vojne discipline i bezlične vojarne. Jitinder radi kao konzultant i pomaže tvrtkama da posluju učinkovitije te sada primjenjuje iste vještine kako bi olakšao proces izgradnje vlastite kuće. Bez ikakvog prethodnog iskustva vodi projekt izgradnje velebne samačke kuće u stilu Hollywood Hillsa.

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without visiting the beautiful cenotes, natural lakes in caves. But for the Mayans, it was the door to the underworld. To learn more about this people, Pati visits the Xocempich cenotes with lawyer and activist Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her life to helping the Maya. / Nijedno putovanje na Yucatán nije potpuno bez obilaska prekrasnih cenotesa, prirodnih jezera u špiljama. No za Maje su to bila vrata u podzemni svijet. Kako bi saznala nešto više o ovom narodu, Pati posjećuje cenote Xocempich s odvjetnicom i aktivisticom Zoilom Cen, koja je život posvetila pomaganju Majama.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Jury members visit competitors in the south of England. In Kent it is a garden with a converted stable in a meadow. This garden broke all the rules and that's why it's so amazing. They visit an urban villa with a complex four-level garden designed so that residents feel surrounded by nature. And in Surrey there is a garden that is at odds with the suburb in which it is located. It stands out with a smart division and a garden room for every mood. / Članovi žirija posjećuju natjecatelje na engleskom jugu. U Kentu to je vrt s preuređenom stajom na livadi. Ovaj vrt prekršio je sva pravila i baš zbog toga tako zadivljuje. Posjećuju urbanu vilu sa složenim vrtom na četiri razine koji je oblikovan tako da se stanovnici osjećaju okruženi prirodom. A u Surreyju se nalazi vrt koji je u suprotnosti s predgrađem u kojem se nalazi. Ističe se pametnom podjelom i vrtnom sobom za svako raspoloženje.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel Roux will share with us the secrets of taking Sunday lunch to the next level. They will serve fish rolls in crab sauce and chicken baked in salt. A trip to Châteauneuf-du-Pape will inspire a dessert of poached pears in red wine with Gallette Serpentine, a sweet shortcrust pastry filled with almonds. / Michel Roux podijelit će s nama tajne podizanja nedjeljnog ručka na višu razinu. Poslužit će riblje valjuške u umaku od rakova i pile pečeno u soli. Izlet u Châteauneuf-du-Pape nadahnut će desert od poširanih krušaka u crnom vinu s Gallette Serpentine, slatkim prhkim tijestom punjenim bademima.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Newfoundland has always been different from the rest of Canada. The Canadian film crew filmed for NDR in six different locations in this extraordinarily beautiful region of special people. These are coastal towns without road connections, so they can only be reached by boat. Then there are the iceberg cowboys who do not catch wild horses with a lasso, but icebergs. And it is also the area with the highest concentration of poets in the country. Newfoundland has only been a Canadian province since 1949 and has always been different from the rest of the country. This film lovingly presents the special people of that region. / Newfoundland se uvijek razlikovao od ostatka Kanade. Kanadska filmska ekipa snimala je za NDR na šest različitih mjesta u ovom izvanredno lijepom kraju posebnih ljudi. Obalni su to gradovi bez cestovnih priključaka pa se do njih može doći samo brodom. Tu su zatim kauboji ledenih bregova koji lasom ne hvataju divlje konje nego ledene sante. A to je i kraj s najvećom gustoćom pjesnika u zemlji. Newfoundland je tek od 1949. kanadska pokrajina i oduvijek je drukčija od ostatka zemlje. Ovaj film s mnogo ljubavi predstavlja posebne ljude toga kraja.

Now they are determined to create a home just for themselves and have designed an impressive, contemporary, wooden prefab house, a place where they can take a break from military discipline and the impersonal barracks. Jitinder works as a consultant helping businesses run more efficiently and is now applying the same skills to facilitate the process of building his own home. Without any previous experience, he manages the project of building a magnificent single house in the style of the Hollywood Hills. / Živote vojne kirurginje Leae i bivšeg vojnog časnika Craiga diktirala je vojska. Sada su odlučni stvoriti dom samo za sebe te su osmislili dojmljivu, suvremenu, drvenu montažnu kuću, mjesto gdje se mogu odmoriti od vojne discipline i bezlične vojarne. Jitinder radi kao konzultant i pomaže tvrtkama da posluju učinkovitije te sada primjenjuje iste vještine kako bi olakšao proces izgradnje vlastite kuće. Bez ikakvog prethodnog iskustva vodi projekt izgradnje velebne samačke kuće u stilu Hollywood Hillsa.

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without visiting the beautiful cenotes, natural lakes in caves. But for the Mayans, it was the door to the underworld. To learn more about this people, Pati visits the Xocempich cenotes with lawyer and activist Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her life to helping the Maya. / Nijedno putovanje na Yucatán nije potpuno bez obilaska prekrasnih cenotesa, prirodnih jezera u špiljama. No za Maje su to bila vrata u podzemni svijet. Kako bi saznala nešto više o ovom narodu, Pati posjećuje cenote Xocempich s odvjetnicom i aktivisticom Zoilom Cen, koja je život posvetila pomaganju Majama.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Jury members visit competitors in the south of England. In Kent it is a garden with a converted stable in a meadow. This garden broke all the rules and that's why it's so amazing. They visit an urban villa with a complex four-level garden designed so that residents feel surrounded by nature. And in Surrey there is a garden that is at odds with the suburb in which it is located. It stands out with a smart division and a garden room for every mood. / Članovi žirija posjećuju natjecatelje na engleskom jugu. U Kentu to je vrt s preuređenom stajom na livadi. Ovaj vrt prekršio je sva pravila i baš zbog toga tako zadivljuje. Posjećuju urbanu vilu sa složenim vrtom na četiri razine koji je oblikovan tako da se stanovnici osjećaju okruženi prirodom. A u Surreyju se nalazi vrt koji je u suprotnosti s predgrađem u kojem se nalazi. Ističe se pametnom podjelom i vrtnom sobom za svako raspoloženje.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel Roux will share with us the secrets of taking Sunday lunch to the next level. They will serve fish rolls in crab sauce and chicken baked in salt. A trip to Châteauneuf-du-Pape will inspire a dessert of poached pears in red wine with Gallette Serpentine, a sweet shortcrust pastry filled with almonds. / Michel Roux podijelit će s nama tajne podizanja nedjeljnog ručka na višu razinu. Poslužit će riblje valjuške u umaku od rakova i pile pečeno u soli. Izlet u Châteauneuf-du-Pape nadahnut će desert od poširanih krušaka u crnom vinu s Gallette Serpentine, slatkim prhkim tijestom punjenim bademima.

programme.title: Endeavor - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: When the Oxford Mail publishes a series of obituaries of people who have died suddenly with distinctive coded messages, Endeavor decides to solve the puzzle. The investigation takes him first to a series of funerals and then behind the scenes of the funeral home to finally force him to face his own mortality. At the same time, Thursday also has various confrontations because the sins of the past are finally catching up with him. But first he must solve problems in the present that force him to take desperate measures to protect those he loves most. / Kad Oxford Mail objavi niz osmrtnica iznenada umrlih osoba s karakterističnim šifriranim porukama, Endeavour odluči riješiti zagonetku. Istraga ga vodi prvo na niz pogreba pa iza kulisa pogrebnog poduzeća da bi ga na kraju natjerala da se suoči s vlastitom smrtnošću. Istodobno i Thursday ima razna suočavanja jer ga napokon sustižu grijesi iz prošlosti. No prvo mora riješiti probleme u sadašnjosti koji ga prisiljavaju da poduzme očajničke mjere kako bi zaštitio one koje najviše voli.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: Medicines are printed in China, amber is sought on the shores of the Baltic Sea. The Sami people in Sweden are fighting for the survival of the reindeer. Plans to open mines on ancient reindeer migration routes threaten the source of livelihood for many. Do high fashion and dirt go together? / U Kini se printaju lijekovi, na obalama Baltičkog mora traži se jantar. Narod Sami u Švedskoj bori se za opstanak sobova. Planovi za otvaranje rudnika na drevnim migracijskim rutama sobova mnogima ugrožavaju izvor egzistencije. Idu li zajedno visoka moda i prljavština?

programme.title: Prometej
programme.desc: The weekly show about science, new knowledge and innovations that practically change our world, improving our everyday life, presents the professional and scientific achievements of our scientists in all scientific fields. / Tjedna emisija o znanosti, novim spoznajama i inovacijama koje praktično mijenjaju naš svijet poboljšavajući nam svakodnevicu, predstavlja stručna i znanstvena postignuća naših znanstvenika u svim znanstvenim područjima.

programme.title: Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Koordinacija
programme.desc: We present a new column _ Master's surgery! The master of this practice is Doctor DS, also known as David Skrbin. He is followed on YouTube by almost three million do-it-yourself project enthusiasts, and he will demonstrate equally useful procedures in the Master's surgery. It was easier to build a new one than to restore the old one! We find out what were the biggest challenges during the reconstruction of the first tube of the Učka tunnel. The guest of the Notes column is Dario Silić, the general manager of Bina Istra, the concessionaire of Istrian ipsilon. We bring you a story about a famous Croatian stone _ and no, it's not from Brač! In the Tips And Tricks column, we deal with furnishing the bathroom. / Predstavljamo novu rubriku _ Majstorska ordinacija! Majstor ove ordinacije je Doctor DS, poznat i kao David Skrbin. Na YouTubeu ga prati gotovo tri milijuna zaljubljenika u uradi sam projekte, a jednako korisne zahvate pokazat će i u Majstorskoj ordinaciji. Jednostavnije je bilo izgraditi novu nego obnoviti staru! Doznajemo koji su bili najveći izazovi tijekom obnove prve cijevi tunela Učka. Gost rubrike Notes je Dario Silić, generalni direktor Bina Istre, koncesionara Istarskog ipsilona. Donosimo priču o jednom poznatom hrvatskom kamenu _ i ne, nije brački! U rubrici Tips And Tricks bavimo se opremanjem kupaonice.

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: After the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina adopted the Reform Agenda, a key document derived from the Growth Plan for the Western Balkans, Ursula von der Leyen visited Bosnia and Herzegovina. From Sunday, the European Union applies a new system for controlling the entry and exit of citizens from outside the EU, the so-called EES, which replaces the traditional use of passports with digital recording of biometric data, such as fingerprints and facial images. The goal is more effective border control, the fight against illegal migration and the monitoring of the stay of foreigners in the Schengen area. The Government of the Republic of Croatia continues to financially support projects for the return of Croats and the creation of sustainable living conditions in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The ceremonial awarding of the financial support contract for this year was held in Orašje. In Odžak, the foundation stone for the construction of the sports hall of the Vladimir Nazor Elementary School, worth one million and 410 thousand convertible marks, was laid, and the funds for the first phase were provided by the counties of Posavina and Osijek-Baranja and the Government of the Republic of Croatia. The beginning of the construction of the expressway Mostar - Polog - Široki Brijeg - the border of the Republic of Croatia was officially marked by the signing of the contract. Good transport connections will help the development of the economy, including agriculture, while Herzegovinian olive growers show how to invest in modernization and new technologies. Collaborating high school from neighboring states, specifically Osijek III. gymnasium and general gymnasium of the Catholic school center "Blaženi Ivan Merz" from Banja Luka, shown in a report by Predrag Solomun. The Osmica Memorial Park recalls the death of eight children in Lašvanska dolina in 1993. They died as a result of a mortar shell explosion on a children's playground in the suburb of Viteška. Thanks to the persistence of the families of the surviving children, the playground became a memorial with a strong anti-war message _ not to be forgotten and never to happen again. The 26th Mediterranean Film Festival ended in Široki Brijeg. In the competition of 19 documentaries, the Grand Prix of the festival was won by the film "Together Forever" by director Anastasya Miroshnichenko, while the award for the best short film was won by "Knives" by Croatian director Ivan Mokrović. / Nakon što je Vijeće ministara BiH donijelo Reformsku agendu, ključni dokument proizašao iz Plana rasta za zapadni Balkan, Ursula von der Leyen posjetila je BiH. Europska unija od nedjelje primjenjuje novi sustav za kontrolu ulaska i izlaska građana izvan EU-a, tzv. EES, koji zamjenjuje tradicionalnu uporabu putovnica digitalnim snimanjem biometrijskih podataka, poput otiska prstiju i slike lica. Cilj je učinkovitija kontrola granica, borba protiv nezakonitih migracija i praćenje boravka stranaca u schengenskom prostoru. Vlada Republike Hrvatske nastavlja financijski poticati projekte povratka Hrvata i stvaranje održivih uvjeta života u BiH. Svečana dodjela ugovora o financijskoj potpori za ovu godinu održana je u Orašju. U Odžaku je položen kamen temeljac za izgradnju sportske dvorane Osnovne škole Vladimira Nazora, vrijedne milijun i 410 tisuća konvertibilnih maraka, a sredstva za prvu fazu osigurale su posavska i osječko-baranjska županija te Vlada Republike Hrvatske. Početak izgradnje brze ceste Mostar _ Polog _ Široki Brijeg _ granica RH službeno je označen potpisivanjem ugovora. Dobra prometna povezanost pomoći će razvoju gospodarstva, uključujući poljoprivredu, dok hercegovački maslinari pokazuju kako se ulagati u modernizaciju i nove tehnologije. Suradnja gimnazija iz susjednih država, konkretno osječke III. gimnazije i Opće gimnazije Katoličkoga školskog centra "Blaženi Ivan Merz" iz Banje Luke, prikazana je u reportaži Predraga Solomuna. Spomen-park Osmica podsjeća na stradanje osmero djece u Lašvanskoj dolini 1993. Poginula su od posljedica eksplozije minobacačke granate na dječjem igralištu u viteškom prigradskom naselju. Zahvaljujući upornosti obitelji preživjele djece, igralište je postalo spomen-obilježje s snažnom antiratnom porukom _ da se ne zaboravi i da se nikada više ne dogodi. U Širokom Brijegu završen je 26. Mediteran film festival. U konkurenciji 19 dokumentaraca, Grand Prix festivala osvojio je film "Zauvijek zajedno" redateljice Anastasye Miroshnichenko, dok je nagradu za najbolji kratkometražni film osvojio "Nožarije" hrvatskog redatelja Ivana Mokrovića.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the "Croatian Sahara", which consists of the remains of the only Croatian desert and a geographical-botanical reserve. The desert is located in the eastern part of the town of Đurđevac. Đurđevački sands represent diverse habitats for the entire living settlement. Some of the plants in this episode are gray bulrush, silkwort, bearded fescue, early hamster, rabbitwort, and medicinal asparagus. The guests of the episode are B.Sc. Geology Engineer Martin Mahović and Željka Kolar from the Public Institution for the Management of Protected Nature Areas in the Koprivnica-Križevačka County. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje "Hrvatsku Saharu" koju čine ostaci jedine hrvatske pustinje i geografsko-botanički rezervat. Pustinja se nalazi na istočnom dijelu Grada Đurđevca. Đurđevački pijesci predstavljaju raznolika staništa za cijelo živo naselje. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su siva gromotulja, svilenica, vlasulja bradica, rani hrčak, zečjak i ljekovita šparoga. Gosti epizode su dipl. ing. geologije Martin Mahović i Željka Kolar iz Javne ustanove za upravljanje zaštićenim dijelovima prirode na području Koprivničko-križevačke županije.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: This time, Ben Fogle will visit Sandy, who opened an animal sanctuary on the Greek island of Andros. They will spend a week on the mountainside with 25 dogs, 8 donkeys, a horse, a mule and more than 20 cats. Surrounded by beautiful nature, Ben helps feed, brush and walk the many animals that live on the property around the 300-year-old house. She will join Sandy in a surprise rescue operation that will bring the total number of dogs to 32. Sandy never takes a day off, and Ben will discover what made her choose this lifestyle. Surrounded by animals, Sandy doesn't feel the need to socialize with the locals and claims that the animals provide her with everything she needs. But it seems to Ben that she doesn't spend enough time on herself because of this, and wonders how she'll cope when she's older. / Ben Fogle ovaj će put posjetiti Sandy koja je na grčkom otoku Androsu otvorila utočište za životinje. Na obronku planine provest će tjedan s 25 pasa, 8 magaraca, konjem, mulom i više od 20 mačaka. Okružen prelijepom prirodom, Ben pomaže hraniti, četkati i šetati mnoštvo životinja koje žive na posjedu oko kuće stare 300 godina. Pridružit će se Sandy u iznenadnoj akciji spašavanja štenaca nakon koje će ukupan broj pasa narasti na 32. Sandy nikad ne uzima slobodan dan, a Ben će otkriti što ju je navelo da izabere takav način života. Okružena životinjama, Sandy ne osjeća potrebu da se druži s lokalnim stanovništvom i tvrdi da joj životinje pružaju sve što joj je potrebno. Ali Benu se čini da zbog toga ne posvećuje dovoljno vremena sebi i pita se kako će se snalaziti kad bude starija.

programme.title: Katastrofa podmornice Titan
programme.desc: In June 2023, the OceanGate submarine was on its final mission to descend on the wreck of the Titanic when it imploded at a depth of 3,800 meters. All five passengers died in the accident. With exclusive interviews with members of the US Coast Guard investigative committee and first-ever video footage, we reveal why the tragedy happened and whether it could have been prevented. We will see an analysis of the events leading up to the fateful day _ from the founding of OceanGate under CEO Stockton Rush to the start of construction of the Titan, a unique carbon fiber submarine designed to take tourists on the adventure of a lifetime _ a visit to the wreck of the Titanic. The documentary provides a detailed account of the last mission that ended in a tragic implosion and initiates a discussion about the establishment of necessary safety protocols in similar deep sea exploration missions. World traveler and explorer Josh Gates will show us for the first time his footage of Titan's interior, which he intended to use in the series "Expedition into the Unknown" on the Discovery Channel. They were created in 2021 _ just a few months before the submarine began going on missions to the wreck of the Titanic. A disturbing interview with Rush and a troubled test dive led Gates to cancel the filming of the planned episode. Through interviews with technicians and deep-sea explorers who took part in the submarine's test dive, as well as long-time friends and colleagues of Stockton Rush, we will learn more about the insufficient safety measures and the clear signs that the submarine was not safe _ but those responsible chose to ignore it. / U lipnju 2023. podmornica OceanGate bila je u posljednjoj misiji spuštanja na olupinu Titanica kada je implodirala na dubini od 3800 metara. U nesreći je poginulo svih pet putnika. Uz ekskluzivne razgovore s članovima istraživačkog odbora američke obalne straže i prvi put objavljene video snimke, otkrivamo zašto se tragedija dogodila te je li se mogla spriječiti. Vidjet ćemo analizu događaja koji su doveli do kobnog dana _ od osnivanja tvrtke OceanGate pod vodstvom izvršnog direktora Stocktona Rusha do početka gradnje Titana, jedinstvene podmornice od ugljičnih vlakana, projektirane kako bi vodila turiste u pustolovinu života _ posjet olupini Titanica. Dokumentarac donosi detaljni prikaz posljednje misije koja je završila tragičnom implozijom te pokreće raspravu o uspostavi nužnih sigurnosnih protokola u sličnim misijama istraživanja dubokog mora. Svjetski putnik i istraživač Josh Gates prvi put će nam pokazati svoje snimke unutrašnjosti Titana, koje je namjeravao upotrijebiti u seriji "Ekspedicija u nepoznato" na Discovery Channelu. Nastale su 2021. _ samo nekoliko mjeseci prije nego što je podmornica počela ići u misije na olupinu Titanica. Uznemirujući intervju s Rushom i problematičan testni zaron naveli su Gatesa da otkaže snimanje planirane epizode. Kroz razgovore s tehničarima i istraživačima dubokog mora koji su sudjelovali u testnom zaronu podmornice, kao i s dugogodišnjim prijateljima i kolegama Stocktona Rusha, saznat ćemo više o nedovoljnim mjerama sigurnosti i jasnim znakovima da podmornica nije sigurna _ ali su odgovorni to odlučili ignorirati.

programme.title: The only chance / Jedina šansa
programme.desc: A squad of elite naval commandos along with a CIA analyst conducts a mission to transport the prisoner Amin Mansour, who possesses key information that could prevent a terrorist attack on Washington D.C. During the mission, they are attacked by an organized terrorist group of rebels who want to free Mansur and use the information for their own purposes. / Odred elitnih mornaričkih komandosa zajedno s analitičarkom CIA-e provodi misiju transporta zatvorenika Amina Mansura, koji posjeduje ključne informacije koje mogu spriječiti teroristički napad na Washington D.C. Tijekom zadatka napada ih organizirana teroristička skupina pobunjenika koja želi osloboditi Mansura i iskoristiti informacije u svoje svrhe.

programme.title: Pred sudom javnosti
programme.desc: Inspector Cassidy tries to convince the prosecutor's office to press charges against Talitha, but Cleo tries to prevent this with all her might. When new information emerges, her case is seriously threatened. Cleo crosses the lines of a professional relationship with Talitha and considers making a mutually beneficial deal with Damian. Meanwhile, the police are tracking down a third suspect, and a new theory is emerging about what happened that night. / Inspektorica Cassidy pokušava uvjeriti tužiteljstvo da podigne optužnicu protiv Talithe, no Cleo to nastoji svim silama spriječiti. Kad se usto pojave i nove informacije, njezin je slučaj ozbiljno ugrožen. Cleo prelazi granice profesionalnog odnosa s Talithom i razmišlja o sklapanju dogovora s Damianom koji bi mogao biti uzajamno koristan. Policija u međuvremenu ulazi u trag trećem osumnjičeniku pa se pojavljuje nova teorija o tome što se dogodilo te noći.

programme.title: Endeavor - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: When the Oxford Mail publishes a series of obituaries of people who have died suddenly with distinctive coded messages, Endeavor decides to solve the puzzle. The investigation takes him first to a series of funerals and then behind the scenes of the funeral home to finally force him to face his own mortality. At the same time, Thursday also has various confrontations because the sins of the past are finally catching up with him. But first he must solve problems in the present that force him to take desperate measures to protect those he loves most. / Kad Oxford Mail objavi niz osmrtnica iznenada umrlih osoba s karakterističnim šifriranim porukama, Endeavour odluči riješiti zagonetku. Istraga ga vodi prvo na niz pogreba pa iza kulisa pogrebnog poduzeća da bi ga na kraju natjerala da se suoči s vlastitom smrtnošću. Istodobno i Thursday ima razna suočavanja jer ga napokon sustižu grijesi iz prošlosti. No prvo mora riješiti probleme u sadašnjosti koji ga prisiljavaju da poduzme očajničke mjere kako bi zaštitio one koje najviše voli.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When Murray goes on a trip, Jane Bales tries to take over the furniture store. While Beverly plots revenge, Adam is excited because Dave Kim is also planning to enroll at NYU. / Kada Murray ode na put, Jane Bales pokuša preuzeti salon namještaja. Dok Beverly smišlja osvetu, Adam je uzbuđen jer i Dave Kim planira upisati NYU.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly fills in as a gym teacher at William Penn Academy, and Barry and Geoff compete for an important summer internship. / Beverly privremeno mijenja nastavnika tjelesnoga u akademiji Williama Penna, a Barry i Geoff natječu se za važno ljetno pripravništvo.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly goes to Florida to clean up her father's apartment, but she gets an unpleasant surprise there. Erica's heroic act at the mall overshadows Barry's medical school admissions results. / Beverly odlazi na Floridu kako bi sredila očev stan, ali ondje je čeka neugodno iznenađenje. Ericin junački čin u trgovačkom centru zasjeni Barryjeve rezultate prijemnoga za studij medicine.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: As Adam's graduation approaches, Beverly ponders whether to remain a supervisor at William Penn Academy; Erica wants to end the long tradition of Sunday dinners at the Schwartz's. / Kako se Adamova matura bliži, Beverly razmišlja hoće li ostati nadzornica u akademiji Williama Penna; Erica želi prekinuti dugu tradiciju nedjeljnih večera kod Schwartzovih.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman's buyers are already renting a home in the beautiful Herefordshire countryside, but they need Nicki's help to find a house that includes enough land to rent out to tourists. We are also waiting for a surprise visit from another leader of Escape to the Interior, who also lives in the countryside. / Kupci Nicki Chapman već iznajmljuju dom u prelijepom krajoliku Herefordshirea, ali trebaju Nickinu pomoć da nađu kuću koja uključuje dovoljno zemlje za iznajmljivanje turistima. Čeka nas i iznenađujući posjet drugog voditelja Bijega u unutrašnjost koji također živi na selu.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George begins by converting a rusty elevator into a house in the air and visits a modern Viking longhouse in Denmark. And the pinkest thing that has ever appeared on the show! / George započinje s preinakom zahrđalog dizala kućicu u zraku i posjećuje modernu vikinšku dugu (dvoransku) kuću u Danskoj. K tomu najružičastija stvar koja se dosad pojavila u emisiji!

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: The ingredient that Pati puts in all her dishes is salt, and in Yucatán you can find one of the best in the world. Salts from Las Coloradas are given their distinctive color by red algae. Engineer Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink salt lakes from which the salt is extracted. / Sastojak koji Pati stavlja u sva jela je sol, a na Yucatánu se može naći jedna od najboljih na svijetu. Soli iz Las Coloradasa prepoznatljivu boju daju crvene alge. Inženjer Felipe Perez vodi Pati do ružičastih slanih jezera iz kojih se dobiva sol.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Judges Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae rate the best gardens in Wales and the West of England in this episode. There is a garden in Shepton Mallet whose owner is a garden designer. It consists of different areas such as a lawn, a kitchen garden and a meadow, and the members of the jury also discover a unique part that is shaped like an amphitheater. In Ceredigion, they discover a remote garden that passers-by don't even know exists. In Tockington, two former teachers rolled up their sleeves and designed their version of a classic English garden, and in Bath, the jury reveals a garden created during the corona that brings a touch of the exotic to a typical English town. / Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi ocijenjuju najbolje vrtove u Walesu i zapadnoj Engleskoj. U Shepton Malletu je vrt čija je vlasnica vrtna dizajnerica. Čine ga različiti prostori poput travnjaka, kuhinjskog vrta i livade, a članovi žirija otkrivaju i jedinstven dio koji je oblikovan poput amfiteatra. U Ceredigionu otkrivaju zabačeni vrt za koji prolaznici i ne znaju da postoji. U Tockingtonu dvoje bivših učitelja zasukalo je rukave i oblikovalo svoju verziju klasičnog engleskog vrta, a u Bathu žiri otkriva vrt nastao tijekom korone koji u tipičan engleski grad unosi dašak egzotike.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Today, Michel will organize a relaxed dinner for friends. For an appetizer, they will prepare snails with Chartreuse liqueur and hazelnuts and milk bread rolls. A visit to the acclaimed chef Fanny Rey will inspire the preparation of fish stew, and for dessert there will be a slightly different chocolate mousse. / Danas će Michel organizirati opuštenu večeru za prijatelje. Za predjelo će pripremiti puževe s likerom Chartreuse i lješnjacima i rolice od mliječnog kruha. Posjet hvaljenoj kuharici Fanny Rey nadahnut će pripremu ribljeg paprikaša, a za desert bit će malo drukčiji čokoladni mousse.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: With a height of 2918 m, Olympus is the highest mountain in Greece, in Greek mythology the seat of Zeus and his exalted divine company. Not far from it is the Pilio peninsula with sycamore forests, olive groves, old mountain villages and magical coves. All this beauty is surpassed only by the world-famous monasteries of Meteora, which are included in the UNESCO list of World Cultural Heritage. These holy places are built on pointed rocks. Maria Zolota and her husband Dionysos run a mountain lodge in Spilios Agapitos at 2,060 m. Each season more than 10,000 guests spend the night here, which requires a lot of organizational talent and hard work. Water is brought from the mountains through a special water supply system. It is water from melted snow and ice. Food supplies should also be organized because there is no freight cable car or access road here. But that's why Takis and his Donkey Express exist. Panaiotis Varipatis and his girlfriend Litsa are truffle hunters. They regularly search for this black gold with their dogs in the Kalambake forest. / Olimp je s visinom od 2918 m najviša planina u Grčkoj, u grčkoj mitologiji sjedište Zeusa i njegove uzvišene božanske družine. Nedaleko od njega je poluotok Pilio sa šumama platana, maslinicima, starim planinskim selima i čarobnim uvalama. Svu tu ljepotu nadilaze samo svjetski poznati manastiri Meteora koji su uvršteni u UNESCO-v popis Svjetske kulturne baštine. Ta su sveta mjesta podignuta na šiljastim stijenama. Maria Zolota i njezin muž Dionysos vode planinarski dom u Spilios Agapitosu na 2060 m. Svake sezone ovdje prenoći više od 10.000 gostiju, za što je potrebno mnogo organizacijskog dara i radinosti. Voda se posebnim vodovodom dovodi iz gorja. To je voda od otopljenog snijega i leda. Treba organizirati i opskrbu namirnicama jer ovdje nema teretne žičare ni pristupne ceste. Ali zato postoji Takis i njegov magareći ekspres. Panaiotis Varipatis i njegova djevojka Litsa lovci su na tartufe. Sa svojim psima u šumi Kalambake redovito tragaju za tim crnim zlatom.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman's buyers are already renting a home in the beautiful Herefordshire countryside, but they need Nicki's help to find a house that includes enough land to rent out to tourists. We are also waiting for a surprise visit from another leader of Escape to the Interior, who also lives in the countryside. / Kupci Nicki Chapman već iznajmljuju dom u prelijepom krajoliku Herefordshirea, ali trebaju Nickinu pomoć da nađu kuću koja uključuje dovoljno zemlje za iznajmljivanje turistima. Čeka nas i iznenađujući posjet drugog voditelja Bijega u unutrašnjost koji također živi na selu.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George Clarke explores the fascinating world of small buildings where people transform small spaces into the most amazing places to live, work and play and even tries to build a few of them himself... ----- George starts by converting a rusty elevator into a house in the air and visits a modern Viking longhouse (mansion) in Denmark. And the pinkest thing that has ever appeared on the show! / George Clarke istražuje fascinantan svijet malih građevina u kojemu ljudi pretvaraju male prostore u najnevjerojatnija mjesta za život, rad i igru te čak i sam pokuša izgraditi nekoliko njih... ----- George započinje s preinakom zahrđalog dizala kućicu u zraku i posjećuje modernu vikinšku dugu (dvoransku) kuću u Danskoj. K tomu najružičastija stvar koja se dosad pojavila u emisiji!

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: The ingredient that Pati puts in all her dishes is salt, and in Yucatán you can find one of the best in the world. Salts from Las Coloradas are given their distinctive color by red algae. Engineer Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink salt lakes from which the salt is extracted. / Sastojak koji Pati stavlja u sva jela je sol, a na Yucatánu se može naći jedna od najboljih na svijetu. Soli iz Las Coloradasa prepoznatljivu boju daju crvene alge. Inženjer Felipe Perez vodi Pati do ružičastih slanih jezera iz kojih se dobiva sol.

In Ceredigion, they discover a remote garden that passers-by don't even know exists. In Tockington, two former teachers rolled up their sleeves and designed their version of a classic English garden, and in Bath, the jury reveals a garden created during the corona that brings a touch of the exotic to a typical English town. / Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi ocijenjuju najbolje vrtove u Walesu i zapadnoj Engleskoj. U Shepton Malletu je vrt čija je vlasnica vrtna dizajnerica. programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Today, Michel will organize a relaxed dinner for friends. For an appetizer, they will prepare snails with Chartreuse liqueur and hazelnuts and milk bread rolls. A visit to the acclaimed chef Fanny Rey will inspire the preparation of fish stew, and for dessert there will be a slightly different chocolate mousse. / Danas će Michel organizirati opuštenu večeru za prijatelje. Za predjelo će pripremiti puževe s likerom Chartreuse i lješnjacima i rolice od mliječnog kruha. Posjet hvaljenoj kuharici Fanny Rey nadahnut će pripremu ribljeg paprikaša, a za desert bit će malo drukčiji čokoladni mousse.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: Morse's assistant Inspector Lewis returns to Oxford after several years away. In Oxford, he is greeted by the mysterious murder of a young girl, Regan, who is soon found to have been intimately connected with several members of the powerful Griffon automobile family. When members of that family start to die, Lewis and his assistant Inspector Hathaway will soon have to find out what secret the Griffon family is hiding and why Morse himself once dealt with a minor report related to Daniel Griffon's juvenile crime. / Morseov pomoćnik inspektor Lewis vraća se u Oxford nakon više godina izbivanja. U Oxfordu ga dočeka misteriozno ubojstvo mlade djevojke Regan za koju se ubrzo dozna da je bila intimno povezana s više članova moćne automobilističke obitelji Griffon. Kada počnu stradavati i članovi te obitelji, Lewis i njegov pomoćnik inspektor Hathaway morat će ubrzo otkriti kakvu tajnu skriva obitelj Griffon i zašto se i sam Morse nekad bavio sitnom prijavom vezanom uz maloljetnički zločin Daniela Griffona.

programme.title: Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: From October 12 to 19, 2025, Zadar will host the 44th European Team Table Tennis Championship, where 24 men's national teams will compete in the group and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik hall brings top-class sport, tension and spectacular encounters in the quest for the title. / Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov.

programme.title: Globalna Hrvatska HTV
programme.desc: A show dedicated to Croats in the homeland and the world. / Emisija posvećena Hrvatima u domovini i svijetu.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We are traveling to the Spanish San Sebastian! We also visited Gastronomika, an international gastronomic congress and haute cuisine fair together with Metro and the best chefs in Croatia. The top wines of Slavonia and Podunavlje came together with great food and great entertainment at the second Danube Wine Festival. See what it looks like when art and top cuisine come together at a dinner that took place at the Museum of Contemporary Art and was prepared by JRE chefs. We report from this year's Via vino festival and discover what is behind the InterWine project. Find out what will happen at Bregfest, which will be held for the fourth time in Zagreb's Lauba. / Putujemo u španjolski San Sebastian! Posjetili smo i Gastronomiku, međunarodni gastronomski kongres i sajam visoke kuhinje zajedno s Metroom i najboljim chefovima Hrvatske. Vrhunska vina Slavonije i Podunavlja spojila su se uz odličnu hranu i sjajnu zabavu na drugom po redu Dunav Wine Festivalu. Pogledajte kako izgleda kad se spoje umjetnost i vrhunska kuhinja na večeri koja se odvila u Muzeju suvremene umjetnosti, a koju su pripremili JRE chefovi. Donosimo izvještaj s ovogodišnjeg Via vino festivala i otkrivamo što stoji iza projekta InterWine. Doznajte što će se sve događati na Bregfestu koji će se po četvrti put održati u zagrebačkoj Laubi.

programme.title: HAK - Traffic education / HAK - Prometna edukacija
programme.desc: Edukativna tjedna emisija Hrvatskog autokluba donosi reportaže, kratke savjete i zanimljivosti o cestovnom prometu i povećanju sigurnosti.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben came to the rocky cliffs of Cornwall, where Todd and Davina live with their children. They left the city for the countryside without any experience _ driven only by a great desire to become farmers. Ben will learn that it took them five years to convert the three-hectare property into a farm. They will join them in taking care of different animals _ pigs, ducks and more than a hundred chickens. They will feel firsthand what their chaotic daily rhythm looks like. You have to find time for the children, take care of the animals, dig the pond, harvest the vegetables... The good life is not always easy, especially if you are at the mercy of stormy weather conditions on the west coast. But Ben will be most impressed by the personal challenges they face _ financially, physically and mentally. / Ben je došao na kamenite litice Cornwalla, gdje Todd i Davina žive s djecom. Otišli su iz grada na selo bez ikakvog iskustva _ vođeni samo velikom željom da postanu farmeri. Ben će saznati da im je trebalo pet godina kako bi posjed površine tri hektara preuredili u farmu. Pridružit će im se u brizi o različitim životinjama _ svinjama, patkama i više od sto kokoši. Iz prve će ruke osjetiti kako izgleda njihov kaotični dnevni ritam. Treba naći vremena za djecu, brinuti se za životinje, iskopati ribnjak, ubrati povrće... Dobar život nije uvijek lak, pogotovo ako ste na milosti burnih vremenskih uvjeta na zapadnoj obali. Ali Bena će se najviše dojmiti osobni izazovi s kojima se suočavaju _ financijski, fizički i psihički.

programme.title: Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Agatha's tour of the Empire in 1922 takes Sir David Suchet to New Zealand where he will explore woolen mills and gold mines, and the Maori will lead him to geothermal springs. Sir David will find out how the trip made Agatha more independent and why his beloved Poirot hates the sea. / Agathina turneja po Carstvu 1922. godine vodi sir Davida Sucheta na Novi Zeland gdje će istražiti tvornice vune i rudnike zlata, a Maori će ga odvesti do geotermalnih izvora. Sir David će saznati kako je putovanje potaknulo Agathu da postane neovisnija i zašto njegov dragi Poirot mrzi more.

programme.title: Rabbit embankment / Zečji nasip
programme.desc: In a village threatened by floods, the orderly life of the young athlete Marko is shaken by the return of Slaven, his boyhood's forbidden love. And while the whole village builds rabbit dykes to protect their homes, Marko will try to build a dyke around himself, defending himself from his own emotions. But water always finds a way. / U selu kojem prijete poplave, posložen život mladog sportaša Marka uzdrma povratak Slavena, njegove dječačke zabranjene ljubavi. I dok cijelo selo gradi zečje nasipe kako bi zaštitilo svoje domove, Marko će pokušati izgraditi nasip oko sebe, braneći se od vlastitih emocija. Ali voda uvijek nađe put.

programme.title: Pred sudom javnosti
programme.desc: After Talitha and Dhillon are charged with Hannah's murder, the legal teams begin preparing for the trial. Cleo and Brian find evidence that points to Dhillon, but Meera manages to dig up some more juicy details from Talitha's past and turn everything to her advantage. The reporters crucify Talitha. Can Cleo help her get rid of her bad image? / Nakon što Talithu i Dhillona optuže za Hannahino ubojstvo, pravni timovi počinju se pripremati za suđenje. Cleo i Brian pronalaze dokaze koji upućuju na Dhillona, no Meera uspijeva iskopati još neke sočne detalje iz Talithine prošlosti i sve preokrenuti u svoju korist. Novinari razapinju Talithu. Može li joj Cleo pomoći da se riješi svog lošeg imidža?

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: The first season of the exciting detective series Lewis has four episodes, the main character is Robbie Lewis (Kevin Whately), the partner of the famous inspector Morse, from the multi-award-winning series of the same name that was shown by HTV. The Lewis series continues where the previous series left off _ five years after the death of his partner Morse, and after a two-year absence from Oxford due to a family tragedy, Lewis, now an inspector, returns to his workplace. But already at the airport, Lewis and his new partner, the young James Hathaway (Laurence Fox), are put into a police car and, under rotating lights, they are urgently transported to the crime scene in Oxford, where an American student was shot. New cases lead Lewis and Hathaway into student circles full of unexpected secrets. --- Morse's assistant Inspector Lewis returns to Oxford after several years away. In Oxford, he is greeted by the mysterious murder of a young girl, Regan, who is soon found to have been intimately connected with several members of the powerful Griffon automobile family. When members of that family start to die, Lewis and his assistant Inspector Hathaway will soon have to find out what secret the Griffon family is hiding and why Morse himself once dealt with a minor report related to Daniel Griffon's juvenile crime. / Prva sezona uzbudljive detektivske serije Lewis ima četiri epizode, glavni lik je Robbie Lewis (Kevin Whately), partner glasovitog inspektora Morsea, iz istoimene, mnogostruko nagrađivane serije koju je HTV prikazivao. Serija Lewis nastavlja se ondje gdje je prethodna serija stala _ pet godina poslije smrti svog partnera Morsea, te nakon dvogodišnjeg izbivanja iz Oxforda zbog obiteljske tragedije, Lewis, sada inspektor, vraća se na svoje radno mjesto. No već u zračnoj luci Lewisa i njegova novog partnera, mladog Jamesa Hathawaya (Laurence Fox), ubacuju u policijski automobil i pod rotirajućim svjetlima hitno prevoze na mjesto zločina u Oxfordu gdje je ustrijeljen američki student. Novi slučajevi vode Lewisa i Hathawayja u studentske krugove pune neočekivanih tajni. --- Morseov pomoćnik inspektor Lewis vraća se u Oxford nakon više godina izbivanja. U Oxfordu ga dočeka misteriozno ubojstvo mlade djevojke Regan za koju se ubrzo dozna da je bila intimno povezana s više članova moćne automobilističke obitelji Griffon. Kada počnu stradavati i članovi te obitelji, Lewis i njegov pomoćnik inspektor Hathaway morat će ubrzo otkriti kakvu tajnu skriva obitelj Griffon i zašto se i sam Morse nekad bavio sitnom prijavom vezanom uz maloljetnički zločin Daniela Griffona.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly goes to Florida to clean up her father's apartment, but she gets an unpleasant surprise there. Erica's heroic act at the mall overshadows Barry's medical school admissions results. / Beverly odlazi na Floridu kako bi sredila očev stan, ali ondje je čeka neugodno iznenađenje. Ericin junački čin u trgovačkom centru zasjeni Barryjeve rezultate prijemnoga za studij medicine.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: As Adam's graduation approaches, Beverly ponders whether to remain a supervisor at William Penn Academy; Erica wants to end the long tradition of Sunday dinners at the Schwartz's. / Kako se Adamova matura bliži, Beverly razmišlja hoće li ostati nadzornica u akademiji Williama Penna; Erica želi prekinuti dugu tradiciju nedjeljnih večera kod Schwartzovih.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Discovering that they have mold in their apartment, Erica and Geoff have to stay with the Goldbergs for a while. Beverly senses tension in their relationship and takes the opportunity to give them some marriage advice. / Otkrivši da imaju plijesan u stanu, Erica i Geoff moraju neko vrijeme boraviti kod Goldbergovih. Beverly osjeti napetost u njihovu odnosu i iskoristi priliku da im da pokoji bračni savjet.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam has finally graduated and everyone is ready for the graduation ceremony; everyone except Beverly, who can't accept that her house will be empty. With Geoff's encouragement, Erica decides to take the stage again and sing backing vocals. / Adam je napokon maturirao i svi su spremni za dodjelu diploma; svi osim Beverly, koja ne može prihvatiti da će joj kuća biti prazna. Uz Geoffovo ohrabrenje, Erica odluči opet stati na pozornicu i pjevati prateći vokal.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: The buyers in this episode want a new home in either Hampshire or Dorset because it's only important to them that it's close to what they love most, the sea. Denise Nurse will try to make them happy and also meet a family from Hampshire who live like a dream in an idyllic Georgian house. / Kupci u ovoj epizode žele novi dom bilo u Hampshireu ili Dorsetu jer važno im je samo da bude blizu onoga što najviše vole, mora. Denise Nurse će ih pokušati usrećiti, a također će upoznati obitelji iz Hampshirea koja živi kao u snu u idiličnoj georgijanskoj kući.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: An actor climbs the property ladder on four wheels _ he transforms a Luton truck into a two-bed luxury flat. We will also see an underground cafe covered with shells. And there's also a train car that functions as a pet-friendly rental space. / Jedan glumac uspinje se na nekretninskoj ljestvici na četiri kotača _ uređuje kamion modela Luton u dvokrevetni luksuzni stančić. Vidjet ćemo i podzemni kafić prekriven školjkama. A tu je i željeznički vagon koji funkcionira kao prostor za najam u kojemu su kućni ljubimci dobrodošli.

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers something specific to Yucatán. She joins the Amazonas softball team, made up of indigenous women, for their morning practice. Over time, they became a highly respected club and overcame stereotypes. / U Yaxunahu Pati otkriva nešto specifično za Yucatán. Pridružuje se softball timu Amazonas, sastavljenom od domorotkinja, na njihovom jutarnjem treningu. S vremenom su postale vrlo cijenjen klub i pobijedile stereotipe.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Judges Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae compare contestants from Central England and the Midlands in this episode. They visit a garden in Cambridgeshire where the American owner has spared no effort to shape his vision of English rural perfection. In Nottinghamshire, they find tranquility in a garden arranged around a natural pond, and in Oxfordshire, they explore a garden on a plot in a city garden. The beautifully decorated space reflects the true gardening love and passion. And behind a seemingly ordinary home in the suburbs of Walsall, the jury discovers a garden that is anything but ordinary. / Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi uspoređuju natjecatelje iz središnje Engleske i Midlandsa. Posjećuju vrt u Cambridgeshireu gdje vlasnik Amerikanac nije štedio truda kako bi oblikovao svoju viziju engleskog ruralnog savršenstva. U Nottinghamshireu pronalaze spokoj u vrtu koji je uređen oko prirodnog jezerca, a u Oxfordshireu razgledavaju vrt na parceli u gradskom vrtu. U krasno uređenom prostoru ogledaju se istinska vrtlarska ljubav i strast. A iza naizgled običnog doma u predgrađu u Walsallu žiri otkriva vrt koji je sve drugo nego običan.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: In this episode, Michel will organize a real feast. A visit to a restaurant on the Mediterranean coast will inspire an appetizer based on smoked fish. Beef cheek stew will serve as the main course, and salted caramel tart with walnuts for dessert. / U ovoj epizodi Michel će organizirati pravu gozbu. Posjet restoranu na mediteranskoj obali nadahnut će predjelo na bazi dimljene ribe. Za glavno poslužit će gulaš od goveđih obraza, a za desert tart od slane karamele s orasima.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Gomera is the second smallest island of the Canary Islands, greener, more natural and wilder than the large islands of this Spanish archipelago in the Atlantic. On it, the trade winds stop in the mountains, providing precious moisture to the thousand-year-old evergreen misty forest. To this day, the island has remained spared from mass tourism because there is no direct air line with the European continent. Thus, Gomera became a secret destination for mountaineers and nature lovers. The Canary Islands are located 100 km off the African coast, and as a Spanish territory they are part of the European Union. It was this small, idyllic island that was the starting point of the legendary research trip of Christopher Columbus, who set out from here in search of India and accidentally discovered America. / Gomera je drugi najmanji otok Kanara, zeleniji, prirodniji i divljiji od velikih otoka ovog španjolskog arhipelaga u Atlantiku. Na njoj se u gorju zaustavljaju pasatni oblaci pružajući dragocjenu vlagu tisućljetnoj zimzelenoj maglovitoj šumi. Otok je do danas ostao pošteđen masovnog turizma jer ne postoji izravna zrakoplovna linija s europskim kontinentom. Tako je Gomera postala tajno odredište planinara i ljubitelja prirode. Kanarski otoci smješteni su 100 km ispred afričke obale, a kao španjolski teritorij dio su Europske unije. Upravo je taj mali, idilični otok bio polazna točka legendarnog istraživačkog putovanja Kristofa Kolumba koji je odavde krenuo u potragu za Indijom i slučajno otkrio Ameriku.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: The buyers in this episode want a new home in either Hampshire or Dorset because it's only important to them that it's close to what they love most, the sea. Denise Nurse will try to make them happy and also meet a family from Hampshire who live like a dream in an idyllic Georgian house. / Kupci u ovoj epizode žele novi dom bilo u Hampshireu ili Dorsetu jer važno im je samo da bude blizu onoga što najviše vole, mora. Denise Nurse će ih pokušati usrećiti, a također će upoznati obitelji iz Hampshirea koja živi kao u snu u idiličnoj georgijanskoj kući.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
