programme.desc: An actor climbs the property ladder on four wheels _ he transforms a Luton truck into a two-bed luxury flat. We will also see an underground cafe covered with shells. And there's also a train car that functions as a pet-friendly rental space. / Jedan glumac uspinje se na nekretninskoj ljestvici na četiri kotača _ uređuje kamion modela Luton u dvokrevetni luksuzni stančić. Vidjet ćemo i podzemni kafić prekriven školjkama. A tu je i željeznički vagon koji funkcionira kao prostor za najam u kojemu su kućni ljubimci dobrodošli.

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers something specific to Yucatán. She joins the Amazonas softball team, made up of indigenous women, for their morning practice. Over time, they became a highly respected club and overcame stereotypes. / U Yaxunahu Pati otkriva nešto specifično za Yucatán. Pridružuje se softball timu Amazonas, sastavljenom od domorotkinja, na njihovom jutarnjem treningu. S vremenom su postale vrlo cijenjen klub i pobijedile stereotipe.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Judges Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae compare contestants from Central England and the Midlands in this episode. They visit a garden in Cambridgeshire where the American owner has spared no effort to shape his vision of English rural perfection. In Nottinghamshire, they find tranquility in a garden arranged around a natural pond, and in Oxfordshire, they explore a garden on a plot in a city garden. The beautifully decorated space reflects the true gardening love and passion. And behind a seemingly ordinary home in the suburbs of Walsall, the jury discovers a garden that is anything but ordinary. / Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi uspoređuju natjecatelje iz središnje Engleske i Midlandsa. Posjećuju vrt u Cambridgeshireu gdje vlasnik Amerikanac nije štedio truda kako bi oblikovao svoju viziju engleskog ruralnog savršenstva. U Nottinghamshireu pronalaze spokoj u vrtu koji je uređen oko prirodnog jezerca, a u Oxfordshireu razgledavaju vrt na parceli u gradskom vrtu. U krasno uređenom prostoru ogledaju se istinska vrtlarska ljubav i strast. A iza naizgled običnog doma u predgrađu u Walsallu žiri otkriva vrt koji je sve drugo nego običan.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: In this episode, Michel will organize a real feast. A visit to a restaurant on the Mediterranean coast will inspire an appetizer based on smoked fish. Beef cheek stew will serve as the main course, and salted caramel tart with walnuts for dessert. / U ovoj epizodi Michel će organizirati pravu gozbu. Posjet restoranu na mediteranskoj obali nadahnut će predjelo na bazi dimljene ribe. Za glavno poslužit će gulaš od goveđih obraza, a za desert tart od slane karamele s orasima.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: After the murder of a former student at Oxford University, detectives Hathaway and Lewis are involved in a very delicate case involving some of the university's most prominent employees. When they find out, however, that some of them were not as respected 20 years ago as they are today, and that they were members of some secret societies with the victim, Lewis and Hathaway will realize that nothing is as it seemed at first... / Nakon ubojstva bivšega studenta sveučilišta u Oxfordu detektivi Hathaway i Lewis upleteni su u vrlo delikatan slučaj koji uključuje neke od najprominentnijih djelatnika sveučilišta. Kada saznaju, međutim, da neki od njih prije 20 godina nisu bili tako cijenjeni kao danas, te da su s žrtvom bili članovi nekih tajnih društava, Lewis i Hathaway shvatit će da ništa nije onako kako im se isprva činilo...

programme.title: Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: From October 12 to 19, 2025, Zadar will host the 44th European Team Table Tennis Championship, where 24 men's national teams will compete in the group and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik hall brings top-class sport, tension and spectacular encounters in the quest for the title. / Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov.

programme.title: Rekreacija
programme.desc: We are taking you to Petrinja to the Chestnut Festival and Mountaineering Chestnut Festival _ an event that successfully combines tradition, sport and hiking, gastronomy and music in one unforgettable experience in two days. We were also at the Zagreb Marathon, which gathered as many as 5,019 runners from almost 80 countries around the world. We investigated who the pacers are and what their role is in the success of the race. We also bring a story about outdoor training _ at training grounds that are springing up in more and more Croatian cities. And in our permanent section From the gym, we present a series of new, useful exercises to strengthen muscles and improve body stability. / Vodimo vas u Petrinju na Festival kestena i planinarsku kestenijadu _ manifestaciju koja u dva dana uspješno spaja tradiciju, sport i planinarenje, gastronomiju i glazbu u jedno nezaboravno iskustvo. Bili smo i na Zagrebačkom maratonu, koji je okupio čak 5019 trkača iz gotovo 80 zemalja svijeta. Istražili smo tko su pejseri i kakva je njihova uloga u uspjehu na utrci. Donosimo i priču o treningu na otvorenom _ na vježbalištima koja niču u sve više hrvatskih gradova. A u našoj stalnoj rubrici Iz teretane predstavljamo niz novih, korisnih vježbi za jačanje mišića i poboljšanje stabilnosti tijela.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: While the world public considered Victoria Beckham to be nobility, she _ was swimming in debt! In addition to the unexpected recognition of the famous spice, we also bring news about the new projects of Scarlett Johansson, Julia Roberts, Idris Elba and Keira Knightley. While presenting new films, Hollywood stars do not spare praise when it comes to the actress who left us in the week after us, the inimitable Diane Keaton. / Dok je svjetska javnost Victoriju Beckham smatrala plemstvom, ona je _ plivala u dugovima! Osim neočekivanog priznanja poznate spajsice, donosimo i novosti o novim projektima Scarlett Johansson, Julije Roberts, Idrisa Elbe i Keire Knightley. Dok predstavljaju nove filmove, holivudske zvijezde ne štede pohvale kada je riječ o glumici koja nas je napustila u tjednu za nama, neponovljivoj Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben travels to the Shetland Islands, one of the most isolated spots in Britain. He will visit Helen and Jason, a couple who have been living on the island of Yell for several years. They will discover why they gave up life in the city and see what obstacles they face as they realize their dream of living on this beautiful island far from civilization. Ben's hosts devote a lot of time to the physically demanding renovation of the house, and at the same time cultivate 10 hectares of land. They admit that sometimes they have too much work. Ben will shear sheep, lay water pipes, weave woolen rugs and extract peat with them. / Ben putuje na Shetlandsko otočje, jednu od najizoliranijih točaka Britanije. Posjetit će Helen i Jasona, par koji već nekoliko godina živi na otoku Yellu. Otkrit će zašto su odustali od života u gradu i vidjeti s kakvim se preprekama suočavaju dok ostvaruju san o životu na ovom lijepom otoku daleko od civilizacije. Benovi domaćini mnogo vremena posvećuju fizički zahtjevnoj obnovi kuće, a usto obrađuju i 10 hektara zemlje. Priznaju da katkad imaju previše posla. Ben će s njima šišati ovce, polagati vodovodne cijevi, tkati vunene sagove i vaditi treset.

programme.title: Krimi petak: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea
programme.desc: The son of a rich entrepreneur and the grandson of an even richer grandfather was kidnapped while he was visiting a museum in Naples with his class. He is locked in a dark and cold basement, and his only companion is a stuffed superhero toy. The investigation is in the dark. The Bastards, more than ever before, will have to act as one to break through the pile of lies and hatred, as they try to find out the fate of the child. / Sin bogatog poduzetnika i unuk još bogatijeg djeda otet je dok je s razredom išao u posjet muzeju u Napulju. Zatvoren je u mračni i hladni podrum, a jedino mu je društvo plišana igračka superjunaka. Istraga tapka u mraku. Bastardi će, više nego ikad dosad, morati djelovati jedinstveno kako bi se probili kroz gomilu laži i mržnje, dok pokušavaju saznati sudbinu djeteta.

programme.title: Krimi petak: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: Dead and dying people were found in an abandoned truck in a quarry. At first it seems to be about people smuggling, but it soon becomes clear that the story is not what it seems. The survivors refuse to cooperate, so Nikki and the team must apply their expertise to identify the victims and discover what really happened. Gabriel gets especially involved, which causes him to face an ethical dilemma, and Jack is surprised by an unexpected visit. / U napuštenom kamionu u kamenolomu pronađeni su mrtvi i ljudi na samrti. U početku se čini da je riječ o krijumčarenju ljudi, no ubrzo postaje jasno da priča nije onakva kakvom se doima. Preživjeli odbijaju surađivati, pa Nikki i ekipa moraju primijeniti svoje stručno znanje kako bi identificirali žrtve i otkrili što se zapravo dogodilo. Gabriel se posebno angažira, zbog čega se nađe pred etičkom dilemom, a Jacka iznenađuje neočekivan posjet.

programme.title: Plot crime: Mode / Krimi petak: Modus
programme.desc: Warren fails to convince the other FBI agents of her theory as to what is behind the president's disappearance. Inger Johanne finds herself in an awkward situation when she realizes that Helen Tyler doesn't want anyone to find her. / Warren ne uspijeva uvjeriti ostale FBI-jevce u svoju teoriju što se krije iza predsjedničina nestanka. Inger Johanne nađe se u nezgodnoj situaciji kad shvati da Helen Tyler ne želi da je itko pronađe.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: After the murder of a former student at Oxford University, detectives Hathaway and Lewis are involved in a very delicate case involving some of the university's most prominent employees. When they find out, however, that some of them were not as respected 20 years ago as they are today, and that they were members of some secret societies with the victim, Lewis and Hathaway will realize that nothing is as it seemed at first... / Nakon ubojstva bivšega studenta sveučilišta u Oxfordu detektivi Hathaway i Lewis upleteni su u vrlo delikatan slučaj koji uključuje neke od najprominentnijih djelatnika sveučilišta. Kada saznaju, međutim, da neki od njih prije 20 godina nisu bili tako cijenjeni kao danas, te da su s žrtvom bili članovi nekih tajnih društava, Lewis i Hathaway shvatit će da ništa nije onako kako im se isprva činilo...

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Discovering that they have mold in their apartment, Erica and Geoff have to stay with the Goldbergs for a while. Beverly senses tension in their relationship and takes the opportunity to give them some marriage advice. / Otkrivši da imaju plijesan u stanu, Erica i Geoff moraju neko vrijeme boraviti kod Goldbergovih. Beverly osjeti napetost u njihovu odnosu i iskoristi priliku da im da pokoji bračni savjet.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam has finally graduated and everyone is ready for the graduation ceremony; everyone except Beverly, who can't accept that her house will be empty. With Geoff's encouragement, Erica decides to take the stage again and sing backing vocals. / Adam je napokon maturirao i svi su spremni za dodjelu diploma; svi osim Beverly, koja ne može prihvatiti da će joj kuća biti prazna. Uz Geoffovo ohrabrenje, Erica odluči opet stati na pozornicu i pjevati prateći vokal.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: When Galerija f8 was opened seven years ago on the eve of Christmas at Trg Republike Hrvatska at number 8, the photography students of the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb received the most beautiful holiday present. In the past seven years, we have seen more than 40 exhibitions at that address, which gathered numerous visitors. And this is confirmation that Galerija f8 has outgrown the student gallery story and that it has become an important place that was missing on the Croatian photography and art scene. These days, due to the danger of the facade collapsing and cracked sculptures on the building, the Gallery had to move out. The agile professors and students of the Department of Photography arranged a new exhibition space in the immediate vicinity and thus continued this beautiful gallery story. In the studio about the ADU Gallery and Department of Photography, we talk with professor Jelena Blagović and photographer Gloria Lizde. And we were also at an interesting exam exhibition of photography students Vid Redža and David Bakarić Mihaljević. / Kada je prije sedam godina uoči Božića na Trgu Republike Hrvatske na broju 8 otvorena Galerija f8, studenti fotografije zagrebačke Akademije dramske umjetnosti dobili su najljepši blagdanski poklon. U proteklih sedam godina na toj smo adresi vidjeli više od 40 izložbi koje su okupljale brojne posjetitelje. A to je potvrda da je Galerija f8 prerasla studentsku galerijsku priču te da je postala važno mjesto koje je nedostajalo na hrvatskoj fotografskoj i umjetničkoj sceni. Ovih dana zbog opasnosti od urušavanja fasade i napuklih skulptura na zgradi Galerija se morala iseliti. Agilni profesori i studenti Katedre za fotografiju uredili su u neposrednoj blizini novi izložbeni prostor i tako nastavili ovu lijepu galerijsku priču. U studiju o Galeriji i Katedri za fotografiju ADU razgovaramo s profesoricom Jelenom Blagović i fotografkinjom Glorijom Lizde. A bili smo i na zanimljivoj ispitnoj izložbi studenata fotografije Vida Redže i Davida Bakarića Mihaljevića.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: After Murray's death, Adam, Barry and Erica return home to be with their mother. Adam postpones going to college and decides to pursue film, Barry is on his way to becoming a doctor, Erica and Geoff become parents, and Beverly prepares for the most important role in life _ that of a grandmother! The new season brings a handful of exciting plots as family members try to navigate their new roles, and Uncle Marvin and Grandpa make an unexpected statement. --- Everyone lives together again, so the usual chaos reigns in the Goldberg house. Pregnant Erica asks Beverly to help her make room for the new baby, and Adam and Barry have to share a room so the baby can have its own. / Nakon Murrayeve smrti, Adam, Barry i Erica vraćaju se kući kako bi bili uz majku. Adam odgađa odlazak na studij i odlučuje se baviti filmom, Barry je na putu da postane liječnik, Erica i Geoff postaju roditelji, a Beverly se priprema za najvažniju ulogu u životu _ onu bake! Nova sezona donosi pregršt uzbudljivih zapleta dok se članovi obitelji pokušavaju snaći u svojim novim ulogama, a stric Marvin i djed neočekivano se iskažu. --- Svi ponovno žive zajedno pa u kući Goldbergovih vlada uobičajeni kaos. Trudna Erica zamoli Beverly da joj pomogne napraviti mjesta za prinovu, a Adam i Barry moraju dijeliti sobu kako bi beba dobila svoju.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam is afraid that Beverly will find it hard for him to go to college, so he tries to find a job in their town. Erica and Geoff keep debating whether they want to find out the gender of the baby. / Adam se boji da će Beverly teško pasti njegov odlazak na fakultet pa pokušava pronaći posao u njihovom gradiću. Erica i Geoff stalno se premišljaju oko toga žele li saznati spol djeteta.

programme.title: Dom na kvadrat
programme.desc: We bring all the novelties presented at this year's NnDizajn fair held in Zagreb. From shower channels, quiet luxury and furniture made of quartz and porcelain, to products of small craftsmen. / Donosimo sve novitete predstavljene na ovogodišnjem NnDizajn sajmu održanom u Zagrebu. Od tuš kanalica, tihog luksuza i namještaja od kvarca i porculana, do proizvoda malih obrtnika.

programme.title: Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Koordinacija
programme.desc: We present a new column _ Master's surgery! The master of this practice is Doctor DS, also known as David Skrbin. He is followed on YouTube by almost three million do-it-yourself project enthusiasts, and he will demonstrate equally useful procedures in the Master's surgery. It was easier to build a new one than to restore the old one! We find out what were the biggest challenges during the reconstruction of the first tube of the Učka tunnel. The guest of the Notes column is Dario Silić, the general manager of Bina Istra, the concessionaire of Istrian ipsilon. We bring you a story about a famous Croatian stone _ and no, it's not from Brač! In the Tips And Tricks column, we deal with furnishing the bathroom. / Predstavljamo novu rubriku _ Majstorska ordinacija! Majstor ove ordinacije je Doctor DS, poznat i kao David Skrbin. Na YouTubeu ga prati gotovo tri milijuna zaljubljenika u uradi sam projekte, a jednako korisne zahvate pokazat će i u Majstorskoj ordinaciji. Jednostavnije je bilo izgraditi novu nego obnoviti staru! Doznajemo koji su bili najveći izazovi tijekom obnove prve cijevi tunela Učka. Gost rubrike Notes je Dario Silić, generalni direktor Bina Istre, koncesionara Istarskog ipsilona. Donosimo priču o jednom poznatom hrvatskom kamenu _ i ne, nije brački! U rubrici Tips And Tricks bavimo se opremanjem kupaonice.

programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Every week, the show for car enthusiasts presents new car models, technological innovations, tests new vehicles, and provides advice on maintenance. / U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: The Ainsworth family and their guests head to the local casino to celebrate, and Luciano's relationship with Rose reaches a breaking point. Bella tries to contain the consequences, but she is hindered by the jealous showdown between Cecil and Marc and the outburst of mad manly courage that threatens the future of the hotel, as well as the need to deal with Constance's family problems. Bella must act decisively to save everything she has invested in the Portofino Hotel, but at what cost to her relationships and those of her children? / Obitelj Ainsworth i njihovi gosti kreću na proslavu u mjesni kasino, a Lucianov odnos s Rose doseže kritičnu točku. Bella pokušava obuzdati posljedice, ali u tome je ometa ljubomorni obračun između Cecila i Marca te ispad lude muške hrabrosti koji prijeti budućnosti hotela, kao i potreba da se uhvati u koštac s Constanceinim obiteljskim problemima. Bella mora odlučno djelovati kako bi spasila sve što je uložila u hotel Portofino, ali pod koju cijenu za svoje veze i veze svoje djece?

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: While trying to get out of town unnoticed after spending the night with her lover Marco, Bella Ainsworth runs into the leader of the local fascists, Danioni. Bella has an excuse ready, but it's clear that Danioni doesn't believe her. During this time, the hotel is preparing for the arrival of Bella's father George and sister Amelia. But Bella's plans fall apart when Cecil suddenly shows up, followed shortly by George and Amelia. As Bella tries to cope with her demanding father and bitter sister, Cecil shocks her by suggesting they break up. It's also exciting among the servants because Constance meets the pharmacist Vita, who likes her, but because of many secrets from her past, Constance doesn't know how to behave. Betty is also enjoying love and preparing for her engagement to Salvatore. Amelia takes Alice to Genoa to try to awaken her former spirit, but Alice is shocked to meet her former suitor Count Carlo Albani. During this time, Bella is seriously considering a divorce, but Cecil tells her that she will have to publicly admit to adultery. Bella gets angry and doesn't know what to do. / Dok pokušava neopaženo otići iz mjesta nakon što je provela noć sa svojim ljubavnikom Marcom, Bella Ainsworth naleti na vođu mjesnih fašista Danionija. Bella ima spreman izgovor, ali jasno je da joj Danioni ne vjeruje. Za to se vrijeme hotel priprema za dolazak Bellina oca Georgea i sestre Amelije. No Bellini planovi padaju u vodu kad se iznebuha pojavi Cecil, a ubrzo nakon njega i George i Amelia. Dok Bella pokušava izaći na kraj sa svojim zahtjevnim ocem i ogorčenom sestrom, Cecil je šokira prijedlogom da se rastanu. Uzbudljivo je i među poslugom jer Constance upoznaje ljekarnika Vitu kojemu se svidi, ali zbog mnogo tajni iz svoje prošlosti Constance ne zna kako bi se ponašala. Betty također uživa u ljubavi i priprema se za zaruke sa Salvatoreom. Amelia odvede Alice u Genovu kako bi pokušala probuditi njezin nekadašnji duh, no Alice šokira susret s bivšim udvaračem grofom Carlom Albanijem. Za to vrijeme Bella ozbiljno razmišlja o rastavi, ali Cecil joj kaže da će morati javno priznati preljub. Bella se razbjesni i ne zna što bi.

programme.title: Svijet vrtlara
programme.desc: In the dry garden, Monty transplants common iris, takes apart the greenhouse for winter salad and harvests quinces. As part of the major modernization of the Village Garden, he transplants bushes into the Orchard and shows us how collecting and saving seeds from plants from the garden can save money. Arit Anderson explores the arguments for and against artificial grass. Deep in the beautiful rural landscape of Wales, Toby Buckland discovers a rich and tranquil Japanese garden. We go to the garden of Andrew Clifton, who repurposes and recycles a wide range of materials to create a wonderful Secret Garden in Nottingham. We are also with gardeners Steve Edney and Louise Dowle, who have planted the entire flowerbed with plants that, with their structure and shapes, not only create stunning winter scenes, but also leave seeds for the next one every year. In addition, we bring more videos about gardens sent to us by viewers. / Monty u Suhom vrtu presađuje običnu peruniku, rasprema staklenik za zimsku salatu i bere dunje. U sklopu velike modernizacije Seoskog vrta, presađuje grmlje u Voćnjak i pokazuje nam kako se skupljanjem i čuvanjem sjemena od biljaka iz vrta može uštedjeti novac. Arit Anderson istražuje koji argumenti govore za, a koji protiv umjetne trave. Toby Buckland duboko u prekrasnom ruralnom krajobrazu Walesa otkriva bogat i smiren japanski vrt. Odlazimo u vrt Andrewa Cliftona, koji prenamjenjuje i reciklira široki spektar materijala i stvara predivan Tajni vrt u Nottinghamu. Nalazimo se i s vrtlarima Steveom Edneyjem i Louiseom Dowle koji su zasadili cijelu gredicu biljkama koje svojom strukturom i oblicima stvaraju ne samo zapanjujuće zimske prizore, već im i svake godine ostavljaju sjeme za iduću. Osim toga donosimo još videouradaka o vrtovima koje nam šalju gledatelji.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Grantchester
programme.desc: Sidney is seduced by the growing movement for black civil rights when an American pastor, the Reverend Todd, and his daughter Violet come to Cambridge, and thanks to a murder, racial intolerance grows. / Sidneyja zavede rastući pokret za crnačka građanska prava kad u Cambridge dođe američki pastor velečasni Todd i njegova kći Violet, a zahvaljujući jednom ubojstvu, poraste rasna netrpeljivost.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea
programme.desc: The son of a rich entrepreneur and the grandson of an even richer grandfather was kidnapped while he was visiting a museum in Naples with his class. He is locked in a dark and cold basement, and his only companion is a stuffed superhero toy. The investigation is in the dark. The Bastards, more than ever before, will have to act as one to break through the pile of lies and hatred, as they try to find out the fate of the child. / Sin bogatog poduzetnika i unuk još bogatijeg djeda otet je dok je s razredom išao u posjet muzeju u Napulju. Zatvoren je u mračni i hladni podrum, a jedino mu je društvo plišana igračka superjunaka. Istraga tapka u mraku. Bastardi će, više nego ikad dosad, morati djelovati jedinstveno kako bi se probili kroz gomilu laži i mržnje, dok pokušavaju saznati sudbinu djeteta.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: Dead and dying people were found in an abandoned truck in a quarry. At first it seems to be about people smuggling, but it soon becomes clear that the story is not what it seems. The survivors refuse to cooperate, so Nikki and the team must apply their expertise to identify the victims and discover what really happened. Gabriel gets especially involved, which causes him to face an ethical dilemma, and Jack is surprised by an unexpected visit. / U napuštenom kamionu u kamenolomu pronađeni su mrtvi i ljudi na samrti. U početku se čini da je riječ o krijumčarenju ljudi, no ubrzo postaje jasno da priča nije onakva kakvom se doima. Preživjeli odbijaju surađivati, pa Nikki i ekipa moraju primijeniti svoje stručno znanje kako bi identificirali žrtve i otkrili što se zapravo dogodilo. Gabriel se posebno angažira, zbog čega se nađe pred etičkom dilemom, a Jacka iznenađuje neočekivan posjet.

programme.title: Karl Lagerfeld: Razotkrivanje
programme.desc: While his longtime rival Yves Saint-Laurent was experiencing a series of life successes, Karl decided to take a different path. He became an advocate of ready-to-wear and distanced himself from Yves and his efforts to become an artist and haute couture designer. Saint-Laurent and Pierre Berge despised him for his understanding of fashion as a commodity. And Lagerfeld despised them with all his heart. In 1972, at the age of 39, Lagerfeld fell in love for the first time when he met Jacques de Bascher. Lagerfeld and Saint-Laurent's business rivalry became personal when Jacques cheated on him with Yves. / Dok je njegov dugogodišnji suparnik Yves Saint-Laurent doživljavao niz životnih uspjeha, Karl je odlučio poći drugim putem. Postao je zagovornik konfekcije i udaljio se od Yvesa i njegovih nastojanja da postane umjetnik i dizajner visoke mode. Saint-Laurent i Pierre Berge prezirali su ga zbog njegova shvaćanja mode kao robe. A i Lagerfeld je njih prezirao iz sveg srca. Godine 1972., u 39. godini života, Lagerfeld se prvi put zaljubio kad je upoznao Jacquesa de Baschera. Poslovno suparništvo Lagerfelda i Saint-Laurenta postalo je i osobno kad ga je Jacques prevario s Yvesom.

programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Sunday afternoons are again cheered up by the team of the show Volim Hrvatska. The captains are Dušan Bućan and Goran Navojec. In the fourth show, they will compete: in Dušan's team Lovro Juraga, Iva Šimić Šakoronja and Ivana Starčević, and in Goran's team Natali Radovčić, Matija Šakoronja and Mario Kovač. Contestants will try their hand at well-known games such as Guess the Song, Happy Birthday, TV and Film, Sport, Famous Compatriots, Shufflers, Average Citizen and Word Croatian. The show is hosted by Mirko Fodor. The hits of local music are performed live by the band Ante Gele. / Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U četvrtoj emisiji snage će odmjeriti: u Dušanovom timu Lovro Juraga, Iva Šimić Šakoronja i Ivana Starčević, a u Goranovom timu Natali Radovčić, Matija Šakoronja i Mario Kovač. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: The fries were cold, the waiter was hot! A review like this makes the chef angry, but makes the restaurant owner happy. Satisfying hungry tourists is one of the biggest challenges. Gastronomy is the area where reviews are the most peppery, but also the most powerful. In just a few clicks, guests can launch a restaurant to the very top of the rankings, or leave it eerily empty. Is our sea enough for Croatian gastronomy to get five stars? / Pomfrit je bio hladan, konobar je bio vatren! Recenzija poput ove naljuti glavnog kuhara, ali razveseli vlasnika restorana. Zadovoljiti gladne turiste jedan je od najvećih izazova. Gastronomija je područje gdje su recenzije najpaprenije, ali i najmoćnije. U samo nekoliko klikova gosti mogu lansirati restoran na sam vrh ljestvice, ili ga ostaviti sablasno praznim. Je li naše more dovoljno da hrvatska gastroponuda dobije pet zvjezdica?

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: Krunoslav Pokas' participation in "Action Camorra" will bring him face to face with a known dangerous criminal. See what encounters with dangerous criminals look like and what a man feels when he has to reach for the last option _ take out his own gun. / Sudjelovanje u "Akciji Camorra" Krunoslava Pokasa dovest će oči u oči s poznatim opasnim počiniteljem. Pogledajte kako izgledaju susreti s opasnim kriminalcima te što čovjek osjeća kada mora posegnuti za zadnjom opcijom _ izvaditi svoj vlastiti pištolj.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Kristijan Iličić's journey through Ethiopia begins in Harar, one of the holy cities of Islam. Harar is known for the coexistence of humans and hyenas, so Kristijan meets a pack of wild hyenas that clean the city at night, feeding on garbage. Visiting Gondar, the former seat of Ethiopian rulers, Kristijan finds himself in a conflict zone between the army and the rebels. Despite the danger of war, he climbs Mount Semien to find gelada monkeys, a unique species of primate that lives only in that location. He briefly visits Lalibella, the holy city of Ethiopian Christians, with the so-called eighth wonder of the world _ in the rock carved Church of St. Jurja. Arriving in the modern metropolis of Addis Ababa, Kristijan explores the past and present of the big city _ he hangs out with the rap star Kassmasse, but also visits the castle of Emperor Menelik, where the Seljan brothers stayed 125 years ago. / Putovanje Etiopijom Kristijan Iličić počinje u Hararu, jednom od svetih gradova islama. Harar je poznat po suživotu ljudi i hijena pa tako i Kristijan susreće čopor divljih hijena koje noću čiste grad hraneći se otpacima. Posjećujući Gondar, bivše sjedište etiopskih vladara, Kristijan se nađe u zoni sukoba vojske i pobunjenika. Unatoč ratnoj opasnosti, penje se na planinu Semien kako bi pronašao majmune gelade, jedinstvenu vrstu primata koja živi samo na toj lokaciji. Nakratko posjeti Lalibellu, sveti grad etiopskih kršćana, s tzv. osmim svjetskim čudom _ u stijenu uklesanom Crkvom sv. Jurja. Dolaskom u modernu metropolu Addis Abebu, Kristijan istražuje prošlost i sadašnjost velikog grada _ druži se s rap zvijezdom Kassmasseom, ali i posjećuje dvorac cara Menelika, u kojem su prije 125 godina boravila braća Seljan.

programme.title: Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: From October 12 to 19, 2025, Zadar will host the 44th European Team Table Tennis Championship, where 24 men's national teams will compete in the group and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik hall brings top-class sport, tension and spectacular encounters in the quest for the title. / Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: Bourdain dives into the gastronomic scene at a crossroads: on the one hand, a recognizable steel town defined by working-class food _ steaks and potatoes, sausages and sauerkraut _ and on the other, a city on the rise attracting a foodie crowd thanks to a new high-tech industry. Bourdain crosses the divide between old and new, hanging out with, among others, professional wrestlers, civil rights activists, and author and native Pittsburgher Stewart ONan. The pioneering chefs of the new restaurant scene, Sonja Finn and Justin Severino, are roasting suckling pig out of town, and chef Kevin Sousa is serving up pasture-fed ribs at his new Superior Motors restaurant. / Bourdain zaranja u gastronomsku scenu na raskrižju: s jedne strane, prepoznatljivi grad čelika definiran radničkom hranom _ odresci i krumpir, kobasice i kiseli kupus _ a s druge, grad u usponu koji privlači gurmansku publiku zahvaljujući novoj visokotehnološkoj industriji. Bourdain prelazi razdjelnice starog i novog družeći se, među ostalima, s profesionalnim hrvačima, aktivistima za građanska prava te piscem i rođenim Pitsburžaninom Stewartom ONanom. Pionirski kuhari nove restoranske scene, Sonja Finn i Justin Severino, peku odojka izvan grada, a chef Kevin Sousa poslužuje rebarca od krava hranjenih na pašnjaku u svom novom restoranu Superior Motors.

programme.title: Clarksonova farma
programme.desc: Spring is coming to the farm and it's time to let the cows and chickens out of their winter quarters. Jeremy's plans to open a restaurant fell through, but that's not the end of his run-ins with the council, who persistently send him letters questioning what is being sold in his shop. Jeremy decides to look for loopholes in the future and resort to various tricks on the edge of the law. Jeremy's best heifer Pepper is not pregnant yet, her last chance is a bull called Heartbreaker. In a conversation with Alan, the builder, it dawned on Jeremy how to make his idea for a restaurant come to life. Everyone is excited about the construction work starting, and Jeremy meets the cook, Pip. But the excitement suddenly subsides when he has to take his first bull to the slaughterhouse. / Proljeće stiže na farmu i vrijeme je da puste krave i kokoši iz njihovih zimskih nastambi. Jeremyjevi su planovi o otvaranju restorana propali, no to nije kraj njegovim okapanjima s vijećem, koje mu uporno šalje dopise u kojima propituje ono što se prodaje u njegovoj trgovini. Jeremy odlučuje ubuduće tražiti rupe u zakonu i pribjegavati raznim lukavstvima na samom rubu zakona. Jeremyjeva najbolja junica Pepper još nije steona, njezina je posljednja šansa bik zvan Srcolomac. U razgovoru s graditeljem Alanom Jeremyju sine kako da njegova ideja o restoranu ipak zaživi. Svi su uzbuđeni zbog početka građevinskih radova, a Jeremy upoznaje kuharicu Pip. No uzbuđenje naglo splasne kad mora odvesti svog prvog junca u klaonicu.

programme.title: Dalida, a woman who dreamed of a different stage / Dalida, žena koja je sanjala o drukčijoj pozornici
programme.desc: Dalida's life was not a series of hits and gossip, but a Greek tragedy. On May 3, 1987, Dalida committed suicide at the age of 54. Just before her death, she hastily wrote a few words on a piece of paper: "I can't take this life anymore. Forgive me." Then she lay down on the bed and swallowed the pills that she had carefully prepared, with a glass of alcohol to enhance their effect. After that, she turned off the lamp on the bedside table and, unlike every other night, fell asleep without the light on. It was as if for the first time in her life she was no longer afraid of the dark. Throughout her career, she was considered the most successful music hall star, the most popular artist and singer with the most performances. Could Dalida have imagined then that her songs, as well as the story of her life, which became unbearable for her, would be so special that they would outlive her in 30 years, unlike most of her colleagues who fell into oblivion after their death? Her friend Line Renaud called her "flashy and dark" in the documentary by Gerard Miller and Anaïs Feuillette, where she appears with fifteen other guests (Orlando, Serge Lama, Bertrand Delanoe, Liza Azuelos, Jean Sobieski, David Lelait-Helo, and Rosy Gigliotti, Dalidina cousin and secretary). Line says that Dalida constantly doubted herself and her love and professional life, so she always considered herself incomplete. "Who could be bound to me forever, given my job?" she said in an interview. After singing in front of thousands of ecstatic spectators and thinking the crowd would choke her, she added: "Success is scary sometimes." The documentary film by Gerard Miller and Anaïs Feuillette tells about the extraordinary fate of a woman who became famous at 20, a world star at 30, and an icon at 40. It follows all the stages of Dalida's life and career and with a somewhat Freudian analysis explains the thoughts of a woman who always followed her desire. / Život Dalide nije bio niz hitova i tračeva, nego grčka tragedija. Dana 3. svibnja 1987. Dalida se ubila u 54. godini. Netom prije smrti na brzinu je napisala na papirić nekoliko riječi: "Ne mogu više podnijeti ovaj život. Oprostite mi." Zatim je legla na krevet i progutala tablete koje je brižno pripremila, uz čašu alkohola koja im je pojačala učinak. Nakon toga ugasila je svjetiljku na noćnom ormariću i, za razliku od svih ostalih večeri, zaspala bez upaljenog svjetla. Kao da se prvi put u životu više nije bojala tame. Cijelu su je karijeru smatrali najuspješnijom zvijezdom music halla, najpopularnijom umjetnicom i pjevačicom s najviše nastupa. Je li Dalida tada mogla zamisliti da će njezine pjesme, ali i priča o njezinu životu, koji joj je postao nepodnošljiv, biti toliko posebne da će je nadživjeti za 30 godina, za razliku od većine njezinih kolega koji su nakon smrti pali u zaborav? Njezina prijateljica Line Renaud nazvala ju je "blještavom i mračnom" u dokumentarnom filmu Gerarda Millera i Anaïs Feuillette, gdje se pojavljuje uz petnaestak drugih gostiju (Orlanda, Sergea Lame, Bertranda Delanoea, Lizu Azuelos, Jeana Sobieskoga, Davida Lelait-Heloa, i Rosy Gigliotti, Dalidinu rođakinju i tajnicu). Line kaže da je Dalida neprestano sumnjala u sebe te svoj ljubavni i profesionalni život, pa se uvijek smatrala nepotpunom. "Tko bi se mogao zauvijek vezati za mene, s obzirom na moj posao?" rekla je u jednom intervjuu. Nakon što je pjevala pred tisućama zanesenih gledatelja i mislila da će je gomila ugušiti, nadodala je: "Uspjeh je katkad zastrašujuć." Dokumentarni film Gerarda Millera i Anaïs Feuillette govori o iznimnoj sudbini žene koja je s 20 godina postala poznata, s 30 svjetska zvijezda, a s 40 ikona. Slijedi sve etape Dalidina života i karijere i pomalo frojdovskom analizom objašnjava razmišljanja žene koja je uvijek slijedila svoju želju.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Sidney is seduced by the growing movement for black civil rights when an American pastor, the Reverend Todd, and his daughter Violet come to Cambridge, and thanks to a murder, racial intolerance grows. / Sidneyja zavede rastući pokret za crnačka građanska prava kad u Cambridge dođe američki pastor velečasni Todd i njegova kći Violet, a zahvaljujući jednom ubojstvu, poraste rasna netrpeljivost.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: After Murray's death, Adam, Barry and Erica return home to be with their mother. Adam postpones going to college and decides to pursue film, Barry is on his way to becoming a doctor, Erica and Geoff become parents, and Beverly prepares for the most important role in life _ that of a grandmother! The new season brings a handful of exciting plots as family members try to navigate their new roles, and Uncle Marvin and Grandpa make an unexpected statement. --- Everyone lives together again, so the usual chaos reigns in the Goldberg house. Pregnant Erica asks Beverly to help her make room for the new baby, and Adam and Barry have to share a room so the baby can have its own. / Nakon Murrayeve smrti, Adam, Barry i Erica vraćaju se kući kako bi bili uz majku. Adam odgađa odlazak na studij i odlučuje se baviti filmom, Barry je na putu da postane liječnik, Erica i Geoff postaju roditelji, a Beverly se priprema za najvažniju ulogu u životu _ onu bake! Nova sezona donosi pregršt uzbudljivih zapleta dok se članovi obitelji pokušavaju snaći u svojim novim ulogama, a stric Marvin i djed neočekivano se iskažu. --- Svi ponovno žive zajedno pa u kući Goldbergovih vlada uobičajeni kaos. Trudna Erica zamoli Beverly da joj pomogne napraviti mjesta za prinovu, a Adam i Barry moraju dijeliti sobu kako bi beba dobila svoju.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam is afraid that Beverly will find it hard for him to go to college, so he tries to find a job in their town. Erica and Geoff keep debating whether they want to find out the gender of the baby. / Adam se boji da će Beverly teško pasti njegov odlazak na fakultet pa pokušava pronaći posao u njihovom gradiću. Erica i Geoff stalno se premišljaju oko toga žele li saznati spol djeteta.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: While the world public considered Victoria Beckham to be nobility, she _ was swimming in debt! In addition to the unexpected recognition of the famous spice, we also bring news about the new projects of Scarlett Johansson, Julia Roberts, Idris Elba and Keira Knightley. While presenting new films, Hollywood stars do not spare praise when it comes to the actress who left us in the week after us, the inimitable Diane Keaton. / Dok je svjetska javnost Victoriju Beckham smatrala plemstvom, ona je _ plivala u dugovima! Osim neočekivanog priznanja poznate spajsice, donosimo i novosti o novim projektima Scarlett Johansson, Julije Roberts, Idrisa Elbe i Keire Knightley. Dok predstavljaju nove filmove, holivudske zvijezde ne štede pohvale kada je riječ o glumici koja nas je napustila u tjednu za nama, neponovljivoj Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: A weekly show in which given topics from science, art and culture, as well as social and political events that directly affect our lives, are considered by intellectuals, with moderation. / Tjedna emisija u kojoj zadane teme iz znanosti, umjetnosti i kulture te društvena i politička zbivanja koja izravno utječu na naš život promišljaju intelektualci, uz moderiranje.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly freaks out when she finds out that Adam called Brea despite his promise to stay away from her until they both settle in college. Joanne lands a coveted job at a fancy law firm in Philadelphia. / Beverly poludi kad sazna da je Adam zvao Breu unatoč obećanju da će se držati podalje od nje dok se oboje ne snađu na fakultetu. Joanne dobiva željeni posao u otmjenoj odvjetničkoj tvrtki u Philadelphiji.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Everyone talks only about the birth of the child, no one mentions Erica's degree anymore, so she wonders how much it really means in their lives. Adam and Barry argue over who will be "head of house" while Murray is gone. / Svi govore samo o rođenju djeteta, nitko više ne spominje Ericinu diplomu pa se ona zapita koliko im zapravo znači u životu. Adam i Barry prepiru se tko će biti "glava kuće" dok nema Murraya.

programme.title: Kućni ljubimci
programme.desc: In the 1800 show Pets, we visit dog breeder Rebeka Tratnik and present the shiba inu and akita inu breeds that she breeds. Anja Andrel, breeder of Bengal cats, will introduce us to a new litter of kittens. Robert Kranjčević will present the rabbits and ornamental poultry he breeds. In the veterinary clinic, we talk about bronchopneumonia in dogs. / U 1800. emisiji Kućni ljubimci u posjetu smo uzgajateljici pasa Rebeki Tratnik i predstavljamo pasmine shiba inu i akita inu koje uzgaja. Anja Andrel, uzgajateljica bengalskih mačaka, upoznat će nas s novim leglom mačića. Robert Kranjčević predstavit će nam kuniće i ukrasnu perad koju uzgaja. U veterinarskoj ambulanti govorimo o bronhopneumoniji kod pasa.

programme.title: DW: Tomorrow is today / DW: Sutrašnjica danas
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle's show about the European way of life brings interesting things from European cities. / Emisija Deutsche Wellea o europskom načinu života, donosi zanimljivosti iz europskih gradova.

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The show brings current events, new scientific discoveries, interesting facts from the animal and plant world, and social phenomena. We will look into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe either. We bring the serious, but also the more casual, fun side of science. / Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We travel Croatia in search of stories about dedication and love for work, as well as tradition in a modern guise. We also monitor the success of family farms. / Putujemo Hrvatskom u potrazi za pričama o posvećenosti i ljubavi prema poslu, kao i tradiciji u suvremenom ruhu. Usto pratimo uspjehe obiteljskih gospodarstava.

programme.title: Rekreacija
programme.desc: Recreation is a show dedicated to a healthy and active lifestyle and the entire lifestyle related to recreational activities. It is intended for a wider active community, with the aim of encouraging regular physical activity and health care. / Rekreacija je emisija posvećena zdravom i aktivnom načinu života te cjelokupnom lifestyleu vezanom uz rekreativne aktivnosti. Namijenjena je široj aktivnoj zajednici, s ciljem poticanja na redovitu tjelesnu aktivnost i brigu o zdravlju.

programme.title: Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: In the first episode, we will dive deeper into the world of Istrian truffles, but literally! Following Bubica, a curly-haired lagotti from Paladin, and her owner Ivana, we will find out the role of sniffing friends in finding this valuable food and what is hidden in the depths of the Istrian forests. Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of gourmet delights and incredible adventures with our four-legged truffle. / U prvoj epizodi zaronit ćemo dublje u svijet istarskih tartufa, ali doslovno! Prateći Bubicu, kovrčavu lagotticu iz Paladina, i njezinu vlasnicu Ivanu, doznat ćemo koja je uloga njuškajućih prijatelja u pronalasku ove vrijedne namirnice i što se to krije u dubinama istarskih šuma. Pripremite se za uzbudljivo putovanje kroz svijet gurmanskih užitaka i nevjerojatnih pustolovina s našom četveronožnom tartufarkom.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: After Marco's proposal, Bella goes on an adventure with Claudine to decide what to do with her future. Constance goes out with Vito and tells him about Tommy, but he's understanding. Alice is enraged when Count Albani rejects her courtship. With Claudine's help, Bella confesses her feelings to Marc and finally tells her family about the breakup. Meanwhile, Betty's engagement celebration is interrupted by the shocking return of Lucian, Billy and a new guest. / Nakon Marcove prosidbe Bella odlazi u pustolovinu s Claudine kako bi odlučila što će sa svojom budućnošću. Constance izlazi s Vitom i kaže mu za Tommyja, ali on ima razumijevanja. Alice se razbjesni kad grof Albani odbije njezino udvaranje. Uz Claudineinu pomoć Bella priznaje Marcu svoje osjećaje i konačno kaže obitelji za rastavu. Za to vrijeme proslavu Bettynih zaruka prekida šokantni povratak Luciana, Billyja i novog gosta.

programme.title: Upoznajte Johna Doea
programme.desc: Social drama with elements of humor. After the newspaper where he works is bought by right-wing tycoon D.B. Norton (E. Arnold), who changes the name of the paper to The New Bulletin, journalist Ann Mitchell (B. Stanwyck) soon finds herself among those to whom editor-in-chief Henry Connell (J. Gleason) decides to hand out layoffs. In order to avoid losing her job, Ann publishes in her last column a fictional letter from the non-existent John Doe, a supposedly disgruntled and bitter citizen who threatens to jump off the city hall building at exactly midnight on Christmas Eve to protest the rot in the world. After the letter intrigues local politicians and attracts enormous public attention, which causes the newspaper's circulation to grow uncontrollably, editor Ann offers big money in exchange for a series of articles about John Doe. And when she confesses to him that it is a fictional character, Connell agrees to help her find the man she will present to the public as John Doe. Their choice soon falls on former baseball player, now homeless and vagabond Long John Willoughby (G. Cooper). An excellent humorous social drama by the legendary Frank Capra ("The Bridegroom Comes", "A Wonderful Life"), nominated for an Oscar in 1942 for the best original story, which was translated into a screenplay by the director's frequent collaborator Robert Riskin ("It Happened One Night", "You Carry Nothing to the Grave"), the adaptation of the story "The Life and Death of John Doe" by Richard Connell and Robert Pressnell Sr., based on Connell's 1922 newspaper article "A Reputation." The final chapter of Capra's kind of trilogy, rounded off by the films "Mr. Deeds Goes to Town" and "Mr. Smith Goes to Washington", in which the author enriched the screwball comedy with shrewd social and political details, is on the one hand a populist story with an ordinary "little" man as a typical Caprian hero in the center, and on the other a subtle call to viewers to immediately before entering Americans enter World War II against pro-Nazi forces in their own country. In this sense, it is also an emphatically socially sensitized and enlightening work, also the first project that Capra realized in an independent production in partnership with the screenwriter Robert Riskin, and after the termination of cooperation with the Columbia Pictures studio, which was tyrannically led by Harry Cohn. Here, too, the director's idealism and faith in the common man are emphasized, which is excellently interpreted by three-time Oscar winner G. Cooper ("Sergeant York", "At Noon"), and whose partner is the brilliant B. Stanwyck ("Fireball", "Double Deception"), who in 1982 was crowned with an honorary Academy Award for unique contribution to film acting. / Socijalna drama s elementima humora. Nakon što novine u kojima radi kupi desno orijentirani tajkun D.B. Norton (E. Arnold), koji naziv lista promijeni u The New Bulletin, novinarka Ann Mitchell (B. Stanwyck) ubrzo se nađe među onima kojima glavni urednik Henry Connell (J. Gleason) odluči podijeliti otkaze. Da bi izbjegla gubitak posla, Ann u svojoj posljednjoj kolumni objavi izmišljeno pismo nepostojećeg Johna Doa, navodnog nezadovoljnog i ogorčenog građanina koji prijeti da će na Badnjak točno u ponoć u znak protesta protiv truleži u svijetu skočiti sa zgrade gradske vijećnice. Nakon što pismo zaintrigira lokalne političare i privuče golemu pozornost javnosti, zbog čega naklada novina počne nezadrživo rasti, urednik Ann ponudi veliki novac u zamjenu za seriju tekstova o Johnu Doeu. A kad mu ona prizna da je to izmišljeni lik, Connell joj pristane pomoći u pronalaženju čovjeka kojeg će javnosti predstaviti kao Johna Doea. Njihov izbor ubrzo padne na nekadašnjeg igrača bejzbola, a sad beskućnika i skitnicu Long Johna Willoughbyja (G. Cooper). Izvrsna humorna socijalna drama legendarnog Franka Capre ("Dolazi mladoženja", "Divan život"), godine 1942. nominirana za Oscara za najbolju izvornu priču koju je u scenarij pretočio redateljev čest suradnik Robert Riskin ("Dogodilo se jedne noći", "U grob ništa ne nosiš"), iznimno je uspjela adaptacija priče "Život i smrt Johna Doea" Richarda Connella i Roberta Pressnella Sr.-a, temeljene na Connellovom novinskom tekstu "A Reputation" iz 1922. godine. Zaključno poglavlje Caprine svojevrsne trilogije koju zaokružuju filmovi "Gospodin Deeds ide u grad" i "Gospodin Smith ide u Washington", u kojoj je autor screwball-komediju obogatio oštroumnim socijalnim i političkim detaljima, s jedne je strane populistička storija s običnim "malim" čovjekom kao tipičnim kaprijanskim junakom u središtu, a s druge suptilan poziv gledateljima da se neposredno pred ulazak Amerike u Drugi svjetski rat suprotstave pronacističkim snagama u vlastitoj zemlji. U tom je smislu riječ i o naglašeno socijalno senzibiliziranom i osvješćujućem djelu, ujedno i prvom projektu kojeg je Capra realizirao u neovisnoj produkciji u partnerstvu sa scenaristom Robertom Riskinom, a nakon prekida suradnje sa studijem Columbia Pictures koji je tiranski vodio Harry Cohn. I ovdje su naglašeni redateljev idealizam i vjera u običnog čovjeka, kojeg odlično interpretira trostruki oskarovac G. Cooper ("Narednik York", "Točno u podne"), a čija je partnerica sjajna B. Stanwyck ("Vatrena kugla", "Dvostruka obmana"), godine 1982. ovjenčana počasnom Akademijinom nagradom za jedinstveni doprinos filmskoj glumi.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: In a time that does not favor the duration of cultural programs, marking a quarter of a century of the Liburnia Jazz Festival in Opatija is an event that awakens optimism. The festival celebrated its 25th anniversary from July 4 to 6, and was preceded by the presentation of the monograph "Liburnia Jazz: 25 years", which remains a permanent document of the significance of the festival. The Liburnia Jazz Festival was the first big step into the world of jazz for many local musicians, giving them the opportunity not only to perform, but also to share the stage with big world names such as Joe Zawinul, Hiromi, Mike Stern, Richard Bona, Maria Joao, Medeski, Martin And Wood, and last year Richard Galliano. This special year, the festival emphasized its role as a meeting place _ bringing together local and foreign musicians, different cultures and musical traditions, which has always been an important component of its identity, together with music and different audiences. / U vremenu koje ne pogoduje trajanju kulturnih programa, obilježavanje četvrt stoljeća Liburnia Jazz Festivala u Opatiji događaj je koji budi optimizam. Festival je svojih 25 godina proslavio od 4. do 6. srpnja, a prethodilo mu je i predstavljanje monografije "Liburnia Jazz: 25 godina", koja ostaje trajni dokument o značaju festivala. Liburnia Jazz Festival bio je prva velika stepenica u svijet jazza za mnoge lokalne muzičare, pružajući im priliku ne samo da nastupe, nego i da dijele pozornicu s velikim svjetskim imenima poput Joea Zawinula, Hiromi, Mikea Sterna, Richarda Bone, Marie Joao, Medeskija, Martina And Wooda, a prošle godine i Richarda Galliana. Ove posebne godine festival je naglasio i svoju ulogu mjesta susreta _ okupljajući lokalne i inozemne glazbenike, različite kulture i muzičke tradicije, što je uvijek bila važna komponenta njegovog identiteta, zajedno s glazbom i različitim publikama.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film presents the authentic experience of three great personalities who, on three different continents, manage to warm human souls for the "living word" shaped by tradition into "fairy tales and stories". Australian Susan Perrow, American Perry Ground and Croatian Jasna Held testify to the "power and healing power" of the oral tradition as opposed to the damage caused exclusively by the "dead" technical mediation of stories in the 21st century. / Film predstavlja autentično iskustvo tri sjajne osobnosti koje na tri različita kontinenta uspijevaju zagrijati ljudske duše za "živu riječ" oblikovanu tradicijom u "bajke i priče". Australka Susan Perrow, Amerikanac Perry Ground i Hrvatica Jasna Held svjedoče kolika je "moć i ljekovitost" usmene tradicije nasuprot šteti koja nastaje isključivo "mrtvim" tehničkim posredovanjem priča u 21. stoljeću.

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: A scary crew has stolen Mr. Porter's donut machine, and the moto dogs are going to get it back. // A terrible team has taken over Humdinger's den where his kitties are. Moto dogs and Wild Cat have to save them. / Strašna ekipa je ukrala stroj za pečenje krafni g. Portera, a moto psići će ga vratiti natrag. // Strašna ekipa je zauzela Humdingerov brlog u kojem su njegove mace. Moto psići i Divlji Mačak ih moraju spasiti.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series I LOVE ZOO ANIMALS, we get to know the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko loves animals and learns about them by helping the garden staff. Every day is a new challenge for him because he is given a special task that he cannot do unless he learns something about the daily activities in the zoo. In this episode, Marko's task is to clean the terrarium of the firefly, but before that he will learn how and why animal housing is cleaned. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko voli životinje i uči o njima pomažući djelatnicima vrta. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može obaviti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu. U ovoj epizodi Markov zadatak je očistiti terarij paličnjaka, no prije toga naučit će kako se i zašto čiste životinjske nastambe.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu angers the other bugs when he doesn't want to share the most fun role in the game with them. / Lu naljuti druge bube kad s njima ne želi dijeliti najzabavniju ulogu u igri.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and petty mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoy and his friends, and each episode deals with a different theme. Cheerful sociables explore the world and learn new words and concepts through play. And he's having a good time along the way. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy is a small cloth toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it _ a ball of woolen balls on four legs _ and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears. Episode 1 When Muc has a sticky encounter with a roll of duct tape, Tweedy has to step on it to help and calm his frightened pet, making sure he doesn't get stuck himself. / Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc _ klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge _ koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove. 1. epizoda Kad Muc doživi ljepljivi susret s kolutom ljepljive vrpce, Tvidi mora na nju stati kako bi pomogao svome uplašenom ljubimcu i umirio ga, pazeći da se i sam ne ulijepi.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Štefi Sirenić's concert is about to start, but her stage is falling apart and her glittering tiara is broken. To replace the tiara, 123 Brojčići go to look for three golden blades of seaweed for Štefi. But on the way back they have to give up the seaweed to help the other animals. Can the team use a simple arithmetic division operation to divide them evenly and make it to the concert on time? / Koncert Štefi Sirenić samo što nije počeo, ali pozornica joj se raspada i njezina svjetlucava tijara se slomila. Da bi nadomjestili tijaru, 123 Brojčići odlaze potražiti tri zlatne vlati morske trave za Štefi. Ali na putu natrag moraju se odreći morske trave da bi pomogli drugim životinjama. Može li tim upotrijebiti jednostavnu računsku operaciju dijeljenja da bi ih ravnomjerno podijelio i stigao na vrijeme na koncert?

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: After returning the residents of Slatkograd their lost belongings, the Love Monster loses Scary Bear. / Nakon što je vratio stanovnicima Slatkograda njihove izgubljene stvari, Ljubavno Čudovište izgubi Strašnog Medu.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Mama duck tries to get her ducklings from their nest in Bitz's castle to the lake, but it's a long way, so Bitz and Bob help them. / Mama patka pokušava odvesti svoje pačiće iz njihova gnijezda u Bitzinu dvorcu do jezera, ali dug je to put pa im Bitz i Bob pomažu u tome.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: When an ankylosaur escapes into the Wasteland, Jon and Blitz go after it to bring it home, and there they spot the rogue, thieving reporter Bera. Convinced that Bero is trying to cause trouble again, Jon leads the ankylosaur past him, not realizing that Bero is actually trying to lead them to where his raptor friend is trapped in a collapsed cave. Every time Jon moves on with the lost aniklosaurus, Bero cuts them off again, which angers Jon more and more until he finally wonders why Bero is acting so strange. When he investigates, he discovers a captive raptor and apologizes to Bera for not listening to him, and calls Mina and Miguel for help. The dinoranchers join forces with Ber and the ankylosaur to rescue a captive raptor just before the rocks completely collapse, and Jon learns that even when he has an important task, he should always pay attention if someone else needs help. / Kada jedan ankilosaur pobjegne u Pustoš, Jon i Blitz kreću za njim kako bi ga vratili kući i ondje primijete nevaljalog, lopovskog rapotra Beru. Uvjeren da Bero opet pokušava stvarati nevolje, Jon vodi ankilosaura mimo njega, ne shvaćajući da ih Bero zapravo pokušava odvesti do mjesta gdje je njegova prijateljica raptorica zarobljena u urušenoj spilji. Svaki put kad Jon krene dalje s izgubljenim aniklosaurom, Bero im ponovno presiječe put, što Jona sve više ljuti dok se napokon ne zapita zašto se Bero ponaša tako čudno. Kad istraži, otkrije zarobljenu raptoricu i ispriča se Beri što ga nije poslušao, te poziva Mina i Miguela u pomoć. Dinorančeri udružuju snage s Berom i ankilosurom kako bi spasili zarobljenu raptoricu netom prije nego što se stijene u potpunosti uruše, a Jon nauči da, čak i kad ima važan zadatak, uvijek treba obratiti pozornost ako netko drugi treba pomoć.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song I'll do it all by myself, you'll meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mehapomagači
programme.desc: A mysterious "Pretty Big Thing" is scaring people away from work, so it's up to the Mechas to find what it is. However, the situation changes when they realize that the Pretty Big Thing is actually just a shadow. / Tajanstvena "Prilično velika stvar" plaši ljude pa bježe s posla, tako da je na Mehama da pronađu što je to. Međutim, situacija se promijeni kad shvate da je Prilično velika stvar zapravo samo sjena.

programme.title: Topsy i Tim
programme.desc: Topsy and Tim is a live-action drama from children's television channel CBeebies, brought to you by BAFTA award-winning creators Darrall Macqueen. The series follows the everyday adventures of cheerful twins. / Topsy i Tim živa je akcijska drama dječjeg televizijskog kanala CBeebies koju donose dobitnici nagrade BAFTA, autori produkcijske kuće Darrall Macqueen. Serija prati svakidašnje pustolovine veselih blizanaca.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo.
