Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy is a small cloth toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it _ a ball of woolen balls on four legs _ and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears. Episode 1 When Muc has a sticky encounter with a roll of duct tape, Tweedy has to step on it to help and calm his frightened pet, making sure he doesn't get stuck himself. / Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc _ klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge _ koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove. 1. epizoda Kad Muc doživi ljepljivi susret s kolutom ljepljive vrpce, Tvidi mora na nju stati kako bi pomogao svome uplašenom ljubimcu i umirio ga, pazeći da se i sam ne ulijepi.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo hears a song on the radio and wants to listen to it again, but he can't find it anymore. The animals from the Big Book help him somehow find her again. / Pablo na radiju čuje jednu pjesmu i poželi je opet slušati, ali više ne može do nje. Životinje iz Velike knjige pomognu mu da ju nekako opet nađe.

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Luce accidentally breaks Đura Huk's bowl. Edmund is sure that this one was his favorite! They definitely have to be fixed! / Luce slučajno razbije zdjelu Đure Huka. Edmund je siguran da mu je ta bila najdraža! Moraju ja svakako popraviti!

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: A scary crew has stolen Mr. Porter's donut machine, and the moto dogs are going to get it back. // A terrible team has taken over Humdinger's den where his kitties are. Moto dogs and Wild Cat have to save them. / Strašna ekipa je ukrala stroj za pečenje krafni g. Portera, a moto psići će ga vratiti natrag. // Strašna ekipa je zauzela Humdingerov brlog u kojem su njegove mace. Moto psići i Divlji Mačak ih moraju spasiti.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković and Viktor Nenadić and Branimira Volf with the support of colleagues from the Web Department of HRT Iva Hren and Matka Švarca and Tomislav Mršić and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film presents the authentic experience of three great personalities who, on three different continents, manage to warm human souls for the "living word" shaped by tradition into "fairy tales and stories". Australian Susan Perrow, American Perry Ground and Croatian Jasna Held testify to the "power and healing power" of the oral tradition as opposed to the damage caused exclusively by the "dead" technical mediation of stories in the 21st century. / Film predstavlja autentično iskustvo tri sjajne osobnosti koje na tri različita kontinenta uspijevaju zagrijati ljudske duše za "živu riječ" oblikovanu tradicijom u "bajke i priče". Australka Susan Perrow, Amerikanac Perry Ground i Hrvatica Jasna Held svjedoče kolika je "moć i ljekovitost" usmene tradicije nasuprot šteti koja nastaje isključivo "mrtvim" tehničkim posredovanjem priča u 21. stoljeću.

programme.title: What did you do in the war, dad? / Što si radio u ratu, tata?
programme.desc: World War II. Commander Lionel Cash (D. Shawn) is tasked with a small group of men to conquer a village full of Italian soldiers. To their great surprise, they are greeted by the cheerful Italian commander Oppo (S. Fantoni), who immediately, without a fight, surrenders both the village and the soldiers, but under one unusual condition. Namely, Cash villagers and Italian soldiers should be allowed to have another big celebration. Cash, known for sticking to the rules, reluctantly agrees after much persuasion. American and Italian soldiers and even Cash himself get drunk together at the celebration. However, the agreed-upon surrender falls apart the next day due to Opp's jealousy, because his former sweetheart Gina (G. Rali) spent the night with Commander Cash. War journalists photograph the "battle" from the air, and there is a big misunderstanding and the whole world thinks that a big battle for survival is taking place in the village. Entangled in a lie, both sides agree to continue pretending to fight for the village... / Drugi svjetski rat. Zapovjednik Lionel Cash (D. Shawn) dobiva zadatak da s manjom grupom ljudi osvoji selo puno talijanskih vojnika. Na njihovo golemo iznenađenje dočekuje ih veseli talijanski zapovjednik Oppo (S. Fantoni) koji odmah, bez borbe, predaje i selo i vojnike, no pod jednim neobičnim uvjetom. Naime, zap. Cash seljanima i talijanskim vojnicima treba dopustiti da održe još jednu veliku proslavu. Cash, poznat po tome da se čvrsto drži pravila, nakon dugog nagovaranja nevoljko pristane. Na proslavi se zajedno napiju i zabave i američki i talijanski vojnici, pa čak i sam Cash. Međutim, dogovorena predaja sljedeći dan otpada zbog Oppove ljubomore, jer je njegova dotadašnja draga Gina (G. Rali) noć provela sa zapovjednikom Cashom. Ratni novinari fotografiraju "borbu" iz zraka te dolazi do velikog nesporazuma i cijeli svijet misli kako se u selu odvija velika bitka za opstanak. Zapletene u laži, obje se strane dogovore kako će i dalje glumiti borbu za selo...

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: During October, as part of the 60th Zagreb Salon of Fine Arts, the television airwaves become a place of artistic intervention. Multidisciplinary artist Karlo Štefanek randomly interrupts the program with the performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu, playing with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment. The work is part of his series Self-titled (2022—), in which he explores the instability of identity and questions the concepts of authorship and authenticity, using the body and (self) portrait as a space of discovery and resistance. In today's Art, we talk to Karl Štefanek about this project and his wider artistic practice, and then look back at the history of television performance. / Tijekom listopada, u sklopu 60. zagrebačkog salona likovnih umjetnosti, televizijski eter postaje mjesto umjetničke intervencije.Multidisciplinarni umjetnik Karlo Štefanek nasumično prekida program performansom AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu, poigravajući se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju. Rad je dio njegove serije Self-titled (2022—), u kojoj istražuje nestabilnost identiteta te propituje koncepte autorstva i autentičnosti, koristeći tijelo i (auto)portret kao prostor otkrivanja i otpora.U današnjem Artu razgovaramo s Karlom Štefanekom o ovom projektu i njegovoj široj umjetničkoj praksi, a potom se osvrćemo na povijest televizijskog performansa.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: When Galerija f8 was opened seven years ago on the eve of Christmas at Trg Republike Hrvatska at number 8, the photography students of the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb received the most beautiful holiday present. In the past seven years, we have seen more than 40 exhibitions at that address, which gathered numerous visitors. And this is confirmation that Galerija f8 has outgrown the student gallery story and that it has become an important place that was missing on the Croatian photography and art scene. These days, due to the danger of the facade collapsing and cracked sculptures on the building, the Gallery had to move out. The agile professors and students of the Department of Photography arranged a new exhibition space in the immediate vicinity and thus continued this beautiful gallery story. In the studio about the ADU Gallery and Department of Photography, we talk with professor Jelena Blagović and photographer Gloria Lizde. And we were also at an interesting exam exhibition of photography students Vid Redža and David Bakarić Mihaljević. / Kada je prije sedam godina uoči Božića na Trgu Republike Hrvatske na broju 8 otvorena Galerija f8, studenti fotografije zagrebačke Akademije dramske umjetnosti dobili su najljepši blagdanski poklon. U proteklih sedam godina na toj smo adresi vidjeli više od 40 izložbi koje su okupljale brojne posjetitelje. A to je potvrda da je Galerija f8 prerasla studentsku galerijsku priču te da je postala važno mjesto koje je nedostajalo na hrvatskoj fotografskoj i umjetničkoj sceni. Ovih dana zbog opasnosti od urušavanja fasade i napuklih skulptura na zgradi Galerija se morala iseliti. Agilni profesori i studenti Katedre za fotografiju uredili su u neposrednoj blizini novi izložbeni prostor i tako nastavili ovu lijepu galerijsku priču. U studiju o Galeriji i Katedri za fotografiju ADU razgovaramo s profesoricom Jelenom Blagović i fotografkinjom Glorijom Lizde. A bili smo i na zanimljivoj ispitnoj izložbi studenata fotografije Vida Redže i Davida Bakarića Mihaljevića.

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode examines the pivotal role of wood throughout human history and how the pursuit of this most ancient commodity, now the foundation of a billion dollar industry, dictates our history, present and future. Uncovering the secret structures of trees, we study the resilience of wooden buildings in Japan and the importance of wooden ships to the rise of empires. Moving to the future, we explore the role of wood in modern human activities and the transition of the construction industry to environmentally conscious construction, emphasizing the timeless importance of wood as a fundamental resource and a leader of innovation. / Epizoda proučava ključnu ulogu drva kroz ljudsku povijest te kako potraga za tom najdrevnijom robom, koja je sada temelj industrije vrijedne milijarde dolara, diktira našu povijest, sadašnjost i budućnost. Otkrivajući tajne strukture stabala, proučavamo otpornost drvenih građevina u Japanu i važnost drvenih brodova za nastanak carstava. Prelazeći na budućnost, istražujemo ulogu drva u modernim ljudskim aktivnostima te prelazak građevinske industrije na ekološki osviještenu gradnju, naglašavajući bezvremensku važnost drva kao temeljnog resursa te predvodnika inovacije.

programme.title: Countries - people - adventures / Zemlje - ljudi - pustolovine
programme.desc: Newfoundland has always been different from the rest of Canada. The Canadian film crew filmed for NDR in six different locations in this extraordinarily beautiful region of special people. These are coastal towns without road connections, so they can only be reached by boat. Then there are the iceberg cowboys who do not catch wild horses with a lasso, but icebergs. And it is also the area with the highest concentration of poets in the country. Newfoundland has only been a Canadian province since 1949 and has always been different from the rest of the country. This film lovingly presents the special people of that region. / Newfoundland se uvijek razlikovao od ostatka Kanade. Kanadska filmska ekipa snimala je za NDR na šest različitih mjesta u ovom izvanredno lijepom kraju posebnih ljudi. Obalni su to gradovi bez cestovnih priključaka pa se do njih može doći samo brodom. Tu su zatim kauboji ledenih bregova koji lasom ne hvataju divlje konje nego ledene sante. A to je i kraj s najvećom gustoćom pjesnika u zemlji. Newfoundland je tek od 1949. kanadska pokrajina i oduvijek je drukčija od ostatka zemlje. Ovaj film s mnogo ljubavi predstavlja posebne ljude toga kraja.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Mirko Zrinšćak lives on Učka, at 950 meters above sea level, in the town of Ičići. Although he graduated in painting from the Academy of Fine Arts in Venice, wood is his main medium of expression. The artist, who sailed around the world as a sailor, chooses a way of life in which, separated from the unrest and acceleration of the modern city, he shapes sculptures and objects in a studio located in a former school building. The motifs of Zrinšćak's photographs are often his own sculptures, collected objects, preserved memories... / Mirko Zrinšćak živi na Učki, na 950 metara nadmorske visine, u mjestu Ičići. Premda je na Likovnoj akademiji u Veneciji završio slikarstvo, drvo je njegov osnovni izražajni medij. Umjetnik koji je kao pomorac oplovio svijet, odabire način života u kojem, odvojen od nemira i ubrzanja suvremenog grada, oblikuje skulpture i objekte u atelijeru smještenom u zgradi nekadašnje škole. Motivi Zrinšćakovih fotografija često su vlastite skulpture, skupljeni predmeti, sačuvane uspomene...

programme.title: 44. Varaždin Baroque evenings / 44. Varaždinske barokne večeri
programme.desc: We present the highlight of the 44th Varaždin Baroque Evenings in 2014, when the evening of Antonio Vivaldi's music was presented in the Varaždin Cathedral on September 20 by an ensemble from his hometown _ Venice Baroque Consort. The artistic director and special guest of the program was the Israeli mandolin player Avi Avital, who delighted the audience with inspired performances of Vivaldi's concertos for mandolin, lute and violin, conjuring up a true picture of the musical scenery of the city on the lagoon in the 17th century. In the introductory commentary, Avi Avital presents his small stringed instrument with characteristic colors typical of the Mediterranean atmosphere. / Predstavljamo vrhunac 44. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri godine 2014. kada je večer glazbe Antonija Vivaldija u varaždinskoj katedrali 20. rujna predstavio ansambl iz njegova rodnog grada _ Venice Baroque Consort. Umjetnički voditelj i poseban gost programa bio je izraelski mandolinist Avi Avital koji je publiku oduševio nadahnutim izvedbama Vivaldijevih koncerata za mandolinu, lutnju i violinu, dočaravši vjernu sliku glazbene kulise grada na laguni u 17. stoljeću. U uvodnom komentaru Avi Avital predstavlja svoj malen žičani instrument karakteristične boje tipične za mediteransko ozračje.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Conversation with a reason is the long-time correspondent of the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe _ German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk with him about why he is so preoccupied with the past and the way we deal with it. How much did the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer influence his interest? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia _ and is it correct to say that Germany was to blame for that process? What were the relations between German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tuđman? What do the documents he researched reveal about the relationship of Croatian politics at that time towards Bosnia and Herzegovina? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe _ there are many reasons to talk with Michael Martens. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu _ njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije _ i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi _ mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: In the Reader's Club, we are discussing Frederic Lenoir's book _ The Philosophy of Desire. What desire means for a person, whether it can be controlled and whether it is a driver or an obstacle to happiness, are discussed by: dr. sc. Zvonimir Galić, full professor at the Department of Psychology of the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb Sanja Srdić Jungić, communication specialist Srđan Sandić, journalist and writer dr. sc. Tomislav Pletenac, ethnologist and cultural anthropologist / U Klubu čitatelja razgovaramo o knjizi Frederica Lenoira _ Filozofija želje. O tome što želja znači za čovjeka, može li se njome upravljati i je li ona pokretač ili prepreka sreći, raspravljaju: dr. sc. Zvonimir Galić, redoviti profesor na Odsjeku za psihologiju Filozofskog fakulteta u Zagrebu Sanja Srdić Jungić, komunikologinja Srđan Sandić, novinar i književnik dr. sc. Tomislav Pletenac, etnolog i kulturni antropolog

programme.title: Everything you wanted to know about sex but didn't dare ask / Sve što ste željeli znati o seksu, a niste se usudili pitati
programme.desc: In the first story "Do aphrodisiacs work?" the court madwoman (W. Allen) tries to arouse the erotic interest of the queen (L. Redgrave) with a love potion... In the second story "What is sodomy?" Dr. Ross (G. Wilder) falls in love with an Armenian sheep and because of her, he rejects his marriage, his career, his place in society... In the third story "Why do some women have problems with orgasm?" the polished Italian playboy Fabrizio (W. Allen) discovers that his wife Gina (L. Lasser) can only climax during sexual intercourse in a public place... In the fourth story "Are Transvestites Homosexuals?" Sam (L. Jacobi) reveals his little secret at the most inconvenient moment... In the fifth story "What do sexual researchers actually achieve?" the research of the mad scientist, Dr. Bernard (J. Carradine), leads to a terrifying mutation... In the sixth story "What are sexual perversions?" Jack Berry (J. Berry) leads a panel discussion about the sexual obsessions of the guests of his TV show... In the seventh story "What happens during ejaculation?" a nervous spermatozoon (W. Allen) is not sure if he will be able to make the "great leap"... / U prvoj priči "Djeluju li afrodizijaci?" dvorska luda (W. Allen) pokušava ljubavnim napitkom pobuditi za sebe erotski interes kraljice (L. Redgrave)... U drugoj priči "Što je sodomija?" dr. Ross (G. Wilder) zaljubi se u armensku ovcu i zbog nje odbaci brak, karijeru, mjesto u društvu... U trećoj priči "Zašto neke žene imaju problema s orgazmom?" uglađeni talijanski playboy Fabrizio (W. Allen) otkriva da njegova supruga Gina (L. Lasser) može doseći klimaks jedino pri seksualnom odnosu na javnom mjestu... U četvrtoj priči "Jesu li transvestiti homoseksualci?" Sam (L. Jacobi) otkriva svoju malu tajnu u najnezgodnijem trenutku... U petoj priči "Što seksualni istraživači zapravo postižu?" istraživanja ludog znanstvenika, dr. Bernarda (J. Carradine), dovode do zastrašujuće mutacije... U šestoj priči "Što su seksualne perverzije?" Jack Berry (J. Berry) vodi panel diskusiju o seksualnim opsesijama gostiju svog TV showa... U sedmoj priči "Što se događa tijekom ejakulacije?" nervozni spermatozoid (W. Allen) nije siguran hoće li moći izvesti "veliki skok"...

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for the affection of a conceited young football player. / Marge i g. Burns bore se za naklonost umišljenoga mladog igrača footballa.

programme.title: Zemlja obećanja
programme.desc: Night in the Sinai desert. A group of men and women warm themselves around a fire under a clear sky. The women are from Eastern Europe. The men are Bedouins who pass through this area with their herds. Tomorrow he will secretly cross the border. Tomorrow Diana and the others will be beaten, raped and sold. It will go from one to the other. Anne will sell them to Hanna's club. They will become victims of an international network that sells women. Diana will meet Rose one night at the club. He will ask for help. Their meeting is a glimmer of hope in the hells these women are going through. It is a tough, engaging drama that criticizes and explores the global problem of modern slavery. / Noć u Sinajskoj pustinji. Skupina muškaraca i žena grije se oko vatre pod vedrim nebom. Žene su iz istočne Europe. Muškarci su beduini koji ovim krajem prolaze sa svojim stadima. Sutra će potajno prijeći granicu. Sutra će Dianu i ostale tući, silovati i prodati. Ići će od jednih do drugih. Anne će ih prodati Hanninom klubu. Postat će žrtvama međunarodne mreže koja prodaje žene. Diana će jedne noći u klubu upoznati Rose. Zatražit će pomoć. Njihov je susret tračak nade u pakle koje te žene proživljavaju. Riječ je o teškoj, angažiranoj drami koja kritizira i istražuje globalni problem modernog ropstva.

programme.title: Graditelj brodova
programme.desc: Shipbuilder Mato Dužević from the Pelješac peninsula is over eighty years old, and he still works from morning to dusk. It is one of the last, and perhaps the last, traditional shipbuilders. Mato can build a boat independently _ from receiving an order, creating a blueprint, choosing wood to long-term design. The film about Mr. Mata is a story about perseverance, talent, satisfaction and enjoyment in this difficult job. / Brodograditelj Mato Dužević s poluotoka Pelješca prešao je osamdesetu, a još uvijek od jutra do sutona radi. Jedan je od posljednjih, a možda i zadnji tradicionalni graditelj brodova. Mato može samostalno sagraditi brod _ od primanja narudžbe, izrade nacrta, odabira drveta do dugotrajnog oblikovanja. Film o gosparu Mati priča je o upornosti, talentu, zadovoljstvu i uživanju u ovom teškom poslu.

Carradine), leads to a terrifying mutation... In the sixth story "What are sexual perversions?" Jack Berry (J. Berry) leads a panel discussion about the sexual obsessions of the guests of his TV show... In the seventh story "What happens during ejaculation?" a nervous spermatozoon (W. Allen) is not sure if he will be able to make the "great leap"... / U prvoj priči "Djeluju li afrodizijaci?" dvorska luda (W. Allen) pokušava ljubavnim napitkom pobuditi za sebe erotski interes kraljice (L. Redgrave)... U drugoj priči "Što je sodomija?" dr. Ross (G. Wilder) zaljubi se u armensku ovcu i zbog nje odbaci brak, karijeru, mjesto u društvu... U trećoj priči "Zašto neke žene imaju problema s orgazmom?" uglađeni talijanski playboy Fabrizio (W. Allen) otkriva da njegova supruga Gina (L. Lasser) može doseći klimaks jedino pri seksualnom odnosu na javnom mjestu... U četvrtoj priči "Jesu li transvestiti homoseksualci?" Sam (L. Jacobi) otkriva svoju malu tajnu u najnezgodnijem trenutku... U petoj priči "Što seksualni istraživači zapravo postižu?" istraživanja ludog znanstvenika, dr. Bernarda (J. Carradine), dovode do zastrašujuće mutacije... U šestoj priči "Što su seksualne perverzije?" Jack Berry (J. Berry) vodi panel diskusiju o seksualnim opsesijama gostiju svog TV showa... U sedmoj priči "Što se događa tijekom ejakulacije?" nervozni spermatozoid (W. Allen) nije siguran hoće li moći izvesti "veliki skok"...

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: 44. Varaždin Baroque evenings / 44. Varaždinske barokne večeri
programme.desc: We present the highlight of the 44th Varaždin Baroque Evenings in 2014, when the evening of Antonio Vivaldi's music was presented in the Varaždin Cathedral on September 20 by an ensemble from his hometown _ Venice Baroque Consort. The artistic director and special guest of the program was the Israeli mandolin player Avi Avital, who delighted the audience with inspired performances of Vivaldi's concertos for mandolin, lute and violin, conjuring up a true picture of the musical scenery of the city on the lagoon in the 17th century. In the introductory commentary, Avi Avital presents his small stringed instrument with characteristic colors typical of the Mediterranean atmosphere. / Predstavljamo vrhunac 44. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri godine 2014. kada je večer glazbe Antonija Vivaldija u varaždinskoj katedrali 20. rujna predstavio ansambl iz njegova rodnog grada _ Venice Baroque Consort. Umjetnički voditelj i poseban gost programa bio je izraelski mandolinist Avi Avital koji je publiku oduševio nadahnutim izvedbama Vivaldijevih koncerata za mandolinu, lutnju i violinu, dočaravši vjernu sliku glazbene kulise grada na laguni u 17. stoljeću. U uvodnom komentaru Avi Avital predstavlja svoj malen žičani instrument karakteristične boje tipične za mediteransko ozračje.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: In the episode "Once upon a time... _ a digital fairy tale for adults", scientists and experts of various profiles, as well as those who still tell stories, testify about the fate of stories and the importance of oral tradition in the digital world... Who still needs Thumbelina, Little Red Riding Hood or Granny Iago? How do mobile phones, games, TV and Internet culture change the personality and being of a child? What is the importance of a living person (narrator) in the development of a child _ human? A family "documentary" for every parent with the message "Stories must not disappear!" / U epizodi "JEDNOM DAVNO... _ digitalna bajka za odrasle" o sudbini priča i važnosti usmene tradicije u digitalnom svijetu svjedoče znanstvenici i stručnjaci raznih profila, kao i oni koji još uvijek pričaju priče... Kome još trebaju Palčić, Crvenkapica ili baba Jaga? Na koji način mobiteli, igrice, TV i internetska kultura mijenjaju osobnost i biće djeteta? Kolika je važnost žive osobe (pripovjedača) u razvoju djeteta _ čovjeka? Obiteljski "dokumentarac" za svakog roditelja s porukom "Priče ne smiju nestati!"

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković and Viktor Nenadić and Branimira Volf with the support of colleagues from the Web Department of HRT Iva Hren and Matka Švarca and Tomislav Mršić and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Mayor Goodway thinks she can change the bad dogs of the Scary Team by pretending to be a bad biker and joining the team. When Gasket puts the Mayor to the test, the dogs have to save her. / Gradonačelnica Goodway misli da može promijeniti zločeste psiće iz Strašne ekipe pretvaranjem da je zločesta bajkerica i učlanjivanjem u ekipu. Kada Gasket stavi Gradonačelnicu na testiranje, psići je moraju spasiti.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series I LOVE ZOO ANIMALS, we get to know the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping in the zoo. Every day is a new challenge for him, because he is given a special task that he cannot complete if he does not learn something about the daily activities in the zoo _ feeding, cleaning and arranging the enclosures, playing, training or treating the animals. In this episode, one of the animals needs to go to another zoo and Marko's task is to prepare the crate for transport. In order for the animal to really get into the crate, it needs to be trained daily. Marko will see how these animals are trained for transport, but also for exercise, weighing or veterinary examination. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu _ prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju, treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U ovoj epizodi jedna od životinja treba otići u drugi zoološki vrt i Markov je zadatak pripremiti sanduk za prijevoz. Da bi životinja doista i ušla u sanduk, treba je svakodnevno trenirati. Marko će vidjeti kako se to životinje treniraju i radi transporta, ali i razgibavanja, vaganja ili veterinarskog pregleda.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Branimir would like to hug, but not all his friends. / Branimir bi se htio grliti, ali ne i svi njegovi prijatelji.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and petty mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoy and his friends, and each episode deals with a different theme. Cheerful sociables explore the world and learn new words and concepts through play. And he's having a good time along the way. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy learns that his pet Muc does not possess the virtue of patience, especially when it comes to food. When his tummy tells him he has to eat, he eats. Tweedy, on the other hand, knows that patience brings rewards. / Tvidi dozna da njegov ljubimac Muc ne vlada vrlinom strpljenja, osobito kad je riječ o hrani. Kad mu trbuščić javi da mora jesti, on jede. Tvidi pak zna da strpljenje donosi nagradu.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Captain Redbeard tasks Marko with trying out the new raft, but it disintegrates in the water. Numbers rush to the rescue. Then they have to figure out how to rebuild the raft for Redbeard. How many things does the perfect raft need for the perfect summer day? / Kapetan Riđobradi zadaje Marku da isproba novu splav, ali ona se raspadne u vodi. Brojčići jure u spašavanje. Zatim moraju odgonetnuti kako ponovno sagraditi splav za Riđobradog. Koliko stvari treba savršena splav za savršen ljetni dan?

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Nimble Sage comes to town for Antics on Ice Day, and Naughty Dog feels left out. / Spretna Mudrica dolazi u grad tijekom Dana za ludorije na ledu, a Nestašni se Psić osjeća izostavljenim.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bob can't go to his friend Phoebe's party because she has measles. / Bob ne može otići na zabavu prijateljice Phoebe jer ona ima ospice.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Tango helps Miguel fix the dino rattle, but makes a clumsy mistake, causing him to worry that it's too rough and too strong for jobs that require gentleness. Miguel comforts her and teaches her a "light song" to make her calm and gentle. Tango then tries to help Min and Jon with their delicate chores, using Miguel's song, but it doesn't go too well for her. But when a pachycephalosaur starts a stampede all over the ranch, Tango realizes that a rough approach won't help her this time. Instead, she finally uses Miguel's easy song to calm the upset dinosaur, proving that she can be both strong and gentle when needed. / Tango pomaže Miguelu popraviti dinotutnjalicu, ali nespretno pogriješi, zbog čega se zabrine da je pregruba i prejaka za poslove koji zahtijevaju nježnost. Miguel je tješi i uči je "laganu pjesmu" kako bi postala smirena i nježna. Tango potom pokušava pomoći Min i Jonu s njihovim nježnim poslovima, koristeći Miguelovu pjesmu, ali joj to ne ide baš najbolje. No kad jedan pahicefalosaur krene u stampedo po cijelom ranču, Tango shvati da joj grub pristup ovaj put neće pomoći. Umjesto toga, napokon upotrijebi Miguelovu laganu pjesmu kako bi smirila uzrujanog dinosaura, dokazujući da zna biti i snažna i nježna kad zatreba.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song I'll do it all by myself, you'll meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mehapomagači
programme.desc: There's a pipe leak on the space station, and Ze's super sticky glue is the solution, until it spills onto Ze and MacFarmer, sticking them together. It's up to Meham to unstick them so they can pull off their super-epic space rescue. / Na svemirskoj stanici došlo je do curenja cijevi, a rješenje je Zeovo super ljepljivo ljepilo, dok se ne prolije na Zea i MacFarmera, pa ih zalijepi zajedno. Na Mehama je da ih odlijepe kako bi mogli izvesti svoje super-epsko spašavanje u svemiru.

programme.title: Topsy i Tim
programme.desc: Topsy and Tim is a live-action drama from children's television channel CBeebies, brought to you by BAFTA award-winning creators Darrall Macqueen. The series follows the everyday adventures of cheerful twins. / Topsy i Tim živa je akcijska drama dječjeg televizijskog kanala CBeebies koju donose dobitnici nagrade BAFTA, autori produkcijske kuće Darrall Macqueen. Serija prati svakidašnje pustolovine veselih blizanaca.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy learns that his pet Muc does not possess the virtue of patience, especially when it comes to food. When his tummy tells him he has to eat, he eats. Tweedy, on the other hand, knows that patience brings rewards. / Tvidi dozna da njegov ljubimac Muc ne vlada vrlinom strpljenja, osobito kad je riječ o hrani. Kad mu trbuščić javi da mora jesti, on jede. Tvidi pak zna da strpljenje donosi nagradu.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Captain Redbeard tasks Marko with trying out the new raft, but it disintegrates in the water. Numbers rush to the rescue. Then they have to figure out how to rebuild the raft for Redbeard. How many things does the perfect raft need for the perfect summer day? / Kapetan Riđobradi zadaje Marku da isproba novu splav, ali ona se raspadne u vodi. Brojčići jure u spašavanje. Zatim moraju odgonetnuti kako ponovno sagraditi splav za Riđobradog. Koliko stvari treba savršena splav za savršen ljetni dan?

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo is mesmerized by how the zipper on the jacket moves up and down. With his friends from the World of Drawings, he explores the magic of opening and closing things. / Pablo je opčinjen time kako se zatvarač na jakni pomiče gore-dolje. S prijateljima iz Svijeta crteža on istražuje tu čaroliju otvaranja i zatvaranja stvari.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bob can't go to his friend Phoebe's party because she has measles. / Bob ne može otići na zabavu prijateljice Phoebe jer ona ima ospice.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song I'll do it all by myself, you'll meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Edmund and Luce took Matilda to the forest to play. But when it's time to return home, Matilda is nowhere to be found! Edmund and Luce are worried because a fox seems to be lurking nearby. / Edmund i Luce poveli su Matildu u šumu na igranje. No, kad dođe vrijeme za povratak kući, Matildi nigdje ni traga! Edmund i Luce su zabrinuti jer se čini da u blizini lunja lisica.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Tango helps Miguel fix the dino rattle, but makes a clumsy mistake, causing him to worry that it's too rough and too strong for jobs that require gentleness. Miguel comforts her and teaches her a "light song" to make her calm and gentle. Tango then tries to help Min and Jon with their delicate chores, using Miguel's song, but it doesn't go too well for her. But when a pachycephalosaur starts a stampede all over the ranch, Tango realizes that a rough approach won't help her this time. Instead, she finally uses Miguel's easy song to calm the upset dinosaur, proving that she can be both strong and gentle when needed. / Tango pomaže Miguelu popraviti dinotutnjalicu, ali nespretno pogriješi, zbog čega se zabrine da je pregruba i prejaka za poslove koji zahtijevaju nježnost. Miguel je tješi i uči je "laganu pjesmu" kako bi postala smirena i nježna. Tango potom pokušava pomoći Min i Jonu s njihovim nježnim poslovima, koristeći Miguelovu pjesmu, ali joj to ne ide baš najbolje. No kad jedan pahicefalosaur krene u stampedo po cijelom ranču, Tango shvati da joj grub pristup ovaj put neće pomoći. Umjesto toga, napokon upotrijebi Miguelovu laganu pjesmu kako bi smirila uzrujanog dinosaura, dokazujući da zna biti i snažna i nježna kad zatreba.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Mayor Goodway thinks she can change the bad dogs of the Scary Team by pretending to be a bad biker and joining the team. When Gasket puts the Mayor to the test, the dogs have to save her. / Gradonačelnica Goodway misli da može promijeniti zločeste psiće iz Strašne ekipe pretvaranjem da je zločesta bajkerica i učlanjivanjem u ekipu. Kada Gasket stavi Gradonačelnicu na testiranje, psići je moraju spasiti.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković and Viktor Nenadić and Branimira Volf with the support of colleagues from the Web Department of HRT Iva Hren and Matka Švarca and Tomislav Mršić and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: In the episode "Once upon a time... _ a digital fairy tale for adults", scientists and experts of various profiles, as well as those who still tell stories, testify about the fate of stories and the importance of oral tradition in the digital world... Who still needs Thumbelina, Little Red Riding Hood or Granny Iago? How do mobile phones, games, TV and Internet culture change the personality and being of a child? What is the importance of a living person (narrator) in the development of a child _ human? A family "documentary" for every parent with the message "Stories must not disappear!" / U epizodi "JEDNOM DAVNO... _ digitalna bajka za odrasle" o sudbini priča i važnosti usmene tradicije u digitalnom svijetu svjedoče znanstvenici i stručnjaci raznih profila, kao i oni koji još uvijek pričaju priče... Kome još trebaju Palčić, Crvenkapica ili baba Jaga? Na koji način mobiteli, igrice, TV i internetska kultura mijenjaju osobnost i biće djeteta? Kolika je važnost žive osobe (pripovjedača) u razvoju djeteta _ čovjeka? Obiteljski "dokumentarac" za svakog roditelja s porukom "Priče ne smiju nestati!"

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Poraženi
programme.desc: In three different stories, the film deals with murders committed by members of well-to-do youth. In the first story, set in Paris, a group of friends kill an acquaintance over jealousy and money. In Rome, a student gets involved in a smuggling ring that leads him to murder, and in London, an unfulfilled poet wants to make money from the fact that he found a woman's corpse. / U tri različite priče film se bavi ubojstvima koje su počinili pripadnici dobrostojeće mladeži. U prvoj priči, smještenoj u Parizu, skupina prijatelja ubija poznanika zbog ljubomore i novca. U Rimu student biva upleten u krijumčarski lanac koji ga dovede i do ubojstva, a u Londonu neostvareni pjesnik želi zaraditi na činjenici da je pronašao ženski leš.

programme.title: Pod suncem
programme.desc: Under the sun of Hvar, the smells and colors are perhaps stronger than elsewhere. That magic of the union of heat from the sky, earth and sea is still preserved by some of its inhabitants... / Pod suncem Hvara mirisi i boje su, možda, jači nego drugdje. Tu čaroliju sjedinjenja topline s neba, zemlje i mora još uvijek čuvaju neki od njezinih stanovnika...

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Conversation with a reason is the long-time correspondent of the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe _ German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk with him about why he is so preoccupied with the past and the way we deal with it. How much did the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer influence his interest? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia _ and is it correct to say that Germany was to blame for that process? What were the relations between German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tuđman? What do the documents he researched reveal about the relationship of Croatian politics at that time towards Bosnia and Herzegovina? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe _ there are many reasons to talk with Michael Martens. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu _ njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije _ i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi _ mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: In the Reader's Club, we are discussing Frederic Lenoir's book _ The Philosophy of Desire. What desire means for a person, whether it can be controlled and whether it is a driver or an obstacle to happiness, are discussed by: dr. sc. Zvonimir Galić, full professor at the Department of Psychology of the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb Sanja Srdić Jungić, communication specialist Srđan Sandić, journalist and writer dr. sc. Tomislav Pletenac, ethnologist and cultural anthropologist / U Klubu čitatelja razgovaramo o knjizi Frederica Lenoira _ Filozofija želje. O tome što želja znači za čovjeka, može li se njome upravljati i je li ona pokretač ili prepreka sreći, raspravljaju: dr. sc. Zvonimir Galić, redoviti profesor na Odsjeku za psihologiju Filozofskog fakulteta u Zagrebu Sanja Srdić Jungić, komunikologinja Srđan Sandić, novinar i književnik dr. sc. Tomislav Pletenac, etnolog i kulturni antropolog

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: With a height of 2918 m, Olympus is the highest mountain in Greece, in Greek mythology the seat of Zeus and his exalted divine company. Not far from it is the Pilio peninsula with sycamore forests, olive groves, old mountain villages and magical coves. All this beauty is surpassed only by the world-famous monasteries of Meteora, which are included in the UNESCO list of World Cultural Heritage. These holy places are built on pointed rocks. Maria Zolota and her husband Dionysos run a mountain lodge in Spilios Agapitos at 2,060 m. Each season more than 10,000 guests spend the night here, which requires a lot of organizational talent and hard work. Water is brought from the mountains through a special water supply system. It is water from melted snow and ice. Food supplies should also be organized because there is no freight cable car or access road here. But that's why Takis and his Donkey Express exist. Panaiotis Varipatis and his girlfriend Litsa are truffle hunters. They regularly search for this black gold with their dogs in the Kalambake forest. / Olimp je s visinom od 2918 m najviša planina u Grčkoj, u grčkoj mitologiji sjedište Zeusa i njegove uzvišene božanske družine. Nedaleko od njega je poluotok Pilio sa šumama platana, maslinicima, starim planinskim selima i čarobnim uvalama. Svu tu ljepotu nadilaze samo svjetski poznati manastiri Meteora koji su uvršteni u UNESCO-v popis Svjetske kulturne baštine. Ta su sveta mjesta podignuta na šiljastim stijenama. Maria Zolota i njezin muž Dionysos vode planinarski dom u Spilios Agapitosu na 2060 m. Svake sezone ovdje prenoći više od 10.000 gostiju, za što je potrebno mnogo organizacijskog dara i radinosti. Voda se posebnim vodovodom dovodi iz gorja. To je voda od otopljenog snijega i leda. Treba organizirati i opskrbu namirnicama jer ovdje nema teretne žičare ni pristupne ceste. Ali zato postoji Takis i njegov magareći ekspres. Panaiotis Varipatis i njegova djevojka Litsa lovci su na tartufe. Sa svojim psima u šumi Kalambake redovito tragaju za tim crnim zlatom.
