programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Sven Stilinović's photography, from early, large-format black-and-white photographic collages to strong structurally saturated color works, is characterized by unconventionality, anarchism and the idea of ​​the absurd. Stilinović treats photography as an intuitive and intellectual process and uses the method of a permanent experiment whose changes become a complex collage of the unpredictable and never defined nature of art. / Fotografija Svena Stilinovića, od ranih, crno-bijelih fotografskih kolaža velikog formata do snažnih strukturalno zasićenih kolorističkih radova, karakterizira nekonvencionalnost, anarhizam i ideja apsurda. Stilinović tretira fotografiju kao intuitivni i intelektualni proces te se koristi metodom permanentnog eksperimenta čije mijene postaju složeni kolaž nepredvidive i nikad dorečene prirode umjetnosti.

programme.title: Boy
programme.desc: The story of Boy takes place in 1984 on the rural east coast of New Zealand, and is inspired by the Oscar-nominated short film Two Cars, One Night. Boy is a hilarious and honest story about growing up and heroes. Boy is a dreamer who loves Michael Jackson and lives with his brother Rocky, a bunch of abandoned cousins ​​and his grandmother. Boy has a hero, and that is his father Alamein, about whom the boy fantasizes. He imagines him as a deep-sea diver, a war hero and a close relative of Michael Jackson (he even dances like him). In reality, Alamein is an incompetent moneylender who was imprisoned for robbery. When Alamein returns home after seven years away, Boy is confronted with the man he thought he knew and the realization that he is not the hero he thought he was. / Priča filma Boy odvija se 1984. na ruralnoj istočnoj obali Novog Zelanda, a nadahnuta je kratkim filmom Dva automobila, jedna noć, koji je bio nominiran za Oscara. Boy je urnebesna i iskrena priča o odrastanju i junacima. Boy je sanjar koji voli Michaela Jacksona i živi s bratom Rockyjem, hrpom napuštenih rođaka i bakom. Boy ima junaka, a to je njegov otac Alamein o kojemu dječak mašta. Zamišlja ga kao dubinskog ronioca, ratnog junaka i bliskog rođaka Michaela Jacksona (čak i pleše poput njega). U stvarnosti, Alamein je nesposoban niškoristi koji je bio u zatvoru zbog pljačke. Kad se Alamein vrati kući nakon sedam godina izbivanja, Boy se suočava s čovjekom za kojeg je mislio da ga poznaje i spoznajom da nije junak kakvim ga je zamišljao.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: The partner country of the festival in 2016 was the Kingdom of Spain, and the opening ceremony went to one of the most respected ensembles specializing in early music _ La Ritirata. Under the artistic direction of the brilliant cellist, also the founder of the ensemble, Josetxu Obregon, La Ritirata becomes an unavoidable musical and cultural delicacy of many festivals and concert halls. At our oldest baroque art festival in Varaždin, members of the ensemble perform arias and instrumental excerpts from two operas based on Miguel de Cervantes, by the Italian baroque composer Antonio Caldara. On the occasion of the 400th anniversary of the death of that great Spanish writer, the musical evening was inspired by his masterpiece, the novel The Fair Knight Don Quixote of Mancha. / Zemlja _ partner festivala 2016. godine bila je Kraljevina Španjolska, a svečanost otvorenja pripala je jednom od najuglednijih ansambala specijaliziranih za ranu glazbu _ La Ritirata. Pod umjetničkim vodstvom briljantnog čelista, ujedno i utemeljitelja ansambla, Josetxua Obregona, La Ritirata postaje nezaobilazna glazbena i kulturna poslastica mnogih festivala i koncertnih dvorana. Na našem najstarijem festivalu barokne umjetnosti u Varaždinu, članovi ansambla izvode arije i instrumentalne ulomke iz dviju opera prema Miguelu de Cervantesu, talijanskog baroknog skladatelja Antonija Caldare. U povodu 400. godišnjice smrti toga velikog španjolskog pisca, glazbena večer nadahnuta je njegovim remek-djelom, romanom Bistri vitez Don Quijote od Manche.

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: Young biologist Goran Šafarek travels through the famous Baranja triangle Kopački rit _ Danube _ Drava in search of deer roar. He found himself in this area during a severe drought, which makes his journey even more exciting; where he is walking now, the water was high until recently, so he walks between scattered shells. Along the way, he meets interesting people, nature and river guardians, rare inhabitants of ethnic villages that are beautiful and eerily empty, an enthusiastic potter who makes jewelry from Drava stone, which he calls precious stone because of its value for the ecosystem. With a group of young ecologists, he sails down the Danube to a white sandbar that sometimes disappears, sometimes appears in a new, wonderful form. His mission is to help preserve rivers, without unnecessarily interfering with their flow and the life around them, as he likes to say: "Let the rivers breathe." / Mladi biolog Goran Šafarek putuje glasovitim baranjskim trokutom Kopački rit _ Dunav _ Drava u potrazi za rikom jelena. U ovom području našao se za vrijeme velike suše što njegovo putovanje čini još uzbudljivijim; tamo gdje sada hoda do nedavno je bila visoka voda, pa prolazi između rasutih školjki. Putem susreće zanimljive ljude, čuvare prirode i čuvare rijeka, rijetke stanovnike etnosela koja su prelijepa i sablasno prazna, zanesenog keramičara koji izrađuje nakit iz dravskog kamena koji naziva dragi kamen zbog njegove vrijednosti za ekosustav. S grupom mladih ekologa Dunavom plovi do bijelog pješčanog spruda koji čas nestaje, čas se pojavljuje u nekom uvijek novom divnom obliku. Njegova je misija pomoći očuvanju rijeka, bez nepotrebnog upletanja u njihov tok i život oko njih, kako on to voli reći: "Pustite rijeke da dišu."

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: When Francois accidentally breaks the diving bell, the Dogs on Patrol must rescue him, Dogfish, and a fleet of whales. // When Wingnut's scrap pile and Oscar disappear at the same time, Chase and the team set out to solve the mystery. / Kada Francois slučajno razbije ronilačko zvono, Psići u ophodnji moraju spasiti njega, Psićribu i plovu kitova. // Kada Wingnutova hrpa otpada i Oscar nestanu u isto vrijeme, Chase i ekipa kreću u rješavanje misterije.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu is disappointed when her xylophone playing doesn't get the reaction she'd hoped for. / Lu je razočarana kad njeno sviranje ksilofona ne postigne reakciju kakvoj se nadala.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Muc loves to play and enjoys endless games with the whistling button with great joy. However, for Tweedy, that game has to end at some point. How will he fulfill Muco's expectations? / Muc se obožava igrati i s velikim veseljem uživa u beskrajnim igrama s fijukavim gumbom. Međutim, za Tvidija ta igra u nekom trenutku mora završiti. Kako će ipak ispuniti Mucova iščekivanja?

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: PEPE, BUBI AND LU by Dr. Zdravka Puppet series A series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, little ones who are still growing their milk teeth. They are a little mischievous and very afraid of doctors and injections, but with dear doctor Zdravka and funny uncle Boža, they will master all the lessons and overcome their fear of the doctor's office. Three fun songs await you in the series! Puppet actors: Katarina Arbanas, Dinka Vuković, Jadran Grubišić, Mladen Vujčić Actors: Mirela Videk, David Petrović Screenwriter: Tomislav Zagoda Director: Petar Orešković Director of photography: Marko Jerbić Editor: Iva Blašković Editor: Sanja Nakić Producer: Sanja Ivančin / PEPE, BUBI I LU kod dr. Zdravke Lutkarska igrana serija Serija za najmlađe o odlasku liječniku. Njezini su glavni junaci Pepe, Bubi i Lu, mališani kojima još rastu mliječni zubi. Malo su nestašni i jako se boje doktora i injekcije, ali uz dragu doktoricu Zdravku i smiješnog ujaka Božu savladat će sve lekcije i pobijediti strah od ordinacije. U serijalu vas očekuju i tri zabavne pjesmice! Glumci lutkari: Katarina Arbanas, Dinka Vuković, Jadran Grubišić, Mladen Vujčić Glumci: Mirela Videk, David Petrović Scenarist: Tomislav Zagoda Redatelj: Petar Orešković Direktor fotografije: Marko Jerbić Montažerka: Iva Blašković Urednica: Sanja Nakić Producentica: Sanja Ivančin

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, while using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. / Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123.

programme.title: Najbolji dan
programme.desc: Paula is a tiny five-year-old, timid and shy. She is single, she doesn't have a pet, but she has a favorite doll, Danica. Paula imagines that she and Danica are princesses, that her room is a castle and her bed is a carriage. The parents want to take their princess to the dentist for the first time. It's a great challenge. Paula is very afraid of the white coat. DigiDigi is urgently needed. / Paula je sićušna petogodišnjakinja, plaha i sramežljiva. Jedinica je, nema kućnog ljubimca, ali ima najdražu lutku Danicu. Paula zamišlja da su Danica i ona princeze, da je njezina soba dvorac, a krevet kočija. Roditelji svoju princezu žele prvi put odvesti zubaru. Strašan je to izazov. Paula se jako boji bijele kute. Hitno treba DigiDigija.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Little Bunny and the Love Monster come to the conclusion that a good idea is easier to come up with in two. / Malena Zečica i Ljubavno Čudovište dolaze do zaključka je dobru ideju lakše osmisliti u dvoje.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz, Bob and Pearl are looking for treasure in a big hot desert. / Bitz, Bob i Bisera u potrazi su za blagom u velikoj vrućoj pustinji.

programme.title: It's at the hotel / Ho ho ho hotel
programme.desc: HO HO HO HOTEL This fall, we invite you to a hotel like you've never seen before! What kind of guests will be welcomed by the best and funniest hosts of Hotel Ruža i Franc and what funny, silly and impossible wishes and problems will be faced by their guests - you will see in 20 episodes of the new humorous and educational series for children! Ruža and Franc can solve any problem, but in their own special and funny way. Dramatic-educational series of 20 ten-minute episodes produced by the Program for Children and Young People takes place in a hotel with the most unusual, best and sweetest hosts Ruža and Franco and their guests with even more unusual crazy wishes and problems! Through the funny and silly incidents of a clumsy magician, a silly scientist, an opera diva who lost her voice and many others, we will learn what is warm and what is cold, what is quiet and what is loud, fast or slow, big or small, high or low, near or far, heavy or light, visible or invisible! In the main series / HO HO HO HOTEL Ove vas jeseni pozivamo u hotel kakav još nikada niste vidjeli! Kakve će sve goste dočekati najbolji i i najzabavniji domaćini Hotela Ruža i Franc i koje će smiješne, šašave i nemoguće želje i probleme imati njihovi gosti- vidjet ćete u 20 epizoda nove humoristično- edukativne serije za djecu ! Ruža i Franc mogu riješiti svaki problem, ali , na a svoj posebni i smiješni način. Igrano- edukativna serija od 20 desetominutnih epizoda u produkciji Programa za djecu i mlade događa se u hotelu s najneobičnijim, najboljim i najsješnijim domaćinima Ružom i Francom te njihovim gostima s još neobičnijim luckastim željama i problemima! Kroz smiješne i šašave zgode nespretnog mađioničara, šašavog znanstvenika, operne dive koja je ostala bez glasa i mnogih drugih, naučit ćemo što je toplo, a što hladno, što tiho, a što glasno, brzo ili sporo, veliko il malo, visoko i nisko, blizu ili daleko, teško ili lagano, vidljivo ili nevidljivo! U seriji glavne

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song I'll do it all by myself, you'll meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: How Elmo got a puppy / Kako je Elmo dobio psića
programme.desc: In this hilarious TV special that teaches us how to love and care for our furry friends, Elmo and Grover help a cute stray dog ​​find a new, permanent home. One day, on Sesame Street, just as Elmo is about to spend the day playing with his friend, Grover, they hear Oskar complaining about a puppy living in a box near his trash can. Elmo and Grover befriend the puppy and soon help him find the right home, where he will stay forever. Yes, it's a great episode. As Sesame Street always teaches us something, this animated special shows us how to take care of our pets. But maybe he could introduce the children more to the responsibilities they have towards a pet (he shows us only the basic, but not the more complex obligations such as training and going to the vet, although that could be the topic of the next special or episode). But the songs are really great (Keksomlat's song about dog treats is a standout), and the story is great, as are the actors who voice the characters. / U ovom veselom TV-specijalu, koji nas uči kako da volimo i brinemo se o našim čupavim prijateljima, Elmo i Grover pomažu slatkome psiću lutalici da pronađe novi, stalni dom. Jednoga dana, u ulici Sezama, baš kada se Elmo sprema provesti dan u igri sa svojim prijateljem, Groverom, začuju Oskara kako se žali na psića koji živi u kutiji blizu njegove kante za smeće. Elmo i Grover sprijatelje se s psićem i ubrzo mu pomognu pronaći pravi dom, u kojemu će zauvijek ostati. Da, riječ je o sjajnoj epizodi. Kako nas Ulica Sezama uvijek o nečemu uči, ovaj nam animirani specijal pokazuje kako da se brinemo o svojim ljubimcima. No, možda bi djecu mogao i više upoznati s odgovornostima koje imaju prema kućnome ljubimcu (pokazuje nam samo osnovne, ali ne i složenije obveze kao što su dresura i odlazak veterinaru, premda bi to mogla biti tema idućega specijala ili epizode). No, pjesme su doista sjajne (izdvaja se Keksomlatova pjesma o psećim poslasticama), a priča je odlična, kao i glumci koji likovima daju glasove.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: The dinoranchers are about to take nutritious watermelons to the herds of wild dinosaurs, but suddenly a tiny wild microraptor appears and manages to scare even Biscuit! Bo and Jane explain that the microraptors are the only dinosaurs the T. rex are afraid of, and that they snack on anything they find in search of food. Jon and Blitz volunteer to catch the microraptor before it eats their entire supply of watermelons, but the little mischievous is so cunning that he outsmarts them every time. It's only when a microraptor scares Biscuit and steals a dino rattle full of watermelons that Blitz finally admits that he needs help catching the tiny raptor. He and the Dinoranchers set off in pursuit of the frightened Rumble-toting Biscuit, and together they manage to catch the microraptor and deliver their watermelon harvest to the wild dinosaurs who need it most. / Dinorančeri se spremaju odnijeti hranjive apatolubenice stadima divljih dinosaura, no iznenada se pojavi sićušni divlji mikroraptor koji uspije prestrašiti čak i Biskvita! Bo i Jane objašnjavaju da su mikroraptori jedini dinosauri kojih se T. rexovi boje te da grickaju sve što pronađu u potrazi za hranom. Jon i Blitz dobrovoljno se javljaju da uhvate mikroraptora prije nego što im izgrize cijelu zalihu apatolubenica, ali taj je mali nestaško toliko lukav da ih svaki put nadmudri. Tek kad mikroraptor prestraši Biskvita i ukrade dinotutnjalicu punu apatolubenica, Blitz napokon priznaje da mu treba pomoć pri hvatanju tog sićušnog raptora. On i Dinorančeri kreću u potjeru za preplašenim Biskvitom koji vuče tutnjalicu, i udruženim snagama uspijevaju uhvatiti mikroraptora te isporučiti svoju berbu lubenica divljim dinosaurima kojima je najpotrebnija.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: Superteta
programme.desc: We know you know all sorts of super heroes! And we know that all of them are great! But we're sure you still haven't met SuperTeta _ a truly special superheroine who helps only and only children! Especially for kindergarteners! / Znamo da poznajete najrazličitije super junake! I znamo da su svi od reda super! Ali smo sigurni da još uvijek niste upoznali SuperTetu _ uistinu posebnu superjunakinju koja pomaže samo i jedino djeci! Osobito vrtićarcima!

programme.title: A colorful pot / Šareni lonac
programme.desc: We are cooking again! Chef Mario Mihelj and his little helpers are cooking and having a good time! In each episode they cook or make one dish. Cook with us too! / Opet kuhamo! Chef Mario Mihelj i njegovi mali pomoćnici kuhaju i pritom se dobro zabavljaju! U svakoj epizodi skuhaju ili naprave po jedno jelo. Kuhaj i ti s nama!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
