For him, the ancient art of tree beekeeping, which dates back to the Middle Ages, is an inspiration for a life in harmony with nature. / Ο Πιότρ είναι μελισσοκόμος στο Αουγκούστουφ, στο βορειοανατολικό άκρο της Πολωνίας. Για τον ίδιο, η αρχαία τέχνη της μελισσοκομίας σε δέντρα, η οποία χρονολογείται από τον Μεσαίωνα, αποτελεί έμπνευση για μια ζωή σε αρμονία με τη φύση.

programme.title: Foreign Children's Program / Ξένο Παιδικό Πρόγραμμα
programme.desc: ERT presents selected children's programs. / Η ΕΡΤ σας παρουσιάζει επιλεγμένα, παιδικά προγράμματα.

programme.title: Landscapes from High K2 E3 (E) / Τοπία από Ψηλά Κ2 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Wales Part A. We are transported to the gentle landscape of Wales, renowned for its beauty, historical past and industrial heritage. It now attracts millions of visitors to enjoy the lush green meadows and magnificent coastline. / Επεισόδιο: Ουαλία Α Μέρος. Μεταφερόμαστε στο ήπιο τοπίο της Ουαλίας, που φημίζεται για την ομορφιά, το ιστορικό παρελθόν και τη βιομηχανική κληρονομιά της. Τώρα προσελκύει εκατομμύρια επισκέπτες για να απολαύσουν τα καταπράσινα λιβάδια και την υπέροχη ακτογραμμή.

programme.title: It's in Your Hand E2 (E) / Είναι στο Χέρι σου Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Ilenia and Stefanos continue construction on their new home. They start with a beautiful bookcase and progress with candlesticks and garden seats made from old tires. / Η Ιλένια και ο Στέφανος συνεχίζουν τις κατασκευές στο καινούργιο σπίτι τους. Ξεκινούν με μία πανέμορφη βιβλιοθήκη και προχωρούν με κηροπήγια και καθίσματα κήπου από παλιά λάστιχα.

programme.title: Herbs, Fruits of the Earth (E) / Βότανα, Καρποί της Γης (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: On the Mountain of the Gods. The forest of Elatochori is a natural botanical garden with more than 1700 species of plants. The flora of the area varies according to the altitude. There we find many great herbs, such as Olympus tea, nettle and truffle mushroom. / Επεισόδιο: Στο Βουνό των Θεών. Το δάσος του Ελατοχωρίου είναι ένας φυσικός βοτανικός κήπος με περισσότερα από 1700 είδη φυτών. Η χλωρίδα της περιοχής διαφοροποιείται ανάλογα με το υψόμετρο. Εκεί βρίσκουμε πολλά και σπουδαία βότανα, όπως το τσάι Ολύμπου, η τσουκνίδα και η τρούφα μανιτάρι.

programme.title: Perimeter / Περίμετρος
programme.desc: Informative broadcast which focuses daily on current affairs and special topics, in concentric circles, with an emphasis on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the Community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: The Salt of the Earth K11 (E) / Το Αλάτι της Γης Κ11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Pontic Tradition in Almopia-Aridea. The show takes us to Pella and invites us to a Pontic feast with a great music and dance company from the Black Club of Almopia in Aridaia. / Επεισόδιο: Ποντιακή Παράδοση στην Αλμωπία-Αριδαία. Η εκπομπή μάς ταξιδεύει στην Πέλλα και μας προσκαλεί σ ένα ποντιακό γλέντι με μια μεγάλη μουσική και χορευτική παρέα από την Εύξεινο Λέσχη Αλμωπίας στην Αριδαία.

programme.title: Wild Greece K3 E9 (E) / Άγρια Ελλάδα Κ3 Ε9 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Chania. Elias and Grigoris visit the area of ​​Chania. They hike below the White Mountains to explore the cave of the cyclops Polyphemus, meet the endemic lizard, the buffalo frog and the Cretan Tarantula. / Επεισόδιο: Χανιά. Ο Ηλίας και ο Γρηγόρης επισκέπτονται την περιοχή των Χανίων. Κάνουν πεζοπορία κάτω από τα λευκά Όρη για να εξερευνήσουν τη σπηλιά του κύκλωπα Πολύφημου, συναντούν την ενδημική σαύρα, τον βουβαλοβάτραχο και την Κρητική Ταραντούλα.

programme.title: Waterscapes in Europe E3 (E) / Υδάτινα Τοπία στην Ευρώπη Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Dordogne. Along its 500 kilometers, the Dordogne has created a picturesque landscape in the south-west of France. The entire river basin is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. / Επεισόδιο: Ο Ντορντόν. Κατά μήκος των 500 χιλιομέτρων του, ο Ντορντόν έχει δημιουργήσει ένα γραφικό τοπίο στα νοτιοδυτικά της Γαλλίας. Ολόκληρη η λεκάνη απορροής του ποταμού αποτελεί απόθεμα βιόσφαιρας της UNESCO.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Acrites E2 (E) / Ακρίτες Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Olympus: Refugees at 2697 m. Our next stop is Olympus and the Plateau of the Muses. There we meet the refugees, at 2,697 m. in the highest inhabited building in the Balkans, the shelter of Ioss Apostolidis. / Επεισόδιο: Όλυμπος: Καταφυγιάδες στα 2697 μ. Επόμενος σταθμός μας ο Όλυμπος και το Οροπέδιο των Μουσών. Εκεί συναντάμε τους καταφυγιάδες, στα 2.697 μ. στο υψηλότερο κατοικημένο οίκημα των Βαλκανίων, το καταφύγιο του Γιώσου Αποστολίδη.

programme.title: The Vineyards of the World E18 (E) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε18 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Rhine Valley. The winegrowers of the Rhine Valley know all the secrets of Riesling, the quintessential German variety, a wine that has been cultivated for centuries in this region thanks to the strong influence of the river. / Επεισόδιο: Η Κοιλάδα του Ρήνου. Οι αμπελουργοί της κοιλάδας του Ρήνου γνωρίζουν όλα τα μυστικά του ρίσλινγκ, της κατ εξοχήν γερμανικής ποικιλίας, ενός κρασιού που καλλιεργείται εδώ και αιώνες στην περιοχή αυτή χάρη στην έντονη επίδραση του ποταμού.

programme.title: Incredible Train Journeys K14 E5 / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ14 Ε5
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Brazil. Philip goes to Brazil. His journey begins in Rio de Janeiro, where he travels on a very original commuter train. He then boards the world's longest train, which crosses part of the Amazon forest. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Βραζιλία. Ο Φιλίπ πηγαίνει στη Βραζιλία. Το ταξίδι του ξεκινά στο Ρίο ντε Τζανέιρο, όπου ταξιδεύει με ένα πολύ πρωτότυπο προαστιακό τρένο. Στη συνέχεια, επιβιβάζεται στο μεγαλύτερο τρένο του κόσμου, το οποίο διασχίζει μέρος του Αμαζονίου δάσους.

programme.title: Hope E1 / Ελπίδα Ε1
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: The Big Chance. Behind the climate crisis lies a great opportunity to build a better world. We look at solutions that, in addition to reducing emissions, improve everyone's lives by embarking on a journey to see the solutions in action. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Η Μεγάλη Ευκαιρία. Πίσω από την κλιματική κρίση κρύβεται μια μεγάλη ευκαιρία για να χτίσουμε έναν καλύτερο κόσμο. Εξετάζουμε λύσεις που, εκτός από τη μείωση των εκπομπών, βελτιώνουν τη ζωή όλων, ξεκινώντας ένα ταξίδι για να δούμε τις λύσεις στην πράξη.

programme.title: Honeymoon trip / Ταξίδι του Μέλιτος
programme.desc: Leo, now retired, is on vacation with his wife. This time, their daughter is away on her honeymoon. The world of familiar mature vacationers is overshadowed by the fear of death. Some reminisce and others rebel. (105) / Ο Λέων, συνταξιούχος πλέον, παραθερίζει, μαζί με τη γυναίκα του. Αυτή τη φορά, η κόρη τους λείπει σε ταξίδι του μέλιτος. Ο κόσμος των γνώριμων παραθεριστών ώριμης ηλικίας σκιάζεται από το φόβο του θανάτου. Άλλοι αναπολούν και άλλοι επαναστατούν. (105)

programme.title: Short Stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: Come Let Me Tell You. Prize-winning fiction film at the Glermont-Ferrand International Festival, France. Giannis and Sofia have been married for 20 years. Their life goes on quietly, until the moment when their calm family peace is disturbed. / Έλα Να Σου Πω. Βραβευμένη ταινία μυθοπλασίας στο Διεθνές Φεστιβάλ Glermont-Ferrand της Γαλλίας. Ο Γιάννης και η Σοφία είναι παντρεμένοι εδώ και 20 χρόνια. Η ζωή τους κυλά ήσυχα, ως τη στιγμή που ταράζεται η ήρεμη οικογενειακή τους γαλήνη.

programme.title: Terra Nostra Chapter 112 / טרה נוסטרה פרק 112
programme.desc: Hortensia visits Amadeo in detention; Coffee prices continue to drop, and they begin to consider burning surpluses; Francesco and Marco Antonio meet Zanti and the coachman in a restaurant; Matteo offers Amadeo help in the company. (chess) / הורטנסיה מבקרת את אמדאו במעצר; מחירי הקפה ממשיכים לצנוח, ומתחילים לשקול שריפת עודפים; פרנצסקו ומרקו אנטוניו פוגשים במסעדה את זאנטי והעגלון; מתאו מציע לאמדאו עזרה בחברה. (שח)

programme.title: My Revenge Chapter 7 / הנקמה שלי פרק 7
programme.desc: Lorenzo and Olivia assign Mario an impossible task, and at the same time he hacks Sonia's cell phone. Orson humiliates Irena. Lola says that Enrique raped her. Pardo is kidnapped and Sonia threatens to hurt his father if he doesn't find out who sent him. (chess) / לורנסו ואוליביה מטילים על מריו משימה בלתי אפשרית, ובמקביל הוא פורץ לנייד של סוניה. אורסון משפיל את אירנה. לולה מספרת שאנריקה אנס אותה. פארדו נחטף וסוניה מאיימת לפגוע באביו אם לא יגלה מי שלח אותו. (שח)

programme.title: The family is everything episode 9 / המשפחה זה הכל פרק 9
programme.desc: Gesika arranges a romantic surprise to dissuade Luka from his decision to break up with her. Brenda and Paulina decide to carry out their plan to separate Venus and Tom. Electra receives flowers and a declaration of love from Morillo, who actually sent Gesica. (chess) / גסיקה מארגנת הפתעה רומנטית כדי להניא את לוקה מהחלטתו להיפרד ממנה. ברנדה ופאולינה מחליטות להוציא לפועל את התוכנית שלהן להפריד בין ונוס לטום. אלקטרה מקבלת פרחים והצהרת אהבה ממורילו, שבעצם שלחה גסיקה. (שח)

programme.title: The Vow Chapter 353 / הנדר פרק 353
programme.desc: The discovery of Palaio lands like a bomb in the palace. Catalina does everything for him to stay there. Lupe felt insecure about Santos' interest in Vera. Alonso discovers a new detail related to Coro's interests, which will completely change the situation in the mansion. (chess) / הגילוי של פלאיו נוחת כמו פצצה בארמון. קטלינה עושה הכול כדי שיישאר שם. לופה חש אי ביטחון מול העניין של סנטוס בוורה. אלונסו מגלה פרט חדש הקשור לתחומי העניין של קורו, דבר שישנה לגמרי את המצב באחוזה. (שח)

programme.title: What the Heart Desires Chapter 68 / מה שהלב רוצה פרק 68
programme.desc: Esmeralda says goodbye to Patricio over his grave to give Carlo a chance. At Tirso's request, Magdalena visits him in prison and he asks for her forgiveness. Leonel gives Valeria the house that was used for his campaign so that she can set up the community dining room in it. (chess) / אסמרלדה נפרדת מפטריסיו מעל קברו כדי לתת הזדמנות לקרלו. לבקשת טירסו, מגדלנה מבקרת אותו בכלא והוא מבקש את סליחתה. לאונל נותן לוולריה את הבית ששימש לקמפיין שלו כדי שהיא תקים בו את חדר האוכל הקהילתי. (שח)

programme.title: Green Gold Chapter 143 / זהב ירוק פרק 143
programme.desc: Zoza pressures Katrina to end the relationship with Thomas. Bea tells Zorez that Miguel presented documents that suspect him of stealing steel. Katrina ends the relationship with Thomas over the phone. Enrique demands to speak with Zorez much to Vera's dismay. (chess) / זוזה לוחץ על קטרינה לסיים את הקשר עם תומאס. ביה מספרת לזורז שמיגל הציג מסמכים שמחשידים אותו בחטיפת מפלדה. קטרינה מסיימת את הקשר עם תומאס דרך הטלפון. אנריקה דורש לדבר עם זורז למורת רוחה של ורה. (שח)

programme.title: Hard Earth Chapter 16 / אדמה קשוחה פרק 16
programme.desc: Guta and Zobi make love in the river, in front of Moda and Zuma. Zooey is anxious about the horses, his father is frustrated and tells Philo that he is disappointed in him. Gotta tells her father that she and Zobi are a couple, and he is angry. Zooey goes out to photograph the nesting area, and a snake bites him. (chess) / גוטה וזובי מתעלסים בנהר, לעיני מודה וזומה. זובי בחרדה מהסוסים, אביו מתוסכל ואומר לפילו שהוא מאוכזב ממנו. גוטה מספרת לאביה שהיא וזובי זוג, והוא כועס. זובי יוצא לצלם את אזור הקינון, ונחש מכיש אותו. (שח)

programme.title: Terra Nostra Chapter 112 / טרה נוסטרה פרק 112
programme.desc: Hortensia visits Amadeo in detention; Coffee prices continue to drop, and they begin to consider burning surpluses; Francesco and Marco Antonio meet Zanti and the coachman in a restaurant; Matteo offers Amadeo help in the company. (chess) / הורטנסיה מבקרת את אמדאו במעצר; מחירי הקפה ממשיכים לצנוח, ומתחילים לשקול שריפת עודפים; פרנצסקו ומרקו אנטוניו פוגשים במסעדה את זאנטי והעגלון; מתאו מציע לאמדאו עזרה בחברה. (שח)

programme.title: My Revenge Chapter 7 / הנקמה שלי פרק 7
programme.desc: Lorenzo and Olivia assign Mario an impossible task, and at the same time he hacks Sonia's cell phone. Orson humiliates Irena. Lola says that Enrique raped her. Pardo is kidnapped and Sonia threatens to hurt his father if he doesn't find out who sent him. (chess) / לורנסו ואוליביה מטילים על מריו משימה בלתי אפשרית, ובמקביל הוא פורץ לנייד של סוניה. אורסון משפיל את אירנה. לולה מספרת שאנריקה אנס אותה. פארדו נחטף וסוניה מאיימת לפגוע באביו אם לא יגלה מי שלח אותו. (שח)

programme.title: The family is everything episode 9 / המשפחה זה הכל פרק 9
programme.desc: Gesika arranges a romantic surprise to dissuade Luka from his decision to break up with her. Brenda and Paulina decide to carry out their plan to separate Venus and Tom. Electra receives flowers and a declaration of love from Morillo, who actually sent Gesica. (chess) / גסיקה מארגנת הפתעה רומנטית כדי להניא את לוקה מהחלטתו להיפרד ממנה. ברנדה ופאולינה מחליטות להוציא לפועל את התוכנית שלהן להפריד בין ונוס לטום. אלקטרה מקבלת פרחים והצהרת אהבה ממורילו, שבעצם שלחה גסיקה. (שח)

programme.title: The Vow Chapter 353 / הנדר פרק 353
programme.desc: The discovery of Palaio lands like a bomb in the palace. Catalina does everything for him to stay there. Lupe felt insecure about Santos' interest in Vera. Alonso discovers a new detail related to Coro's interests, which will completely change the situation in the mansion. (chess) / הגילוי של פלאיו נוחת כמו פצצה בארמון. קטלינה עושה הכול כדי שיישאר שם. לופה חש אי ביטחון מול העניין של סנטוס בוורה. אלונסו מגלה פרט חדש הקשור לתחומי העניין של קורו, דבר שישנה לגמרי את המצב באחוזה. (שח)

programme.title: What the Heart Desires Chapter 68 / מה שהלב רוצה פרק 68
programme.desc: Esmeralda says goodbye to Patricio over his grave to give Carlo a chance. At Tirso's request, Magdalena visits him in prison and he asks for her forgiveness. Leonel gives Valeria the house that was used for his campaign so that she can set up the community dining room in it. programme.title: Handball - Qualification for the European Championship (w): Montenegro - Portugal / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž): Crna Gora - Portugal
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two stages. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group advances to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The aim is for the viewers to relax and have fun in the hour and a half, in order to escape from the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and families. In numerous sections, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of our interlocutors, we share tips for a simpler life. Along with simple and concrete advice for the viewers, in the show we will host numerous individuals or groups engaged in humanitarian work, as well as celebrities who we will present in a slightly different light, giving them the opportunity to share with the viewers their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.desc: The Montenegrin Football League was founded in 2004, but the first season was played in the 2006/2007 season. after the independence of the country. 12 clubs in the three-round competition system fought for the championship title, which was eventually won by Zeta from Golubovac, which remained the only championship title of Montenegro. programme.title: Handball - Qualification for European Championship (w): Faroe Islands - Montenegro / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž): Farska ostrva - Crna Gora
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two stages. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group advances to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Balet tre sorelle

programme.title: A Troca

programme.title: The Year of the Bear / O Ano do Urso
programme.desc: Documentary that follows the life cycle of five different species of bears, filmed over the course of a year in different parts of the world: the European brown bear, the polar bear, the gray bear, the American black bear and the mythical and very rare Kermode bear. Discover these giants as they emerge from hibernation and live their daily lives in increasingly fragile ecosystems. / Documentário que acompanha o ciclo de vida de cinco especies diferentes de ursos, filmadas ao longo de um ano em diferentes partes do mundo: o urso-pardo europeu, o urso-polar, o urso-cinzento, o urso-negro-americano e o mítico e raríssimo urso de kermode. Descubra estes gigantes quando emergem da hibernaçao e vivem as suas vidas quotidianas em ecossistemas cada vez mais frágeis.

programme.title: Hora dos Portugueses
programme.desc: Daily magazine, with different perspectives, with Portuguese communities spread around the world, to portray the current ways of experiencing Portugueseness in different territories and recognize the achievements and achievements of the Portuguese who make up these groups of citizens. / Magazine diário, com diferentes olhares, junto de comunidades de portugueses espalhados pelo mundo, para retratar as atuais formas de viver a portugalidade nos diferentes territorios e reconhecer os feitos e conquistas dos portugueses que compõem estes grupos de cidadaos.

Do quarto secreto de Salazar a Manique do Intendente, uma localidade pensada para ser capital do reino. Pelo meio conhecemos os inacabados pavilhões das Caldas da Rainha e subimos no mapa para visitar uma das escolas mais bonitas.

programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito

But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve problems big and small and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Mia Go
programme.desc: Mia is a girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. With her fearless sense of adventure, she tries things for the first time with a fearless attitude. Mia lives in the busy city Everyday with her closest friends and together they go on great adventures. / Mia e uma menina cujo entusiasmo contagia todos ao seu redor. Com seu destemido sentido de aventura, ela tenta as coisas pela primeira vez com uma atitude destemida. Mia mora na movimentada cidade Todososdias com os seus amigos mais proximos e juntos vao viver grandes aventuras.

programme.desc: Top seeds Arturo Coello/Agustín Tapia clash with No.2 Alejandro Galán/Federico Chingotto. programme.title: Race 1 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: The Misano weekend opens with a sprint that rewards clean starts, tyre warm-up and bravery through Curvone. Expect late dives into Turn 1, heavy braking at Quercia and traction duels out of Tramonto onto the back straight. Safety cars and track-limits calls can flip the order, while newcomers hunt points and title hopefuls set the tone for the round.

programme.title: Race 2 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: Race 2 reshuffles the deck after overnight tweaks. Warmer track temps raise tyre-degradation stakes, making slipstream timing on the main straight vital. Inside lines at Turn 1 and measured exits from Tramonto decide most passes. Watch for undercuts on out-laps, safety-car restarts, and penalties for track limits as contenders bank crucial mid-round points.

programme.title: Race 3 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: With setups refined, Race 3 is often the weekend’s fiercest sprint. Nose-to-tail packs form into Turn 1, while rhythm and patience through the fast right-lefts keep front tyres alive. Curvone commitment and a tidy run to Quercia create overtaking chances. Expect bold moves, defensive elbows, and strategy on push laps to climb

programme.title: Race 4 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: The Misano finale. Championship hopefuls chase maximum points as fatigue, tyre life and track limits shape the last attacks. A strong launch, disciplined braking at Quercia and perfect traction from Tramonto decide podiums. Anticipate safety-car drama, photo-finish drafts to the stripe, and decisive moves under pressure as the round closes with a flat-out sprint.

programme.title: Race 5 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: Rising talents go wheel-to-wheel at Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli in Race 5. Slipstreams on the main straight and commitment through Curvone shape the order, while track limits, safety cars, and bold restarts can flip everything late. A flat-out sprint where newcomers and title hopefuls fight to the flag.

programme.title: Race - Qiddiya Round - Extreme H World Cup 2025
Race - Qiddiya Round - Extreme H World Cup 2025
Race - Qiddiya Round - Extreme H World Cup 2025
programme.desc: Extreme H World Cup hits Qiddiya for a desert race. Hydrogen-powered Pioneer 25 SUVs face Time Trials, head-to-head heats, and a multi-car Grand Final, with energy management, tyre wear and route choice deciding positions. Expect dunes, dust and daring passes under the Tuwaiq cliffs, driver switches, and strategy on boost usage as teams chase points, manufacturer bragging rights and momentum in the sport’s new zero-emissions era. Broadcast highlights and on-board shots bring the action home.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Everton - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8

programme.title: Fulham vs Arsenal - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8

The Gunners last failed to win more consecutive league visits to Fulham in April 1962.

programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan.

The Qatari league includes star names such as Firmino, Verratti, and Qatari Akram Afif, the best player in Asia.

programme.title: MMA UFC 318
programme.desc: The term mixed martial arts was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a review of the Ultimate Fighting Championship tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Box: Jack Cullen - Mark Heffron / Boks: Jack Cullen - Mark Heffron
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need any more reason to follow this noble martial art? We find the first traces of boxing already in the third century BC on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxing were established in the 18th century in London and define the fighting area, equipment and illegal and allowed types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: MMA UFC 79
programme.desc: The term mixed martial arts was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a review of the Ultimate Fighting Championship tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Paris - Baskonia / Košarka - Euroleague: Paris - Baskonia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Jacksonville Jaguars - Seattle Seahawks / Američki fudbal - NFL: Jacksonville Jaguars - Seattle Seahawks
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but it was only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century that the current version of the competition was created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most media-covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - FIBA ​​Champions League: Benfica - Spartak / Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Benfica - Spartak
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fibina Basketball Champions League. The goal of this league is to compete with the organization Euroleague Basketball S.L. and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, a regular part, a playoff and a final tournament of the best four, or popularly known as the Fayball Four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.desc: Handball Bundesliga is the highest ranking of handball competitions in Germany. Along with the Spanish league, the Bundesliga is considered the best European league. It was founded in 1965 as a separate competition of the northern and southern regions. Only since 1977 has it been a unique competition. There are currently 19 teams in the two-round competition system. The Kil handball club has won the most titles. programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: A show for all fans of this sport, who are fed up with industrial, high-budget football, for those who are fed up with tactics and games without goals. The show will follow the matches played in the third tier of the football competition in Serbia. Every week we will present one game from all four groups of the Serbian league, we will hear interesting interviews and see interesting contributions. / Emisija za sve ljubitelje ovog sporta, koji su se zasitili industrijskog, visokobudžetnog fudbala, za one kojima je dosta taktiziranja i utakmica bez golova. programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Efes - Panathinaikos / Košarka - Euroleague: Efes - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.desc: MLB or Major League Baseball is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the World Series. The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play in the World Series finals. The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili Major League Baseball je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju World Series finale. programme.title: Football - Polish League: Motor - GKS Katowice / Fudbal - Poljska liga: Motor - GKS Katowice
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first football league of Poland was founded in 1927. This league is organized by the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league. The champion directly wins the title of Polish champion. The number of teams changed over the years, 18 participated in the 90s, and only 10 in the 30s. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu, osnovana je 1927. godine. Ovu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno, u ligi učestvuje 16 ekipa. Prvak direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona. Broj ekipa se sa godinama menjao, 90-ih učestvovalo ih je 18, a 30-ih samo 10.

programme.title: Fudbal - Championship: Middlesbrough - Ipswich
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond the multi-million dollar contracts and the glittering lights of media popularity lies the Championship, the English league it once was. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams in the fight for the holy goal, entry into the Premiership. The specialty of the Championship is that, with an average attendance of about 15,000 people, it is the second most watched league in the world. For real football fans, it is a must stop for sports weekend entertainment. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svetla medijske popularnosti smestio se Čempionšip, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premieršip. Posebnost Čempionšipa je i u tome što je sa prosečnom posećenošću od oko 15000 ljudi najgledanija druga liga na svetu. Pravim ljubiteljima fudbala nezaobilazna je stanica sportske vikend razonode.

programme.title: Football - Italian league: Udinese - Cagliari / Fudbal - Italijanska liga: Udinese - Cagliari
programme.desc: Seria A is a professional football competition consisting of 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a number of great players and coaches. / Seria A je profesionalno fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 ekipa u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Seria A postala je sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski fudbal se svojim kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi.

programme.title: Future stars of the Arena / Buduće zvezde Arene
programme.desc: We present to you successful young people who represent the future of sports in Serbia. Get to know sportsmen and women who are already achieving exceptional results in junior competitions. / Predstavljamo vam uspešne mlade ljude koji predstavljaju budućnost sporta u Srbiji. Upoznajte sportistkinje i sportiste koji već u juniorskim takmičenjima ostvaruju izuzetne rezultate.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Athletic - Mallorca / Fudbal - Španska liga: Athletic - Mallorca
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Plan igre
programme.desc: The football coach and analyst will talk about how football looks and how it should look, using the example of several games from the Premier League. We will try to focus on football itself, not to leave the football field, and to give an answer to the question of what separates the teams into those that lose and those that win, that is, they often win. Our guests, football experts, will also give their opinion. / Fudbalski trener analitičar će na primeru nekoliko utakmica iz Premijer lige govoriti o tome kako fudbal izgleda i kako bi trebalo da izgleda. Pokušaćemo da se fokusiramo na sam fudbal, da ne silazimo sa fudbalskog terena, i da damo odgovor na pitanje šta je to što razdvaja ekipe na one koje gube i one koje pobeđuju, odnosno često pobeđuju. Svoje viđenje daće i naši gosti, stručnjaci iz oblasti fudbala.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found their happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different sports, and here they could see for themselves how true the stories about the famous Serbian hospitality are. Some of them found the love of their life here, found godfathers, friends for life, got citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what is their life like, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. Kakav je njihov odnos prema Srbiji i kakav je njihov život, saznajte u našoj emisiji.

programme.title: Football - Spanish 2nd League: Almeria - Zaragoza / Fudbal - Španska 2. liga: Almeria - Zaragoza
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct placement up, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Sport Brothers League
programme.desc: An event dedicated to the promotion of football and healthy lifestyle habits, organized by the Sports Brothers League and FC Bežanija. Children aged 10 to 12 compete in the tournament, and the little ones can expect a suitable accompanying program. / Manifestacija posvećena promociji fudbala i zdravih životnih navika u organizaciji Sports Brothers League i FK Bežanija. Na turniru se takmiče deca starosti od 10 do 12 godina, a mališane očekuje i prigodan propratni program.

programme.title: Handball - Qualification for the European Championship (w): Germany - North Macedonia / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž): Nemačka - Severna Makedonija
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group moves to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će doneti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podeljene u dve faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dve grupe u kojoj pobednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dve prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Sportske igre mladih
programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this region, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. Under the slogan We live life without drugs, because drugs take life, we enable elementary school students in Serbia to participate completely free of charge in competitions, in ten sports disciplines, and the most successful individuals and teams travel on a free mini-vacation as participants in the GRAND INTERNATIONAL FINALS of the Games in Split. We enable young people to participate completely free of charge in competitions in ten sports disciplines (soccer, beach volleyball, street basketball, handball, volleyball, game between two fires, table tennis, tennis, athletics and chess). / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za decu i omladinu na ovim prostorima, čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva. Pod sloganom Živimo život bez droge, jer droga uzima život, osnovcima u Srbiji omogućavamo potpuno besplatno učestvovanje u takmičenjima, u deset sportskih disciplina i najuspešniji pojedinci i ekipe putuju na besplatno mini letovanje kao učesnici VELIKOG MEĐUNARODNOG FINALA Igara u Splitu. Mladima godinama omogućavamo potpuno besplatno učestvovanje u takmičenjima u deset sportskih disciplina, (mali fudbal, odbojka na pesku, ulični basket, rukomet, odbojka, igra između dve vatre, stoni tenis, tenis, atletika i šah).

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Monaco - Valencia / Košarka - Euroleague: Monaco - Valencia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. programme.title: Football - Swiss League: St. Gallen - Thun / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga: St. Gallen - Thun
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Onvo - Bahcesehir / Košarka - Turska liga: Onvo - Bahcesehir
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: ASVEL - Virtus Bologna / Košarka - Euroleague: ASVEL - Virtus Bologna
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Panathinaikos - GA Eagles / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Panathinaikos - GA Eagles
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. programme.title: Zona zdravog sporta

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Borac - Herzegovina / Košarka - KLS: Borac - Hercegovac
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest level of professional basketball in that country. The league itself was founded in 2006 and as such has 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the two-round point system, and in the matches each club is the host once and the guest once. It is interesting that the Serbian clubs that play in the regional ABA league do not participate in this part of the competition. After the first part, the four best clubs are placed in the Super League, in which only then are the clubs that played in the regional competition joined, and at that stage the champion of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Superleague depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but there are always 8 teams in that part of the competition. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found their happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different sports, and here they could see for themselves how true the stories about the famous Serbian hospitality are. Some of them found the love of their life here, found godfathers, friends for life, got citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what is their life like, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. Kakav je njihov odnos prema Srbiji i kakav je njihov život, saznajte u našoj emisiji.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Vienna - Mega / Košarka - ABA liga: Vienna - Mega
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Besiktas - Onvo / Košarka - Turska liga: Besiktas - Onvo
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Besiktas - Chemnitz / Košarka - Eurocup: Besiktas - Chemnitz
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 of the strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards. / Evrokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo takmičenje Evroleague Basketball. U ovom takmičenju se bore najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspeju izboriti plasman u Evroligu, te u njemu sudeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih evropskih liga. Plasman u Evrokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. vajldkards.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Paris - Baskonia / Košarka - Euroleague: Paris - Baskonia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Spanish League: Gran Canaria - Unicaja / Košarka - Španska liga: Gran Canaria - Unicaja
programme.desc: The Spanish basketball league was founded in 1957 as Liga National and got its current format in 1983 when the ACB organization took control of the competition. According to scoring, League ACB is one of the three best European leagues. Currently, 18 teams participate in the league, which play each other twice during the season. The team with the most titles won is Real Madrid, but it is followed closely by Barcelona. Throughout history, the Spanish league has given us some of the world's greatest players and coaches. / Španska košarkaška liga osnovana je 1957. godine kao Liga National te je današnji format dobila 1983. godine kada organizacija ACB preuzima kontrolu nad takmičenjem. Prema bodovanju, Liga ACB jedna je od tri najbolje evropske lige. Trenutno u ligi sudeluje 18 ekipa koje u toku sezone po dva puta igraju međusobno. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula je madridski Real ali u stopu ga prati i Barselona. Španska liga kroz istoriju nam je dala neke od najvećih svetskih igrača i trenera.

programme.title: Basketball - Greek League: Olympiacos - Panathinaikos / Košarka - Grčka liga: Olympiacos - Panathinaikos

Takmičenje svake sezone okuplja 12 klubova, a ubedljivo najuspešnija ekipa od osnivanja lige je Panatinaikos.

programme.title: Podbacivanje sa Dejanom Tomaševićem
programme.desc: A sports show where you will be able to hear many interesting stories from the world of basketball. / Sportska emisija u kojoj ćete moći da čujete brojne zanimljive priče iz sveta košarke.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian League: Napoli - Trieste / Košarka - Italijanska liga: Napoli - Trieste
programme.desc: The long history of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A dates back to 1920 and its collapse. The first winner was the team from Kostana in the same year, 1920. This league is of great importance for European club basketball as a league that has given over 35 titles to its clubs in European competitions, starting with the Euroleague, FIBA ​​Saporta Cup and the Radivoje Korac Cup. The competition itself consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents in a round robin, followed by an eight-team playoff. Elimination matches are played on four won matches out of seven or in English terminology Best of seven. / Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske Lega Basket Serie A datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija Best of seven.

programme.title: Basketball - German league: Bayern - Bamberg / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Bayern - Bamberg
programme.desc: The history of German club basketball dates back to 1939, but the German Basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964, while the competition itself started two years later. The competition consists of 18 teams, and the season is divided into a regular part in which everyone plays each other in a double round and a playoff part that starts after the regular part is over. The last two teams of the regular season are relegated, while in the playoffs the winner is awarded the Best of five format, where teams must win at least 3 games out of 5 in order to eliminate the rival. The interesting thing about the league is that each team must have a hall with a minimum of 3,000 seats for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Poslednje dve ekipe regularnog dela ispadaju u niži rang, dok se u plejofu pobednik dobija Best of five formatu gdje ekipe moraju dobiti minmalno 3 utakmice od 5 kako bi izbacili rivala. Zanimljivost lige je da svaka ekipa mora imati dvoranu od minimalno 3000 mesta za publiku.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Manisa - Erokspor / Košarka - Turska liga: Manisa - Erokspor
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Fenerbahce - Bayern / Košarka - Euroleague: Fenerbahce - Bayern
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: London Lions - Trento / Košarka - Eurocup: London Lions - Trento
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 of the strongest European leagues participate in it. U ovom takmičenju se bore najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspeju izboriti plasman u Evroligu, te u njemu sudeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih evropskih liga. Plasman u Evrokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. vajldkards.

programme.title: Basketball rules / Košarkaška pravila
programme.desc: Legendary basketball player and new coach of Crvena zvezda Saša Obradović. Through the half-hour episode, we were reminded of the beginnings of our hero, which were in Mali Kalemegdan. From there, his career took him to Germany, where he gained his complete affirmation. programme.title: Basketball - FIBA ​​Champions League: Benfica - Spartak / Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Benfica - Spartak
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fibina Basketball Champions League. The goal of this league is to compete with the organization Euroleague Basketball S.L. and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, a regular part, a playoff and a final tournament of the best four, or popularly known as the Fayball Four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Oviedo - Espanyol / Fudbal - Španska liga: Oviedo - Espanyol
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.
