programme.title: Rukomet - EHF League champion: Szeged - Magdeburg / Rukomet - EHF Liga šampiona: Szeged - Magdeburg
programme.desc: Handball Champions League has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to the change of name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition, followed by eliminations, has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga šampiona svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu šampiiona uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama menjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Volleyball - CEV Champions League: Perugia - Halkbank Ankara, semi-finals / Odbojka - CEV Liga šampiona: Perugia - Halkbank Ankara, polufinale
programme.desc: We got the first winner of this competition in 1960, after the CSKA Moscow team defeated the Rapida team from Bucharest. The Russian team is also the most successful in the Champions League and the only one with a double-digit number of titles, even though all its titles date back to the USSR era. The club itself was disbanded in 2009, even though they have won 13 European championship titles. From 1959 to 2000, the name of the league was the European Champions Cup, after which it was changed to the current name. The French club Paris Volley was the first champion under the new name of the competition in 2001. / Prvog pobednika ovog takmičenja smo dobili 1960. godine nakon što je ekipa CSKA Moskve pobedila ekipu Rapida iz Bukurešta. Ruska ekipa je ujedno i najuspešnija u Ligi šampiona te jedina koja ima dvocifreni broj titula iako sve njene titule datiraju iz doba SSSRa. Sami klub je rasformiran 2009. godine iako imaju čak 13 titula prvaka Evrope. Naziv lige je od 1959. do 2000. godine bio Evropski Kup Prvaka nakon čega je sledila izmena u današnji naziv. Francuski klub Pariz Volej je bio prvi prvak pod novim nazivom takmičenja 2001. godine.

programme.title: Volleyball - Turkish league (w): Fenerbahce - Vakifbank, G3 final / Odbojka - Turska liga (ž): Fenerbahce - Vakifbank, finale G3
programme.desc: The Women's Turkish Volleyball League is the highest level of women's club competition in Turkey and is organized under the authority of the Turkish Volleyball Federation. The league was founded in 1983, and the Eçasibaşı team became the first champion of Turkey. Eçasibaşı is also the most successful team in Turkey, having won the championship title 17 times. 12 teams compete in the league, which play 22 matches in a two-round system in the regular part of the season. The top eight continue the competition in the playoffs and fight for the title of Turkish champion. / Ženska turska odbojkaška liga je najviši rang ženskog klupskog takmičenja u Turskoj i je organizovana pod ingerencijom Turskog odbojkaškog saveza. Liga je osnovana 1983. godine, a prvi šampion Turske postala je ekipa Ečasibaši. Ečasibaši je ujedno i najuspešnija ekipa Turske koja je 17 puta osvajala titulu šampiona. U ligi se takmiči 12 ekipa koje u dvokružnom sistemu u regularnom delu sezone odigraju 22 meča. Osam najboljih takmičenje nastavlja u plej ofu i bore se za titulu šampiona Turske.

programme.title: Rukomet - EHF Liga Evrope: Vardar - Sesvete
programme.desc: The EHF Cup, the second most important competition for men's handball clubs in Europe, began its journey in 1993. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup, which played its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012, the former EHF Cup Winners' Cup has been added to the EHF Cup. The competition, like the Champions League, consists of a part where the clubs play in groups and the best ones go to the knock out phase. After the quarter-finals with two games between opponents, the final four follows. The semi-finals and finals as well as the match for third place are played with one game won. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gde klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u knock out fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dve utakmice između protivnika sledi final four. Polufinale i finale kao i utakmica za treće mesto se igraju na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

programme.title: Handball: Bundesliga - Never stop / Rukomet: Bundesliga - Never stop
programme.desc: In the last few years, the popularity of handball in Germany has been continuously growing. This show is dedicated to professionals who managed to realize their boyhood dreams and achieve great success on the handball court. programme.title: Handball - EHF Champions League: Pelister - Barcelona / Rukomet - EHF Liga šampiona: Pelister - Barcelona
programme.desc: Handball Champions League has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name Champions Cup. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. programme.title: Handball - German league: Flensburg - Kiel / Rukomet - Nemačka liga: Flensburg - Kiel
programme.desc: Handball Bundesliga is the highest ranking of handball competitions in Germany. Along with the Spanish league, the Bundesliga is considered the best European league. It was founded in 1965 as a separate competition of the northern and southern regions. Only since 1977 has it been a unique competition. There are currently 19 teams in the two-round competition system. The Kil handball club has won the most titles. The high quality of the handball game and full stands are the reason why the Bundesliga is so followed all over the world. / Rukometna Bundesliga je najviši rang rukometnih takmičenja u Nemačkoj. Uz špansku ligu Bundesliga se smatra najboljom evropskom ligom. Osnovana je 1965. godine kao odvojeno takmičenje severne i južne regije. Tek od 1977. deluje kao jedinstveno takmičenje. Trenutno broji 19 ekipa u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Najviše osvojenih titula broji rukometni klub Kil. Visok kvalitet rukometne igre i ispunjene tribine razlog su zašto je Bundesliga toliko praćena u celom svetu.

programme.title: Volleyball - League of Nations (W): Italy - Brazil, final / Odbojka - Liga nacija (Ž): Italija - Brazil, finale
programme.desc: The FIVB Women's Volleyball Nations League is a newly established national team competition. The competition is divided into two phases, the league phase and the final phase. 16 national teams enter the league stage, and in a total of 120 games of the league part, they are hunting for one of the first five positions that lead to the final stage of the competition. The five best national teams join the host and are divided into two groups with three teams each. The two best teams from each group advance to the semi-finals where they fight for the grand final. / FIVB ženska odbojkaška Liga nacija novoosnovano je takmičenje reprezentacija. Takmičenje je podeljeno u dve faze, ligašku fazu i finalnu fazu. U ligašku fazu ulazi 16 reprezentacija koje u ukupno 120 utakmica ligaškog dela love jednu od prvih pet pozicija koje vode u finalnu fazu takmičenja. Pet najboljih reprezentacija pridružuju se domaćinu te se dele u dve grupe sa po tri ekipe. Po dve najbolje reprezentacije iz svake grupe se plasiraju u polufinale gde se bore za veliko finale.

programme.title: Odbojka - CEV šampiona League: Jastrzebski - Zawiercie, semi-final / Odbojka - CEV Liga šampiona: Jastrzebski - Zawiercie, polufinale
programme.desc: We got the first winner of this competition in 1960, after the CSKA Moscow team defeated the Rapida team from Bucharest. The Russian team is also the most successful in the Champions League and the only one with a double-digit number of titles, even though all its titles date back to the USSR era. The club itself was disbanded in 2009, even though they have won 13 European championship titles. From 1959 to 2000, the name of the league was the European Champions Cup, after which it was changed to the current name. The French club Paris Volley was the first champion under the new name of the competition in 2001. / Prvog pobednika ovog takmičenja smo dobili 1960. godine nakon što je ekipa CSKA Moskve pobedila ekipu Rapida iz Bukurešta. Ruska ekipa je ujedno i najuspešnija u Ligi šampiona te jedina koja ima dvocifreni broj titula iako sve njene titule datiraju iz doba SSSRa. Sami klub je rasformiran 2009. godine iako imaju čak 13 titula prvaka Evrope. Naziv lige je od 1959. do 2000. godine bio Evropski Kup Prvaka nakon čega je sledila izmena u današnji naziv. Francuski klub Pariz Volej je bio prvi prvak pod novim nazivom takmičenja 2001. godine.

programme.title: Volleyball - Turkish league (m): Ziraat - Galatasaray, final G1 / Odbojka - Turska liga (m): Ziraat - Galatasaray, finale G1
programme.desc: The First Turkish Volleyball League or Efeler League is the highest level of Turkish club volleyball competition. It was founded in 1970 under the authority of the Turkish Volleyball Federation and in its current format, the league contains 12 clubs. Historically, the most successful club is Eçasibaşı with 12 championship titles of Turkey, while they are followed by Halkbank with eight titles. / Prva turska odbojkaška liga ili Efeler liga je najviši rang takmičenja turske klupske odbojke. Istorijsko najuspešniji klub je Ečasibaši sa 12 osvojenih titula prvaka Turske dok ih u stopu prati Halkbank sa osam titula.

programme.desc: The Danish football league and its strongest Danish football ranking is known as the Superliga and was founded in 1991. programme.title: Hockey - KHL: Lokomotiv - CSKA / Hokej - KHL: Lokomotiv - CSKA
programme.desc: The strongest hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called the KHL or Continental Hockey League. The competition itself originated from the Russian Super League in 2008, and since then the competition has spread to more and more European and Asian countries, becoming unofficially the second best hockey league in the world after the American-Canadian NHL. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL playoffs receives the prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed Russian team wins the title of champion of Russia. Since 2011, in addition to clubs from the former USSR, clubs from Central Europe have entered the league, while since 2016, a Chinese representative has entered for the first time. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Football - Russian league: Rubin - Zenit / Fudbal - Ruska liga: Rubin - Zenit
programme.desc: The Russian Football League, as the successor of the Soviet Union, records its competitive beginnings in 1936, although football has been played on the territory of the Union since the 1900s. The most successful team during that time was Spartak Moscow, although since the beginning of the second half of the century, clubs like CSKA Moscow and Zenit from St. Petersburg have been more successful. Petersburg. The league will continue until the 2012/2013 season. played in the term spring - autumn due to the long winter and since then it has been played classically European autumn - spring. Large financial investments in Russian football clubs have brought the league very close to the UEFA ranking of the coefficients of the first leagues in Europe. / Ruska fudbalska liga kao naslednik Sovjetskog saveza beleži svoje takmičarske početke od 1936. godine iako se fudbal na području saveza igrao još od 1900ih. Najuspješnija ekipa za to vreme je Moskovski Spartak iako od početka drugog dela veka uspješniji su klubovi poput CSKA Moskve i Zenita iz St. Petersburga. Liga se sve do sezone 2012./2013. igrala u terminu proleće - jesen zbog dugačke zime te se od tada igra klasično evropski jesen - proleće. Velika finansijska ulaganja u ruske fudbalske klubove jako su približili ligu na Uefinoj lestvici koeficijenata prvih liga po snazi u Evropi.

programme.title: Hockey - KHL: Lokomotiv - CSKA / Hokej - KHL: Lokomotiv - CSKA
programme.desc: The strongest hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called the KHL or Continental Hockey League. The competition itself originated from the Russian Super League in 2008, and since then the competition has spread to more and more European and Asian countries, becoming unofficially the second best hockey league in the world after the American-Canadian NHL. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL playoffs receives the prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed Russian team wins the title of champion of Russia. Since 2011, in addition to clubs from the former USSR, clubs from Central Europe have entered the league, while since 2016, a Chinese representative has entered for the first time. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league: CSKA - Pari NN / Košarka - VTB liga: CSKA - Pari NN
programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Belorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Sport Brothers League
programme.desc: An event dedicated to the promotion of football and healthy lifestyle habits, organized by the Sports Brothers League and FC Bežanija. Children aged 10 to 12 compete in the tournament, and the little ones can expect a suitable accompanying program. / Manifestacija posvećena promociji fudbala i zdravih životnih navika u organizaciji Sports Brothers League i FK Bežanija. Na turniru se takmiče deca starosti od 10 do 12 godina, a mališane očekuje i prigodan propratni program.

programme.title: Sportske igre mladih
programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this region, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. Under the slogan We live life without drugs, because drugs take life, we enable elementary school students in Serbia to participate completely free of charge in competitions, in ten sports disciplines, and the most successful individuals and teams travel on a free mini-vacation as participants in the GRAND INTERNATIONAL FINALS of the Games in Split. We enable young people to participate completely free of charge in competitions in ten sports disciplines (soccer, beach volleyball, street basketball, handball, volleyball, game between two fires, table tennis, tennis, athletics and chess). / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za decu i omladinu na ovim prostorima, čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva. Pod sloganom Živimo život bez droge, jer droga uzima život, osnovcima u Srbiji omogućavamo potpuno besplatno učestvovanje u takmičenjima, u deset sportskih disciplina i najuspešniji pojedinci i ekipe putuju na besplatno mini letovanje kao učesnici VELIKOG MEĐUNARODNOG FINALA Igara u Splitu. Mladima godinama omogućavamo potpuno besplatno učestvovanje u takmičenjima u deset sportskih disciplina, (mali fudbal, odbojka na pesku, ulični basket, rukomet, odbojka, igra između dve vatre, stoni tenis, tenis, atletika i šah).

The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular season, playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / Natonal Hockey League je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dve severnoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: Sports magazine that brings you all the latest news, results, statistics and interesting facts from the world of American football. / Sportski magazin koji vam donosi sve najnovije vesti, rezultate, statistiku i zanimljivosti iz sveta američkog fudbala.

programme.title: American football - NFL: Cincinnati Bengals - Pittsburgh Steelers / Američki fudbal - NFL: Cincinnati Bengals - Pittsburgh Steelers
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but it was only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century that the current version of the competition was created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most media-covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Bejzbole - MLB: Los Angeles Dodgers - Millwaukee Brewers, Game 3 / Bejzbol - MLB: Los Angeles Dodgers - Milwaukee Brewers, Game 3
programme.desc: MLB or Major League Baseball is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the World Series. The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play in the World Series finals. The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili Major League Baseball je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem World Seriesa. Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju World Series finale. Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Šampionat
programme.desc: The Stanley Cup is the name of the trophy awarded to the winner of the duel between the best team of the Eastern Conference and the best team of the Western Conference in the National Hockey League. This competition with a rich tradition has been played since 1893. / Stenli kup je naziv za trofej koji se dodeljuje pobedniku duela najboljeg tima Istočne konferencije i najboljeg tima Zapadne konferencije u Nacionalnoj hokejaškoj ligi. Ovo takmičenje bogate tradicije igra se od davne 1893. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA League: Final: Oklahoma - Indiana, G5 / Košarka - NBA liga: Finale: Oklahoma - Indiana, G5
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, will forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna meseca davne 1946. godine zauvek će promeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: NFL Arena
programme.desc: A show dedicated to the National Football League, the largest professional competition in American football that was founded in 1920. Find out all about the upcoming matches, the best players and the expectations of the teams. / Emisija posvećena Nacionalnoj fudbalskoj ligi, najvećem profesionalnom takmičenju u američkom fudbalu koje je osnovano 1920. godine. Saznajte sve o utakmicama koje slede, najboljim igračima i očekivanjima timova.

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Ilirija - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Ilirija - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Water polo - Regional league: Radnički - Jadran / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Radnički - Jadran
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or the sponsor name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs compete, later also Italian and Serbian clubs. The first season, which began on September 26, 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. The year of establishment is taken as the same year 2008, when the decision was made in Dubrovnik at the qualifying tournament for the European Championship. After the first season, Italian representatives also joined the league, who soon gave up, while since 2014, the league has also included clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. Prva sezona, koja je počela 26. septembra 2008., okupljala je 12 klubova, 8 iz Hrvatske, 3 iz Crne Gore i 1 iz Slovenije. Za godinu osnutka se uzima ista ta 2008. godina kada je odluka donešena u Dubrovniku na kvalifikacionom turniru za Evropsko prvenstvo. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

programme.title: Jezdeci na dolge steze
programme.desc: In Missouri, after the end of the Civil War, outlaws Frank and Jesse James join a group consisting of the Coleman brothers, Jim and Bob Younger, and the Miller boys. Together they form a gang that attacks carriages and banks. A bank robbery ends in a shootout with government men. Some of the members of the gang also have better halves: Coleman Younger spends time with the unyielding Belle Start, while Ed Miller is engaged to the reserved Beth. The story begins with a large and successful bank robbery in Missouri and ends with a bank robbery in Northfield, in which there is a massacre of Jessie James's gang. Between the two groundbreaking events, the film shows how the men meet their loved ones and report to them, how there are conflicts within the gang, how they drink in the city pubs and have fun with the buyable women in brothels, how they think about calming down, withdrawing and starting to live a normal life. All the while, Pinkerton's corrupt agency is on their trail, killing their innocent relatives due to intimidation, and this is why public opinion is increasingly on the side of the outcasts. The breakthrough and massacre comes when Jessie James' gang attacks in Northfield. / V Missouriju se po koncu državljanske vojne izobčenca Frank in Jesse James pridružita skupini, ki jo sestavljajo bratje Coleman, Jim in Bob Younger ter Millerjeva fanta. Skupaj ustanovijo tolpo, ki napada kočije in banke. Rop banke se konča s strelskim obračunom z vladnimi možmi. Nekateri od članov tolpe imajo tudi boljše polovice: Coleman Younger preživlja čas z nepopustljivo Belle Start, medtem ko je Ed Miller zaročen z zadržano Beth.Zgodba se prične z velikim in uspešnim bančnim ropom v Missuriju in zaokroži z bančnim ropom v Northfieldu, v katerem je prišlo do masakra tolpe Jessie Jamesa. Med obema prelomnima dogodkoma film prikazuje, kako moški srečujejo svoje drage in se z njimi poročajo, kako prihaja do spopadov znotraj bande, kako popivajo po mestnih krčmah in se zabavajo s kupljivimi ženskami v kurbiščih, kako razmišljajo, da bi se umirili, umaknili in pričelo živeti normalno življenje. Ves čas pa jim je na sledi Pinkertonova skorumpirana agencija, ki zaradi ustrahovanja pobija njihove nedolžne sorodnike, prav zaradi tega pa je javno mnenje vse bolj na strani izobčencev. Do preloma in masakra pa pride ob napadu tolpe Jessie Jamesa v Northfieldu.

programme.title: Football (M): Slovenia - Switzerland, Qualification for the 2026 World Cup / Nogomet (M): Slovenija - Švica, Kvalifikacije za Svetovno prvenstvo 2026
programme.desc: A month ago, Switzerland taught the Slovenian national football team a real lesson, will anything be different in Stožice? More than two hundred members of the International Football Association (FIFA) are competing in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Cup in football. The long and very tense qualifications differ depending on which continental confederation it is. What they all have in common is that it is an overture to the final tournament. The importance of the qualifications is further enhanced by the fact that no one except the host has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must fight for the opportunity to defend the title. / Švica je pred mesecem dni slovenski nogometni reprezentanci odčitala pravo lekcijo, bo v Stožicah kaj drugače?Več kot dvesto članic Mednarodne nogometne organizacije (FIFA) tekmuje v kvalifikacijah za glavni turnir svetovnega prvenstva v nogometu.Dolge in zelo napete kvalifikacije se razlikujejo glede na to, za katero kontinentalno konfederacijo gre. Vsem pa je skupno to, da gre za uverturo v končni turnir.Pomen kvalifikacij še povečuje dejstvo, da na zaključnem turnirju nima pravice sodelovati nihče razen gostitelja, svetovni prvaki pa se morajo izboriti za priložnost za obrambo naslova.

programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.desc: Mid-mornings begin with an overview of the daily press and the current topic, which we put in the center. In the column "Good morning, I have a problem!", together with the viewers, we overcome various dilemmas, and we offer advice on traffic minutes for all road users. We also take a look at what's new in the world of film and entertainment and give you suggestions for good books and interesting content broadcast on TV Slovenija, while the field team shares garden tips. Wednesday is also sports-themed, in the section "Š as a sport" we learn about unusual sports, host sports heroes and comment on and announce important sports events. A morning with us is a good morning! / Sredina jutra se pričnejo s pregledom dnevnega tiska in aktualne teme, ki jo postavljamo V središče. V rubriki »Dobro jutro, imam problem!« skupaj z gledalci premagujemo najrazličnejše zagate, za vse udeležence v prometu pa svetujemo v prometnih minutah. Pogledamo tudi, kaj je novega v svetu filma in zabave ter vam podamo predloge za dobre knjige in zanimive vsebine, ki se predvajajo na TV Slovenija, terenska ekipa pa deli vrtne nasvete. Sreda je tudi športno obarvana, v rubriki »Š kot šport« spoznavamo nenavadne športe, gostimo športne junake in komentiramo ter napovedujemo pomembne športne dogodke. Jutro z nami je dobro jutro!

programme.title: What's going on?: Melani Mekicar, Mon. / Kaj dogaja?: Melani Mekicar, pon.
programme.desc: You probably weren't invited to the meeting with Golob's lawyer, so you better stay at home and watch the new episode of the show What's going on? Who bought Gorenjka, what is happening in Styria and why are we still standing in Primorka? In the field, we found out how the system copes with the lack of doctors, and our linguist Master Baltič analyzes the driveway where the government collects money for weapons. This time, Robi Petan generously gave up his space to the Speaker of the National Assembly, Urška, who recited some of his poetry together with Boro, and in the telenovela Palomar, we see how Prime Minister Golob takes care of his security guards. Our guest will be presenter and actress Melani Mekicar, and the Lojzeta Odpustak Ensemble will sing the legendary Postman on the Little Terrace. / Na sestanek z Golobovim odvetnikom verjetno niste bili povabljeni, zato raje ostanite doma in si oglejte novo epizodo oddaje Kaj dogaja? Kdo je kupil Gorenjko, kaj se dogaja na Štajerskem in zakaj še vedno stojimo na Primorki? Na terenu smo ugotavljali, kako se sistem spopada z pomanjkanjem zdravnikov, naš jezikoborec magister Baltič pa analizira dovoz, na katerem vlada zbira denar za orožje. Robi Petan je tokrat svoj prostor velikodušno odstopil predsednici državnega zbora Urški, ki je skupaj z Borom zrecitirala nekaj svoje poezije, v telenoveli Palomar pa vidimo, kako premier Golob skrbi za svoje varnostnike. Naša gostja bo voditeljica in igralka Melani Mekicar, na Mali terasi pa nam bo Ansambel Lojzeta Odpustaka zapel legendarnega Poštarja.

programme.title: About animals and people, educational-advisory show, Mon. / O živalih in ljudeh, izobraževalno–svetovalna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: We admired the maned wolves that arrived at the Ljubljana Zoo some time ago. We visited the breeder of the canary mastiff breed and got to know many puppies of this breed. We present a large prey - the snake. We advise how to prepare nutritious food / Občudovali smo grivasti volkulji, ki sta pred časom prispeli v Ljubljanski živalski vrt. Obiskali smo vzreditelja pasme kanarske doge in se družili s številnimi mladički te pasme. Predstavljamo veliko ujedo – kačarja. Svetujemo, kako pripraviti hranljiv
programme.desc: ozivalih@rtvslo.si.

programme.title: People and Earth, educational-advisory show, Mon. / Ljudje in zemlja, izobraževalno–svetovalna oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: Our team visited the Biotechnical Center Ljubljana. We also attended the ninth meeting of young farm takers. We present a project called Feelings on the farm. With the project, they draw attention to mental health problems and help adapted to the farming population. Rabič farm from Slovenska Bistrica was the winner in the online voting category of the Naj hlev competition. We present a scientific study that demonstrated the bioinsecticidal effect of proteins from mushrooms on the Colorado potato beetle. / Naša ekipa je obiskala Biotehniški center Ljubljana. Bili smo tudi na devetem srečanju mladih prevzemnikov kmetij. Predstavljamo projekt, ki so ga poimenovali Počutje na kmetiji. S projektom opozarjajo na težave v duševnem zdravju in na pomoč prilagojeno kmečkemu prebivalstvu. Na natečaju za Naj hlev je v kategoriji spletnega glasovanja slavila kmetija Rabič iz Slovenske Bistrice. Predstavljamo znanstveno raziskavo s katero so dokazali bioinsekticidno delovanje proteinov iz gob na koloradskega hrošča.

programme.title: FEATURED: Your Son Huckleberry Finn Book Show Mon. / izBRANO: Tvoj sin Huckleberry Finn, oddaja o knjigah, pon.
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the unexpected death of the writer Bekim Sejranović, restless spirit of the Balkans and master of auto fiction. He planned the trip along the Sava as a child, as he humorously described in the book Nikamor, od nirod. In 2006, he and his friends realized the idea, at which time a film was made about this trip, which was shot by Moku Teraoka, one of the protagonists of the novel Your Son, Huckleberry Finn. / Minilo je pet let odkar je nepričakovano umrl pisatelj Bekim Sejranović, nemirni duh Balkana in mojster avtofikcije. Popotovanje po Savi je načrtoval že kot otrok, kot je humorno opisal v knjigi Nikamor, od nikoder. Leta 2006 je s prijateljema idejo uresničil, takrat je o tem popotovanju nastal tudi film, ki ga je posnel Moku Teraoka, eden izmed protagonistov romana Tvoj sin, Hucleberry Finn.

programme.title: Compatriots, a show about Slovenians abroad and around the world, Mon. / Rojaki, oddaja o Slovencih v zamejstvu in po svetu, pon.
programme.desc: The show "Compatriots" is a bridge between the homeland and Slovenians who live outside its borders. Song, literature, folklore and many other forms of expression keep the Slovenian word and tradition alive. Slovenia lives on also thanks to new economic connections, research and tourism initiatives and exceptional individuals who enrich our common space. These are all compatriots, get to know them together with us. / Oddaja »Rojaki« je most med domovino in Slovenci, ki živijo zunaj njenih meja. Pesem, literatura, folklora in številne druge oblike izražanja ohranjajo živo slovensko besedo in tradicijo. Slovenstvo živi naprej tudi po zaslugi novih gospodarskih povezovanj, raziskovalnih in turističnih pobud ter izjemnih posameznikov, ki bogatijo naš skupen prostor. Vse to so Rojaki, spoznajte jih skupaj z nami.

programme.title: Living room: Joy despite the bad / Dnevna soba: Radost kljub hudemu
programme.desc: Bernarde Žarn's guests in the Living Room will be missionary Tone Kerin and radio host Jure Sešek. They will talk about life in Madagascar and elsewhere, where Slovenian missionaries work, and above all about how to look for and find joy and spread goodness despite all the bad things in this world. / V Dnevni sobi bosta gosta Bernarde Žarn misijonar Tone Kerin in radijski voditelj Jure Sešek. Govorili bodo o življenju na Madagaskarju in drugod, kjer delujejo slovenski misijonarji in predvsem o tem, kako kljub vsemu hudemu na tem svetu iskati in najti radost ter širiti dobroto.

programme.title: Environments, pon. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambiences; In the vicinity of Olimje, there are charming wooden houses with a wonderful view, which are linked to the Kozjan tradition with their design. Their final image is the merit of the hearty owners with a great sense of aesthetics. / Ambienti; V bližini Olimja se s čudovitim razgledom ponašajo lične lesene hiške, ki se s svojo zasnovo navezujejo na kozjansko tradicijo. Njihova končna podoba je zasluga srčnih lastnikov z veliko občutka za estetiko.
programme.desc: Burnt wood on facades is returning to architecture as an aesthetic and sustainable solution - especially because it offers natural protection without chemicals, while at the same time creating a rustic and elegant look. Especially in Gorenjska, farmers used to deliberately burn wooden buildings to protect them from the weather and pests. When renovating the boathouse on the western edge of Lake Bled, the architects followed the materiality of the riverside buildings in this part of Slovenia. In the charming village above Litija, we visited the Green Paradise, which impresses with more than 2,000 varieties of plants from all over the world. It is spread over one and a half hectares of carefully paved steep terrain, where you can enjoy an informative walk among magnificent trees and shrubs and a stunning view of the surrounding hills. / Žgani les na fasadah se vrača v arhitekturo kot estetska in trajnostna rešitev – še posebej , ker ponuja naravno zaščito brez kemikalij, hkrati pa ustvarja rustikalen in eleganten videz. Predvsem na Gorenjskem, so kmetje nekoč lesene objekte namerno ožgali, da bi jih zaščitili pred vremenskimi vplivi in škodljivci. Arhitekti so pri prenovi čolnarne na zahodnem robu Blejskega jezera sledili materialnosti obrežnih objektov v tem delu Slovenije. V očarljivi vasici nad Litijo smo obiskali Zeleni raj, ki navdušuje z več kot 2000 sortami rastlin z vsega sveta. Razprostira se na poldrugem hektarju skrbno utrjenega strmega terena, kjer vas čaka poučen sprehod med veličastnimi drevesi in grmovnicami ter osupljiv razgled na okoliške hribe.

programme.title: Avtomobilnost: Prevoz na klic oziroma klik
programme.sub-title: We will publish a story about the new arrangement of public transport in the municipality of Radlje ob Drava. There, school transport was replaced by electric Toyota vans. They are also used for transportation between hamlets and also for "taxi" transportation, which citizens order via / Objavili bomo zgodbo o novi ureditvi javnega prevoza v občini Radlje ob Dravi. Tam so namreč šolske prevoze nadomestili z električnimi Toyotinimi kombiji. Uporabljajo jih tudi za prevoze med zaselki in še za -taksi” prevoze, ki jih občani naročijo preko
programme.desc: In more than a hundred Slovenian municipalities, they have Prostoferje - volunteers who drive the elderly to the doctor, to the store or to run other errands. We hung out with the "freelancers" at the AMZS training ground in Vransko, where they had driving training. We filmed the show in Ptuj, where they installed a traffic sign equipped with radar. It stands at one of the busiest traffic spots. You will also hear a conversation with an Audi engineer about the suspension of the new Q3 SUV and a discussion about the Ford van with an asymmetrical design. / V več kot sto slovenskih občinah imajo Prostoferje - prostovoljce, ki starejše vozijo k zdravniku, v trgovino ali po drugih opravkih. S »prostoferji« smo se družili na poligonu AMZS-ja na Vranskem, kjer so imeli vozniško izobraževanje.Oddajo smo posneli na Ptuju, kjer so postavili z radarjem opremljeni prometni znak. Stoji na eni od prometno bolj obremenjenih točk.Slišali boste tudi pogovor z Audijevim inženirjem o vzmetenju novega SUV-ja, znamke Q3 in diskusijo o Fordovem kombiju z asimetrično obliko.

programme.title: A trail of millennia: Heritage of the State Museum in Ljubljana, documentary film, Mon. / Sled tisočletij: Dediščina Deželnega muzeja v Ljubljani, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Amir Muratović... The National Museum of Slovenia is the oldest continuously operating museum institution in Slovenia. It has stored almost 100,000 years of history in 200 years. / R: Amir Muratović... Narodni muzej Slovenije je najstarejša neprekinjeno delujoča muzejska ustanova na Slovenskem. V 200 letih je shranil skoraj 100.000 let zgodovine.
programme.desc: The jubilee exhibition Zlata sled will guide visitors through the history and present of the museum. The film follows the preparation of the layout concept, the care of the restorers and conservators for the objects, the installation of the exhibition and its final appearance. When the then State Museum was founded, they turned to patriotic friends of science. The first collections were donated to the museum by counts Zois, Hohenwart, Hladnik, Erberg, Repežič, the mayor of Hradecki and bishops Wolf and Baraga. The first exhibition spaces in the lyceum were too small, and they started building a new museum building. In honor of the wedding of Crown Prince Rudolf, it was named Rudolfinum. Local artists and craftsmen participated in the plans and interior fittings, the authors of the paintings in the entrance hall and on the staircase are Janez and Jurij Šubic. The management of the museum has always been aware that it is a national museum that preserves the heritage of thousands of years. The original museum was later divided into several institutions. First, the Ethnographic Museum became independent, then the Museum of Natural History, which still has premises in the same building, and after the Second World War, the current Archives of the Republic of Slovenia became independent. The National Gallery received many works of art from the National Museum. The film highlights the most important museum items, such as the Neanderthal flute, the Koliščar finds, the jewelry of the Princess of Stis, the situla from Vača, the mummy, the statue of Emonc, Roman swords from Ljubljanica, the first photographs on glass, Prešeren's legacy. The author was interested in the stories of the objects, what they were used for, why they are important and, above all, whether they are placed in a different time than when the museum acquired them through new museum knowledge. In this way, the film also presents the valuable scientific work of curators, restorers and all others who take care of the preservation and protection of museum objects. The screenwriter and director of the film is Amir Muratović, director of photography and cinematographer Bernard Perme, editor Zlatjan Čučkov, author and music performer Boštjan Gombač. / Skozi zgodovino in sedanjost muzeja bo obiskovalce vodila jubilejna razstava Zlata sled. Film spremlja pripravljanje koncepta postavitve, skrb restavratorjev in konservatorjev za predmete, postavljanje razstave in njeno končno podobo. Ob ustanovitvi takratnega Deželnega muzeja so se obrnili na domoljubne prijatelje znanosti. Prve zbirke so muzeju podarili grofje Zois, Hohenwart, Hladnik, Erberg, Repežič, župan Hradecki ter škofa Wolf in Baraga. Prvi razstavni prostori v liceju so bili premajhni in lotili so se gradnje nove muzejske stavbe. V čast poroke prestolonaslednika Rudolfa so jo poimenovali Rudolfinum. Pri načrtih in notranji opremi so sodelovali domači umetniki in mojstri, avtorja poslikav v vhodni dvorani in na stopnišču sta Janez in Jurij Šubic. Vodstva muzeja so se v vseh obdobjih zavedala, da gre za nacionalni muzej, ki ohranja dediščino tisočletij.Prvotni muzej se je pozneje razdelil na več institucij. Najprej se je osamosvojil Etnografski muzej, nato Prirodoslovni muzej, ki ima še danes prostore v isti stavbi, po drugi vojni pa se je izdvojil še današnji Arhiv Republike Slovenije. Narodna galerija je veliko umetnin dobila iz Narodnega muzeja.Film izpostavlja najpomembnejše muzealije, kot so neandertalska piščal, koliščarske najdbe, nakit stiške kneginje, situla iz Vač, mumija, kip Emonca, rimski meči iz Ljubljanice, prve fotografije na steklu, Prešernova zapuščina. Avtorja so zanimale zgodbe predmetov, čemu so služili, zakaj so pomembni in predvsem, ali so skozi nova muzealska spoznanja umeščeni v času drugače, kot takrat, ko jih je muzej pridobil. Na ta način je v filmu predstavljeno tudi dragoceno znanstveno delo kustosov, restavratorjev in vseh drugih, ki skrbijo za ohranitev in varovanje muzejskih predmetov.Scenarist in režiser filma je Amir Muratović, direktor fotografije in snemalec Bernard Perme, montažer Zlatjan Čučkov, avtor in izvajalec glasbe Boštjan Gombač.

programme.title: On to the beautiful: Horse tourism, Mon. / Na lepše: Konjski turizem, pon.
programme.desc: Holidays on horseback are one of the more authentic ways to get to know the microlocations of individual regions from a completely different perspective. Equestrianism and riding have a centuries-old tradition in Slovenia, and sometimes the horse was at home as a member of the family, as it helped with farm chores, was a basic means of transport and also communication between remote and hard-to-reach villages. Today, in the light of tourism, it seems that off-road riding can be a good way of soft tourism, to keep guests in transit destinations that are not part of the tourist backbone not only for one night, but also for a whole week. In the show, more about the Pula Dolenj estate, horse trails in the Green Karst area, and the recently opened Museum of Trucking and Transportation in Senožeče. / Počitnice na konjskem hrbtu so eden bolj pristnih načinov, kako s čisto drugačne perspektive spoznavati mikrolokacije posameznih regij. Konjeništvo in jahanje imata v Sloveniji večstoletno tradicijo in včasih je bil konj pri hiši kot član družine, saj je pomagal pri kmečkih opravilih, bil osnovno prevozno sredstvo ter tudi komunikacija med oddaljenimi in težko dostopnimi vasmi. Danes pa se v luči turizma zdi, da je terensko jahanje lahko dober način mehkega turizma, kako goste v tranzitnih destinacijah, ki niso del turistične hrbtenice, zadržati ne samo eno noč, ampak tudi po cel teden. V oddaji več o dolenjskem posestvu Pule, konjskih poteh na območju Zelenega krasa ter o še sveže odprtem Muzeju tovorništva in prevozništva v Senožečah.

programme.title: Environments, pon. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambiences; In the vicinity of Olimje, there are charming wooden houses with a wonderful view, which are linked to the Kozjan tradition with their design. Their final image is the merit of the hearty owners with a great sense of aesthetics. / Ambienti; V bližini Olimja se s čudovitim razgledom ponašajo lične lesene hiške, ki se s svojo zasnovo navezujejo na kozjansko tradicijo. Njihova končna podoba je zasluga srčnih lastnikov z veliko občutka za estetiko.
programme.desc: Burnt wood on facades is returning to architecture as an aesthetic and sustainable solution - especially because it offers natural protection without chemicals, while at the same time creating a rustic and elegant look. Especially in Gorenjska, farmers used to deliberately burn wooden buildings to protect them from the weather and pests. When renovating the boathouse on the western edge of Lake Bled, the architects followed the materiality of the riverside buildings in this part of Slovenia. In the charming village above Litija, we visited the Green Paradise, which impresses with more than 2,000 varieties of plants from all over the world. It is spread over one and a half hectares of carefully paved steep terrain, where you can enjoy an informative walk among magnificent trees and shrubs and a stunning view of the surrounding hills. / Žgani les na fasadah se vrača v arhitekturo kot estetska in trajnostna rešitev – še posebej , ker ponuja naravno zaščito brez kemikalij, hkrati pa ustvarja rustikalen in eleganten videz. Predvsem na Gorenjskem, so kmetje nekoč lesene objekte namerno ožgali, da bi jih zaščitili pred vremenskimi vplivi in škodljivci. Arhitekti so pri prenovi čolnarne na zahodnem robu Blejskega jezera sledili materialnosti obrežnih objektov v tem delu Slovenije. V očarljivi vasici nad Litijo smo obiskali Zeleni raj, ki navdušuje z več kot 2000 sortami rastlin z vsega sveta. Razprostira se na poldrugem hektarju skrbno utrjenega strmega terena, kjer vas čaka poučen sprehod med veličastnimi drevesi in grmovnicami ter osupljiv razgled na okoliške hribe.

programme.title: Our Inattentive, Hyperactive Mind, UK Documentary, Mon. / Naš nepozorni, hiperaktivni um, britanska dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: It is estimated that as many as one in seven people are neurodivergent - their brains simply work differently than most people. However, they often encounter misunderstanding from those close to them, which is why many deal with depression, anxiety and even suicidal thoughts. Televisions / Ocenjujejo, da je kar sedmina ljudi nevrorazličnih – njihovi možgani preprosto delujejo drugače kot pri večini. Vendar pogosto naletijo na nerazumevanje bližnjih, zato se številni spoprijemajo z depresijo, tesnobo in celo samomorilnimi mislimi. Televizi
programme.desc: Henry, a young tour guide who was diagnosed with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in high school, does not get in the way of his work. His energy and imagination even help him. It's different when he has to plan his daily errands. With these, he is often completely lost and fears that he is a disgrace to those close to him. 51-year-old Jo was diagnosed with this disorder only in menopause and now regrets that she did not find out about it earlier. Now she knows why she changed as many as 14 jobs and could never settle down. The show shows how two people with attention deficit disorder prepare a short film to explain to their loved ones how their hyperactive mind works. INSIDE OUR MINDS, ADHD / Great Britain / 2025 / Director: Joe Myerscough. / Mladega turističnega vodnika Henryja, pri katerem so v srednji šoli odkrili motnjo pozornosti s hiperaktivnostjo, njegova drugačnost ne ovira pri delu. Energičnost in domiselnost mu celo pomagata. Drugače je, ko mora načrtovati vsakodnevne opravke. Pri teh je pogosto povsem izgubljen in boji se, da je bližnjim v sramoto. 51-letni Jo pa so diagnozo te motnje postavili šele v menopavzi in zdaj obžaluje, da zanjo ni izvedela že prej. Zdaj ve, zakaj je zamenjala kar 14 zaposlitev in se ni mogla nikoli ustaliti. Oddaja prikazuje, kako obe osebi z motnjo pozornosti pripravita kratek film, s katerim svojim bližnjim razložita, kako deluje njun hiperaktivni um. INSIDE OUR MINDS, ADHD / Velika Britanija / 2025 / Režija: Joe Myerscough.

programme.title: Let's Listen to the Silence: New Hope for Dementia, Mon. / Prisluhnimo tišini: Novo upanje za demenco, pon.
programme.desc: For the first time in history, drugs are available that can slow down the course of dementia. The European Commission has so far approved two, the first, lekanemab, and we expect it in Slovenia this year as well. It will be intended for people in the early stages of the disease with mild cognitive impairment. But despite new treatment options, experts emphasize that prevention is the most important. But when the disease flares up, support for people with dementia and their loved ones is crucial. Learn more about dementia, its development and ways of dealing with it in the show Listen to the silence, which will be broadcast on October 15, 2025 at 3:40 p.m. on the first program of Television Slovenia. / Prvič v zgodovini so na voljo zdravila, ki lahko upočasnijo potek demence. Evropska komisija je doslej odobrila že dve, prvo, lekanemab, letos pričakujemo tudi v Sloveniji. Namenjeno bo osebam v zgodnji fazi bolezni z blagimi kognitivnimi motnjami. A kljub novim možnostim zdravljenja strokovnjaki poudarjajo, da je najpomembnejša preventiva. Ko pa bolezen izbruhne, je ključna podpora osebam z demenco in njihovim bližnjim. Več o demenci, njenem razvoju in načinih spoprijemanja z njo v oddaji Prisluhnimo tišini, ki bo na sporedu 15. 10. 2025 ob 15.40 na prvem programu Televizije Slovenija.

programme.sub-title: Today marks the end of the 34th Week for Life, which under the title Man + Woman = Original Plan draws attention to the sanctity of life. / Danes se zaključuje 34. teden za življenje, ki z naslovom Moški + ženska = izvorni načrt opozarja na svetost življenja.
programme.desc: Recently, the Slovenian public has been talking about life and related issues, as we are witnessing tectonic shifts in its understanding. While modern man positions himself as the standard and master of life, most religious traditions teach us that life is a gift from God and therefore sacred. The Catholic Church emphasizes that every person is created in God's image and therefore has immeasurable value, regardless of age, health, abilities or circumstances. / O življenju in z njim povezanimi vprašanji se v zadnjem času v slovenski javnosti krešejo menja, saj smo priče tektonskim premikom v njegovem razumevanju. Medtem ko se sodobni človek postavlja za merilo in gospodarja življenja, nas večina verskih tradicij uči, da je življenje Božji dar in zato sveto. Katoliška cerkev poudarja, da je vsak človek ustvarjen po Božji podobi in ima zato neizmerno vrednost, ne glede na starost, zdravje, sposobnosti ali okoliščine.

programme.desc: You probably weren't invited to the meeting with Golob's lawyer, so you better stay at home and watch the new episode of the show What's going on? Robi Petan je tokrat svoj prostor velikodušno odstopil predsednici državnega zbora Urški, ki je skupaj z Borom zrecitirala nekaj svoje poezije, v telenoveli Palomar pa vidimo, kako premier Golob skrbi za svoje varnostnike. programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.desc: The best introduction to the weekend is the Friday show Dobro jutro, which serves you with good cheer and useful information. In the first hour, we first check what is current at home and around the world, and before eight o'clock we offer a wide variety of practical advice. In the following, we will focus on minor health problems and solutions. The Culinary section of Cooking Minutes has a special place, where we highlight traditional Slovenian dishes and reveal useful tricks on how to prepare them in a simple but tasty way. In the last hour of the show, we accept the greetings and congratulations of the viewers for their loved ones and delight you with many prize games. Let the show Dobro jutro be the right one and the best company with your morning coffee. / Najboljši uvod v konec tedna je petkova oddaja Dobro jutro, ki vam postreže z dobro voljo in s koristnimi informacijami. V prvi uri najprej preverjamo, kaj je aktualnega doma in po svetu, pred osmo pa ponudimo najrazličnejše praktične nasvete. V nadaljevanju se posvetimo manjšim zdravstvenim težavam in rešitvam. Posebno mesto ima kulinarična rubrika Kuharske minute, kjer izpostavljamo tradicionalne slovenske jedi in razkrijemo uporabne trike, kako jih pripraviti na enostaven, a okusen način. V zadnji uri oddaje sprejemamo pozdrave in čestitke gledalcev za svoje bližnje in vas razveseljujemo s številnimi nagradnimi igrami. Naj bo oddaja Dobro jutro prava in najboljša družba ob jutranji kavi.

programme.title: Let's Bite Science: Mind Wandering, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Tavanje misli, pon.
programme.sub-title: During a lecture, a meeting or even a conversation with a loved one, we often think about something completely different. Scientists have found that almost half of the time we are awake, our brain is not where our body is. Mind wandering, as we call it, is momentary / Med predavanjem, sestankom ali celo pogovorom z bližnjim velikokrat razmišljamo o čem popolnoma drugem. Znanstveniki ugotavljajo, da skoraj polovico časa, ko smo budni, naši možgani niso tam, kjer je telo. Tavanje misli, kakor pravimo temu, je trenutno
programme.desc: Why is mind wandering useful and when does it become a problem? What happens in the brain then? In the show, they will also prepare an experiment in which the viewers can also participate. During the beeps, the creators will write down their thoughts, and the guest of the show will see if their thoughts wandered or not. / Zakaj je tavanje misli koristno in kdaj postane težava? Kaj se takrat dogaja v možganih? V oddaji bodo pripravili tudi eksperiment, pri katerem bodo lahko sodelovali tudi gledalci. Ob piskih bodo ustvarjalci zapisali svoje misli, gost oddaje pa bo pogledal, ali so jim misli tavale ali ne.

programme.title: Car availability: Transport on call or click, Mon. / Avtomobilnost: Prevoz na klic oziroma klik, pon.
programme.sub-title: We will publish a story about the new arrangement of public transport in the municipality of Radlje ob Drava. There, school transport was replaced by electric Toyota vans. They are also used for transportation between hamlets and also for "taxi" transportation, which citizens order via / Objavili bomo zgodbo o novi ureditvi javnega prevoza v občini Radlje ob Dravi. Tam so namreč šolske prevoze nadomestili z električnimi Toyotinimi kombiji. Uporabljajo jih tudi za prevoze med zaselki in še za -taksi” prevoze, ki jih občani naročijo preko
programme.desc: In more than a hundred Slovenian municipalities, they have Prostoferje - volunteers who drive the elderly to the doctor, to the store or to run other errands. We hung out with the "freelancers" at the AMZS training ground in Vransko, where they had driving training. We filmed the show in Ptuj, where they installed a traffic sign equipped with radar. It stands at one of the busiest traffic spots. You will also hear a conversation with an Audi engineer about the suspension of the new Q3 SUV and a discussion about the Ford van with an asymmetrical design. / V več kot sto slovenskih občinah imajo Prostoferje - prostovoljce, ki starejše vozijo k zdravniku, v trgovino ali po drugih opravkih. S »prostoferji« smo se družili na poligonu AMZS-ja na Vranskem, kjer so imeli vozniško izobraževanje.Oddajo smo posneli na Ptuju, kjer so postavili z radarjem opremljeni prometni znak. Stoji na eni od prometno bolj obremenjenih točk.Slišali boste tudi pogovor z Audijevim inženirjem o vzmetenju novega SUV-ja, znamke Q3 in diskusijo o Fordovem kombiju z asimetrično obliko.

programme.title: Holy and holy: -He sent me to preach the gospel to the poor- / Sveto in svet: -Poslal me je oznanjat evangelij ubogim-
programme.desc: He sent me to preach the gospel to the poor is the motto of the Missionary Society - Lazarists. The community of priests and brothers, the society of apostolic life, was founded in 1625 by St. Vincentius Pavelski. On the occasion of the 400th anniversary of the Missionary Society, its beginnings and mission, the charism of St. Vincent of Pavelski and the role of the Vincentian family in the modern world in this year's program "Sveto in svet". / Poslal me je oznanjat evangelij ubogim je geslo Misijonske družbe – lazaristov. Vincencija Pavelskega in vlogi Vincencijanske družine v sodobnem svetu pa v tokratni oddaji Sveto in svet.

programme.sub-title: La Passion De Dodin Bouffant / The Taste Of Things; A wonderful film, which we do not recommend watching on an empty stomach. programme.desc: 1885. Chef Eugenie has been cooking for the famous gourmet Dodin for twenty years in the idyllic French countryside. Together they create dishes that satisfy even the most spoiled palates. Mutual admiration eventually blossoms into a romantic relationship, but Eugenie likes to be free, so she doesn't want to get married. One summer day, however, Dodin decides to cook for his beloved for the first time... Original title: LA PASSION DE DODIN BOUFFANT Year of production: 2023 Country: France, Belgium Genre: romantic drama Director: Anh Hung Tran Screenplay: Anh Hung Tran based on the novel by Marcel Rouff Starring: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Magimel, Bonnie Chagneau-Ravoire, Patrick dAssumçao. / 1885. Kuharska mojstrica Eugenie na idiličnem francoskem podeželju že dvajset let kuha za znamenitega sladokusca Dodina. Skupaj ustvarjata jedi, ki zadovoljijo celo najbolj razvajene brbončice. Medsebojno občudovanje sčasoma preraste v romantično razmerje, toda Eugenie je rada svobodna, zato se ne želi poročiti. Nekega poletnega dne pa se Dodin odloči, da bo prvič kuhal za svojo ljubljeno …Originalni naslov: LA PASSION DE DODIN BOUFFANTLeto produkcije: 2023Država: Francija, BelgijaŽanr: romantična dramaRežija: Anh Hung TranScenarij: Anh Hung Tran po romanu Marcela RouffaIgrajo: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Magimel, Bonnie Chagneau-Ravoire, Patrick dAssumçao.

programme.title: Century of the Soviet Union, British documentary series, 2/3, Mon. / Stoletje Sovjetske zveze, britanska dokumentarna serija, 2/3, pon.
programme.sub-title: The Soviet Union, 100th Anniversary 1922; After five years of civil war, the Soviet Union was founded on December 30, 1922, the first socialist country in the world, which left an indelible mark on the entire twentieth century. Documentary series in three / The Soviet Union, 100th Anniversary 1922; Po petih letih državljanske vojne je bila 30. decembra 1922 ustanovljena Sovjetska zveza, prva socialistična država na svetu, ki je vtisnila neizbrisen pečat vsemu dvajsetemu stoletju. Dokumentarna serija v treh
programme.desc: Part 2: With the intensification of the Cold War in the 1950s, the space race and the construction of the Berlin Wall, the Cuban Missile Crisis brought the world to the brink of nuclear war. The leaders of the superpowers managed to find a peaceful solution, but soon both left the stage of history. In the Soviet Union, which tried with all its might to catch up with the West, Khrushchev was deposed due to an unsuccessful agricultural policy, and Kennedy died in an assassination attempt. THE SOVIET UNION, 100TH ANNIVERSARY 1922 / Great Britain / 2022 / Director: Lyndy Saville. / 2. del:Z zaostrovanjem hladne vojne v 50. letih 20. stoletja, vesoljsko tekmo in gradnjo berlinskega zidu se je svet ob kubanski raketni krizi znašel na robu jedrske vojne. Voditeljema velesil je uspelo najti mirno rešitev, a sta kmalu oba zapustila oder zgodovine. V Sovjetski zvezi, ki si je z vsemi silami prizadevala dohiteti Zahod, so zaradi neuspešne kmetijske politike odstavili Hruščova, Kennedy pa je umrl v atentatu.THE SOVIET UNION, 100TH ANNIVERSARY 1922 / Velika Britanija / 2022 / Režija: Lyndy Saville.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: 2nd competition for jazz ensembles and soloists: Winners' concert with the Big Band of RTV Slovenia, recording from Studio 14 of Radio Slovenia, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: 2. tekmovanje za jazzovske ansamble in soliste: Koncert nagrajencev z Big bandom RTV Slovenija, posnetek iz Studia 14 Radia Slovenija, pon.
programme.desc: R: Šuligoj Jaka... Competition between jazz ensembles and soloists is unique in Slovenia. It is intended for young musicians who are still studying. It encourages them to deepen their knowledge, further education, motivates them and offers them recognition of their abilities and efforts. In total, more than 50 young talented competitors took part in the first two competitions. The fairness and professionalism of the competition was ensured by a five-member expert jury consisting of the most prominent instrumentalists and music educators. The following contestants performed at the concert: Matic Ašič (guitar), Matic Mikola (saxophone), Aljoša Struga (bass), Anže Vrabec (piano), Gregor Cepek (drums), Dano Ličen (vocals), Jure Rozman (drums) and Vid Jamnik (vibraphone). The artistic director of the competition is saxophonist Primoz Fleischman, otherwise a member of the Big Band of RTV Slovenia. / R: Šuligoj Jaka... Tekmovanje jazzovskih ansamblov in solistov je v Sloveniji edinstveno. Namenjeno je mladim glasbenikom, ki so še v teku šolanja. Spodbuja jih k poglabljanju znanj, nadaljnjem izobraževanju, jih motivira in jim nudi priznavanje njihovih sposobnosti in prizadevanja. Skupno je na prvih dveh tekmovanjih nastopilo več kot 50 mladih nadarjenih tekmovalcev. Za korektnost in strokovnost tekmovanja je skrbela petčlanska strokovna žirija, ki so jo sestavljali najuglednejši instrumentalisti in glasbeni pedagogi. Na koncertu so tako nastopili tekmovalci: Matic Ašič (kitara), Matic Mikola (saksofon), Aljoša Struga (bas), Anže Vrabec (klavir), Gregor Cepek (bobni), Dano Ličen (vokal), Jure Rozman (bobni) in Vid Jamnik (vibrafon). Umetniški vodja tekmovanja je saksofonist Primoz Fleischman, sicer član Big banda RTV Slovenija.

programme.title: News 3CatInfo / Notícies 3CatInfo
programme.desc: Information space with news, general information, sports and weather forecast. / Espai informatiu amb notícies dinformacio general, esportiva i previsio meteorològica.

programme.title: Blues a lestudi
programme.desc: Space that deals a dull blow to the panorama of blues and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows you to see key artists of this genre in their natural areas: the recording studios. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del blues i les seves variants a Catalunya. Un dels elements clau daquest programa musical es que permet veure artistes clau daquest gènere en el seus àmbits naturals: els estudis de gravacio.

programme.title: Jazz a lestudi
programme.desc: Space that deals a dull blow to the panorama of jazz and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows you to see artists such as Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador and Horacio Fumero in their natural areas: the recording studios. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del jazz i les seves variants a Catalunya. Un dels elements clau daquest programa musical es que permet veure artistes com Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador i Horacio Fumero en el seus àmbits naturals: els estudis de gravacio.

programme.title: News 3CatInfo / Notícies 3CatInfo
programme.desc: Information space with news, general information, sports and weather forecast. / Espai informatiu amb notícies dinformacio general, esportiva i previsio meteorològica.

programme.title: Matins
programme.desc: Morning program that gives the keys to the day that begins, explains the news that has happened by providing the context to understand them and analyzes with accredited voices the current affairs nearest and beyond the world. / Programa matinal que dona les claus del dia que comença, explica les notícies que han passat aportant-ne el context per entendre-les i analitza amb veus acreditades lactualitat mes propera i la darreu del mon.

programme.title: Everything is soft / Tot es mou
programme.desc: Helena Garcia Melero runs this daily magazine that follows current affairs, gives voice to the protagonists of the moment and deals with those issues that most closely affect the citizens with a friendly and distracted tone. / Helena Garcia Melero condueix aquest magazín diari que segueix lactualitat, dona veu als protagonistes del moment i tracta aquelles questions que toquen mes de prop els ciutadans amb un to amable i distret.

programme.title: Telenotícies comarques
programme.desc: Daily news, directed and presented by Núria Sole, with local and regional information that highlights the voice of the street, the witnesses and the protagonists of the news. TN Comarques explains and reflects the reality of towns and cities in Catalonia. / Informatiu diari, dirigit i presentat per Núria Sole, amb informacio local i comarcal que posa en valor la veu del carrer, els testimonis i els protagonistes de la notícia. TN Comarques explica i reflecteix la realitat dels pobles i ciutats de Catalunya.

programme.title: Telenotícies migdia
programme.desc: Daily news that includes the most outstanding current events, collected by TVC's news services, with the support of chronicles and connections with correspondents and special envoys around the world. / Informatiu diari que inclou els esdeveniments mes destacats de lactualitat, recollits pels serveis informatius de TVC, amb el suport de les cròniques i les connexions amb els corresponsals i enviats especials arreu del mon.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. programme.title: Married at first sight - in winter clothes / Gift vid forsta ogonkastet - i vinterskrud

Nar olikheter och likheter trader fram provas formågan att slappa in den andre och att våga visa vem man egentligen ar. programme.desc: Short archive. Backen Lill-Strimma Svedberg was so good that he became the first Westerner to be invited to the Soviet Union. An artist who died only 28 years old. / Kort arkivet. programme.desc: Food brothers James and Adam Price go on a fishing trip on the Sound of Öresund with fisherman Niels. programme.title: Sverige!
programme.desc: Fares Fares is a guest of Farah Abadi. As a 14-year-old, he came from Lebanon to Sweden. Örebro became the family's new hometown. Fares found acting and on that path it is. From the main role in his brother Josef's film Jalla! Yalla! to large theater stages and an international film career. In addition, we meet the actors who live in the wild west together with the visitors to Småland's High Chaparral and the illustrator in Harnosand who creates images for clients around the world. / Fares Fares ar gast hos Farah Abadi. Jalla! till stora teaterscener och internationell filmkarriar. However, Marianne gets in touch with two elderly gentlemen, John and Pontus, who help her through all the dangers of the big city. / En komedi om den unga Marianne som vantrivs i sitt arbete på en lantgård och istallet drommer om att klara sig sjalv i storstaden. Val dar står hon utan jobb eller bostad och till råga på allt blir hon bestulen på sin resvaska. Marianne får dock kontakt med två aldre gentlemen, John och Pontus, som hjalper henne genom storstadens alla faror.

Marianne, Goran and Vincent barricade themselves inside a club as panic spreads on the ship. / Vampyrinfektionen sprider sig nar Walter forvandlar Dan till en tankande vampyr, som snabbt blir fascinerad av sina nya formågor. Albin och Lo forfoljer Edith efter att ha sett henne attackera en annan passagerare. Pia inser att något riktigt skrammande håller på att handa mitt framfor deras ogon och tvingas agera på ett satt hon inte trodde att hon var kapabel till. Marianne, Goran och Vincent barrikaderar sig inne i en klubb nar paniken sprider sig på fartyget.
